rows.title: Business MI & Insight Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Turn Data Into Better Business Decisions
At Clear Group, we're building a data-driven business where insight plays a critical role in shaping decisions, improving performance and delivering better outcomes for our clients and colleagues.
We're looking for a Business MI & Insights Analyst to join our growing Data, MI & Analytics team. This is a highly visible role that sits at the heart of UK Retail, partnering with operational leaders and commercial stakeholders to understand performance, identify opportunities and provide meaningful insight that drives action.
If you enjoy solving business problems, influencing decisions and turning complex data into practical recommendations, we'd love to hear from you.
What You'll Be DoingYou'll work at the intersection of data, operations and business performance, helping leaders understand what's happening across the business and where improvements can be made.
You'll:Develop and maintain insightful dashboards, reports and MI solutions using Power BI and SQLAnalyse operational performance, productivity, customer outcomes and service deliveryIdentify trends, risks and opportunities that support better decision-makingPartner with stakeholders across Operations, Sales, Customer Experience and Retail leadership teamsSupport performance measurement, Consumer Duty monitoring and business change initiativesHelp embed a culture of data-driven decision making across UK RetailTranslate analysis into clear recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes
What We're Looking ForWe're interested in people who can combine analytical capability with strong commercial awareness and stakeholder engagement.
You'll likely have:Strong SQL skills and experience working with structured datasetsExperience building and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reporting solutionsThe ability to turn data into actionable business insightExperience working in operational, customer-focused or regulated environmentsExcellent communication and stakeholder management skillsA natural curiosity and desire to understand the story behind the data
Experience within insurance, insurance operations or knowledge of Acturis would be beneficial but isn't essential.
Why Join Clear?This is an opportunity to join a business that is evolving quickly and investing in how data supports growth and performance.
You'll have the opportunity to:Work closely with senior stakeholders across UK RetailInfluence operational and commercial decision-makingShape how performance insight is delivered across the businessSupport transformation and acquisition integration activityWork with modern tools and technologies including Power BI, Microsoft Fabric and SQLMake a visible impact in a growing and ambitious organisation
If you're looking for a role where your insight will influence decisions and your work will have a visible impact across the business, we'd love to hear from you.
EligibilityApplicants must have the legal right to work in the UK.
Recruitment Notice (Agencies)Clear Group does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. Where no signed terms of business exist, we reserve the right to engage directly with candidates.

rows.title: Analyst (Supply Analytics, Bangkok-based, Relocation provided)
rows.descriptionText:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

THIS ROLE IS BASED IN BANGKOK, THAILAND (WITH RELOCATION PROVIDED)

Location: Bangkok, Thailand (*Not open for remote work)

Get to Know our Team:

As part of the Supply Analytics, you will be responsible for identifying new partners and opportunities, cultivating a relationship with them, and working together with them to deliver the best outcome for our end customers. You would also be responsible with managing the day-to-day interaction with the partner and working closely with other teams within Agoda to ensure the partners needs are met.

We design tailored business and product solutions with our partners and help them generate measurable value. Members of our team are empowered and supported to grow their market(s) or accounts. We develop win-win relationships and leverage Agoda’s unique accommodations portfolio and tech solutions to bring our partners the advantages they seek. Utilizing our strong brand and resources, we build new channels to increase the visibility of Agoda, introduce more travelers to our great products and service and deliver significant revenues to the overall business.

The Opportunity: 

As an Analyst, you will report directly to either the Senior Manager or Associate Director within the Supply Department and this will be an individual contributor role. You will be responsible and fully empowered to work with the partners on the ground. You will be supported by a team within the Supply department and work closely with other Team members within Agoda.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

Translate internal briefs into analytical projects (to include refining the initial brief and asking the ‘right questions’, working through potential hypotheses and storyboarding the output)Use and analyze data from multiple large-scale data warehouses and present statistically strong analysis to a wide range of business stakeholders.Proactively identify opportunities for growth within supply and the wider business.Drive new analytical initiatives and projects aimed at improving organizational efficiency and shaping Agoda supply.Identify, support, and lead projects aimed at scaling up the way the Supply organization leverages on data, insights, and intelligence.Automate manual operational processes and present back on time savings gained through modernization of business operations

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

At least 2-5+ years of experience working as an Analyst with experience in analytics/data science/insights/strategy/BIAdvanced working knowledge and hands-on experience in SQLStrong knowledge and hands-on experience in data visualization tools such as Tableau (preferably) Expert domain of data analysis and data visualization tools and software such as Excel, Python (or R)Bachelor’s degree ideally in a business or quantitative subject (e.g. computer science, mathematics, engineering, science, economics or finance).A good understanding of statistical modelling knowledge or any machine learning technique knowledge (such as hypothesis testing, regression, logistic regression, random forest, etc.)Good stakeholder management experience. Comfortable presenting to senior leadership and C-suite.Experience in conducting A/B testing experimentationStrong experience in finding data insights and provide business recommendation to the businessA hacker’s mindset – the ability to build simple but clever and elegant solutions to new problems within significant resource, operational and time constraints through deep understanding of the business, creative problem solving, and a wide range of expertise in data, analytics, automation, programming, and prototyping.Excellent communicator with superior written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal communication skills.Data driven in both decision making and performance measurement.Extreme comfort in ambiguous, fast-paced environment.Ability to multi-task, prioritize and coordinate resources.

It’s Great if you Have: 

MBA or Masters in a quantitative subject (e.g. computer science, mathematics, engineering, science, economics or finance).Program management certifications (e.g. PMI, PRINCE2) to compliment your program management experience.Asian market experience.Travel industry / e-commerce / tech / consulting experience.

rows.title: Business Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Why This Role Matters 

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Offline & Online) strategy, to deliver trusted, actionable customer and commercial insight that drives profitable online growth by improving sales, conversion, and decision-making across our Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams. You will create visibility of performance, enable data-led decision-making, improve access to meaningful insights and champion the adoption of self-service analytics across the business. By transforming complex data into clear recommendations, you'll create clarity, enable confident decisions, and drive sustainable growth that shapes how millions of customers experience our brands so we can put a smile on our customers’ faces today and tomorrow.

What You'll Be Doing

Identify and quantify customer and commercial opportunities that drive profitable online growth, helping to improve sales, conversion and customer value across our channels. Deliver trusted customer, trading and performance insights that enable faster, more confident decision-making across the business. Partner closely with Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Analyse customer behaviour, digital journeys and conversion performance to uncover opportunities that enhance the customer experience and remove friction points. Evaluate the effectiveness of promotions, trading initiatives, product enhancements and A/B tests, ensuring investment is focused on the activities that deliver the greatest impact. Develop and evolve reporting, forecasting and advanced analytics solutions that improve understanding of performance drivers and future growth opportunities. Champion data-led ways of working by improving access to insights, driving adoption of self-service analytics and leveraging AI-enabled tools to support smarter decision-making. 

What You'll Bring

Experience in an eCommerce, retail or digital environment, with a strong understanding of the drivers behind sales, conversion and commercial performance. Strong digital analytics capability, including customer behaviour analysis, segmentation, journey analysis, funnel analysis and performance reporting. Advanced experience with analytical and visualisation tools such as GA4, SQL, Power BI, Looker and Excel. Experience delivering end-to-end analysis, translating complex data into clear insights and actionable commercial recommendations. Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation and performance measurement, including assessing impact, return on investment and optimisation opportunities. Strong commercial awareness, with exposure to decisions such as pricing, promotions, stock or investment prioritisation linked to measurable outcomes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, build alignment and tell compelling stories through data. 

How You Will Make An Impact

Enable faster, more confident decision-making by providing clear, trusted insight that helps teams understand opportunities, risks and the actions that will deliver the greatest commercial and customer impact. Help shape the priorities of Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams by bringing clarity to complex performance challenges and identifying the initiatives most likely to improve sales, conversion and customer outcomes. Turn customer, commercial and digital insights into tangible actions, ensuring recommendations translate into measurable improvements in business performance. Proactively uncover new growth opportunities and emerging risks, developing data-led hypotheses and recommendations that drive continuous optimisation across the customer journey. Influence key business decisions by combining compelling storytelling with evidence-based insight, building alignment across cross-functional stakeholders and helping teams move from insight to action. Drive a deeper understanding of the factors that influence customer behaviour and business performance, helping the organisation focus investment on the initiatives that generate the strongest returns. Simplify complexity and create clarity from multiple data sources, enabling teams to execute faster, prioritise effectively and make smarter decisions that support sustainable growth. 

Who We Are

You may not have heard of us, but you’ll know our brands! AS Watson is the world’s largest international health and beauty retailer, with over 17,000 stores across 31 markets serving over 5.3 billion customers each year.

From Superdrug, Kruidvat and Watsons to Marionnaud, The Perfume Shop and many more, our brands are loved by customers around the world. Behind them are passionate people who are encouraged to innovate, collaborate and grow.

What You Will Get From Us

Competitive Salary and Bonus Scheme Exclusive Discounts - Enjoy savings across our iconic brands. Holiday entitlement Hybrid Working Model Refer-a-friend schemeLearning and Development Opportunities - Grow your skills with tailored programmes. Mental Health and Wellbeing Support Life Assurance Interest Free Loans

rows.title: Consulting Senior Analyst I
rows.descriptionText:
Job Summary

The Consulting Senior Analyst I will be a key contributor to our consulting practice, bringing expertise in the energy and chemical sectors to deliver insightful market analysis and strategic advice to our clients. Projects will revolve around multiple business lines including energy, feedstocks, olefins, plastics, aromatics, inorganics, syngas, and other materials.

This position requires experienced graduates with a strong background in analytics and market consultancy.

The position is based at our London office and will require working closely with our global team on a regular basis.

About The Team

Dow Jones Energy enables energy and chemical stakeholders around the global to improve operational efficiency and make strategic decisions with deep insights, future outlooks, price discovery and consultation from a celebrated team of subject matter experts. We offer short- and long-term market coverage for more than 200 core building-block chemicals with a full suite of advisory services and top-tier events held around the globe. Our bespoke consulting team has experience from upstream oil, gas, and minerals operations to chemicals, plastics and downstream end-use markets. This rich expertise equips us with a deep understanding of the industry’s most significant challenges, allowing us to collaborate closely and deliver the best solution that fits the needs of our clients. The worldwide chemical and energy industry looks to Dow Jones Energy to guide decisions and help manage risk across the entire value chain.

You Will

Conduct comprehensive research and analysis for consulting projects.Review and analyse market and pricing data from Dow Jones Energy’s internal databases and publications and carry out secondary / desk research as required.Apply deep knowledge of the energy/petrochemical/chemical sector to deliver commercial and techno-economic recommendations.Collaborate with cross-functional consulting and research teams to drive project success.Act as a key team member and lead execution of project specific tasks, ensuring timely delivery and client satisfaction.Assist in preparation of project proposals for the clients.Utilize understanding and expertise in the energy/petrochemical/chemical sector to provide commercial or techno-economic insights to the consulting projects.Contribute to team discussions on various consulting projects as a knowledgeable stakeholder.

You Have

A minimum of B.Sc./B.Eng./B.Tech. degree in chemical engineering or chemistry or equivalent is required.A postgraduate degree in science or business management will be considered as an advantage.Demonstrable f experience in a commercial or techno-economic role in the energy, refining or petrochemical industry or within energy/refining/petrochemical market consultancy is required.Broad understanding of the energy and petrochemicals business, the structure of industry, the production technologies, and economic aspects such as energy and chemical markets and pricing is desirable.Proven track record of analytics and market consultancy work is essential.Strong analytical skills with the ability to conduct thorough research and analysis.Good command of the English language in written and spoken forms.Experience in writing analytical reports is desirable.Excellent communication skills for effective client interaction and team collaboration.Additional language skills are a plus.Proficiency in MS Office suite of programs.

rows.title: Early in Career Development Programme - Associate Customer Account Manager 2027
rows.descriptionText:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Are you a graduate looking to learn all about the Diagnostics Healthcare Industry? Are you passionate about learning how account management can deliver great customer experience? Does it excite you to challenge diverse internal and external stakeholders to ‘do now what patients need next’?

If you’ve replied to these questions in the affirmative, we welcome you to apply for this exciting opportunity ac Associate Customer Account Manager to join our field -based Customer Account Management Team covering Managed Service Contracts across the South region and other geographically appropriate MLS accounts

Today, both patients and healthcare professionals benefit from the wide portfolio that Roche Diagnostics has to offer. This includes pioneering products, services and comprehensive solutions, all of which contribute towards enhancing patient outcomes thus increasing quality of life.

Our customer account management team’s primary focus is to co-create shared business strategies that drive digital adoption, account retention, and sustainable growth. We enable our customers to deliver superior clinical and health-economic outcomes to patients and clinicians while ensuring they receive a superior customer experience aligned with Roche's commercial vision and patient-care goals.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the South Regional Customer Account Manager, through proactive collaboration, you will co-create shared business strategies and build deep, meaningful, long-term commercial relationships within your assigned customer base. Passionate about customer engagement, you will make direct connections between a customer’s business goals and how our product & services suite can contribute to their execution in significant periods of change in the healthcare industry. In practice, you will focus on providing excellent customer experience by optimising and driving operational excellence, supporting the development and growth of the MLS contracts, and managing timely interventions of all the cross-functional teams for our Managed Services.

We will support and develop you to be a key point of contact for the Roche Managed Service Accounts and our third-party partners, you will oversee the customer experience through the entire life cycle in close collaboration with all stakeholders in the cross functional team including sales, marketing, technical services, customer services, finance, and more, as appropriate.

Some steady state example activities include:

Attendance and running of operational, financial and quarterly business meetingsProcessing product additions and Contract Change Notifications (CCN’s)Handling new subcontracts and third party negotiationsUse of the Roche CRM and embedding in the Roche squadsMonitoring customer feedback and championing customer experience

Who you are

You are an energetic Associate Customer Account Manager who will be an advocate for our customers with an emphasis on delivering value with every touch. Passionate about customer experience, you bring proactive collaboration to build deep, meaningful, and long-term commercial relationships while driving account retention, digital adoption, and sustainable growth in alignment with Roche's patient-care goals.

You are a creative and strategic thinker, with a strong sense of personal initiative, who holds the customer at the heart of what you do on a daily basis. You are a recent graduate, educated to degree level or equivalent.

Passionate and resilient about delivering customer promises, you have great communication, and problem-solving skills and these are some of the key attributes you will need to be successful in this role.

Other key skills/knowledge required:

Empathy for our customers, while protecting the interests of our company and its assetsGood numeracy skills (with attention to detail) to interrogate large data set and draw meaningful insights and recommendations (Advanced Excel skills with all round strong Microsoft Office)Excellent ability to perform with a professional demeanor while utilising sound judgment and time management skillsBe passionate about quality customer service. You love helping people, and you constantly strive to provide value with every interaction by delivering excellent internal and external serviceBe organised, ahead of schedule, communicative, and accountable—in short, own your role entirely, while being open to challenge, suggestions, and new ideasStrong listener who can identify problem points and develop clear solutions and process improvements; know how to roll up your sleevesAnalytical and logical ability to understand business workflows and how they map to base application functionality

Investing in you

Roche Diagnostics UK & Ireland is in an exciting phase of growth, where the business is channelling its energy, focus, functions and processes towards enhancing customer and patient experience in the countries it operates in. As the medical diagnostics market-leader in UK & Ireland, the organisation recognises its responsibility to the healthcare system and will continue to remain agile in developing new ways of working, with a growth mindset. We have the courage and passion to keep challenging ourselves to improve what we do and the way we do it.

What this means for you is, not only a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, but also a recognised product training programme and continuous support to build on your knowledge, skills and potential, helping you prepare for the exciting opportunities for further career development.

Application Process

Phase I: CV and Cover Letter Review (Your cover letter should not exceed one page.)

As part of your cover letter, Roche is keen to understand your motivation in applying for this position.

Why Roche : What is your key motivation for applying for this role?Why you: What personal qualities, skills and experience will you bring in relation to what the role will require?

Applications close on Sunday, 18 October 2026. The application process may be extended beyond this date but could close at any point after this time.

Phase II: Video interview: Following your application, you will be informed if you are successful and moved to the next stage of the process which will involve video questions / answers to support your application. Estimated date: November 2026

Phase III: In person assessment centre

You will take part in our full day in person assessment centre at our Roche offices in Burgess Hill, Sussex. Further details will be provided if successfulExpected date: w/c 07 December 2026. The exact date will be provided if successful

Please note: Unfortunately visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Candidates must already hold valid authorisation to work in the UK.

Ready to apply? Go ahead and join us, we are waiting for you! 

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

rows.title: Data Squad Scrum Master
rows.descriptionText:
Data Squad Scrum Master
Location: London | Hybrid (4 Days Onsite per Week)Contract: Contract
We're partnering with a leading organisation undergoing a significant enterprise-wide data transformation to appoint an experienced Data Squad Scrum Master.
This is an excellent opportunity for an agile delivery professional to play a key role in supporting the development of modern data products and analytics capabilities, working within a cross-functional team to drive effective, consistent and high-quality delivery.
We're particularly interested in candidates with experience in technical, data or analytics environments who can facilitate agile delivery, remove blockers and support teams in adopting scalable, product-led ways of working.
The Opportunity
As Data Squad Scrum Master, you'll take responsibility for enabling effective agile delivery within a cross-functional Data squad, ensuring alignment with product priorities, sprint goals and wider transformation objectives.
Working closely with Data Product Owners, Engineers, Analysts, Architects and business stakeholders, you'll facilitate agile ceremonies, manage delivery dependencies and support continuous improvement across the squad.
This is a collaborative, delivery-focused role requiring someone who can balance strong agile facilitation with practical problem-solving, helping teams deliver effectively within a complex data and technology environment.
Key Responsibilities
You'll play a key role in driving successful agile delivery by:Facilitating agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives.Supporting sprint planning, backlog readiness and delivery coordination to ensure alignment with product priorities.Identifying, managing and resolving delivery risks, blockers and dependencies across the squad.Monitoring sprint progress, team capacity and delivery performance to improve predictability and efficiency.Building strong relationships with Product Owners, Engineers, Architects, Governance teams and business stakeholders.Supporting the adoption of agile methodologies, product-led delivery principles and continuous improvement practices.Coordinating dependencies across data platforms, architecture, governance, security and integration teams.Ensuring clear visibility of delivery progress through effective reporting, communication and stakeholder engagement.Supporting adherence to agreed technical, data quality and governance standards across Databricks, Tableau and associated data platforms.Coaching squad members to promote collaboration, accountability and effective agile ways of working.
About You
You will be an experienced Scrum Master or Agile Delivery Lead with a strong understanding of agile methodologies and the ability to support cross-functional teams within complex technical environments.You will also have:Proven experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead or similar role within a technical, data or analytics environment.Strong experience facilitating agile ceremonies and supporting iterative delivery within cross-functional teams.Excellent understanding of agile delivery methodologies, sprint management and product-led delivery models.Experience identifying and resolving delivery risks, dependencies and operational blockers.Strong stakeholder management, communication and facilitation skills.Experience collaborating with engineering, analytics, architecture and business teams.Excellent organisational, coaching and problem-solving capabilities.A proactive, collaborative approach with the ability to support continuous improvement and effective team delivery.
Desirable experience includes:Experience working within cloud-based data and analytics environments, including AWS, Databricks or Lakehouse architectures.Familiarity with Tableau reporting and analytics solutions.Understanding of Data Governance, Data Quality and associated delivery standards.Knowledge of SAP data environments, including SAP BW, Datasphere or S/4HANA.Experience within retail, merchandising, supply chain, planning or customer analytics environments.
Why Apply?
This is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to a major data transformation programme, supporting the delivery of modern data products and helping shape effective agile practices within a collaborative, technology-driven environment.In return, you'll benefit from:Competitive day rate of £650.Hybrid working arrangement based in London.The opportunity to contribute to a high-impact enterprise data transformation programme.Exposure to modern data technologies, including AWS, Databricks and Tableau.Close collaboration with experienced data, engineering and technology professionals.The opportunity to influence agile delivery practices and drive continuous improvement across a cross-functional team.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
By applying you are confirming you are happy to be added to the Addition Solutions mailing list regarding future suitable positions. You can opt out of this at any time simply by contacting one of our consultants.

rows.title: Campaign Monetization Specialist – TikTok Shop (Third Party Associate)
rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
The UK Campaign and marketing team owns major commercial moments across TikTok Shop UK. Within this setup, the Campaign Monetization function is responsible for building scalable monetization models around campaign traffic and merchant demand, ensuring commercial growth is measurable, repeatable, and operationally sustainable.

You will need strong commercial judgment, structured problem solving, and hands-on analytical capability. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment, translating ambiguous business goals into clear monetization plans, and aligning a wide group of stakeholders to deliver measurable Ads and revenue outcomes.

The UK Campaign and marketing team owns major commercial moments across TikTok Shop UK. Within this setup, the Campaign Monetization function is responsible for building scalable monetization models around campaign traffic and merchant demand, ensuring commercial growth is measurable, repeatable, and operationally sustainable.

This role sits at the intersection of campaign strategy, merchant monetization, product capability, and business operations. You will work closely with Platform and Brand Campaigns, Product, Commercial, Industry, Marketing, Data, Finance, and regional stakeholders to turn campaign moments into scalable revenue opportunities.

About the Role
As a Campaign Monetization TPA, you will own the strategy and execution of monetization initiatives across TikTok Shop UK platform campaigns, with a clear focus on campaign monetization scope. This includes building and scaling initiatives such as ShopAds packages, Brand Amplification Programme（BAP), and future monetization programs, while establishing the budget management, ROI attribution, and performance measurement frameworks needed for long-term growth.
You will need strong commercial judgment, structured problem solving, and hands-on analytical capability. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment, translating ambiguous business goals into clear monetization plans, and aligning a wide group of stakeholders to deliver measurable Ads and revenue outcomes.

Responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end monetization strategy for campaign commercial initiatives, turning campaign traffic and merchant demand into scalable revenue opportunities.
- Drive planning and execution for key non-IP monetization programs, including ShopAds package strategy, BAP expansion, and new campaign monetization pilots, from concept design through launch and post-campaign review.
- Build a clear standalone monetization target framework, including revenue goals, ROI measurement, attribution logic, operating cadence, and scale-up criteria.
- Partner with Product and business teams to improve monetization capabilities, increasing package flexibility, merchant applicability, operational efficiency, and overall adoption.
- Define merchant segmentation, value proposition, and GTM approach for monetization programs, and work with commercial and industry teams to improve merchant recruitment, conversion, and retention.
- Establish structured budget governance and spend-efficiency management, including weekly tracking, monthly review, and performance diagnostics across investment, return, and commercial impact.
- Conduct deep-dive analyses on monetization performance, merchant behavior, package uptake, campaign efficiency, and revenue contribution; translate findings into actionable recommendations.
- Build repeatable playbooks, SOPs, and reporting mechanisms, so campaign monetization can scale beyond one-off initiatives and become a durable growth engine.
- Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Campaigns, Commercial, Product, Marketing, Finance, and Data teams to ensure strong execution quality, risk control, and decision transparency.
- Support annual and quarterly planning by shaping monetization roadmap, resourcing needs, success metrics, and business cases for future investments.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- 3+ years of experience in e-commerce, monetization, growth strategy, performance marketing, ads business, revenue operations, consulting, or related internet business functions.
- Proven experience owning complex business initiatives end to end, ideally including monetization programs, campaign commercialization, ad products, seller growth, or platform revenue projects.
- Strong commercial thinking with the ability to connect business goals, merchant incentives, user experience, and platform economics.
- Excellent analytical skills; comfortable using data to size opportunities, define targets, evaluate ROI, and influence decisions. Advanced Excel is required; SQL or equivalent analytical capability is strongly preferred.
- Strong structured problem-solving skills with the ability to turn ambiguous goals into actionable frameworks, operating mechanisms, and clear execution plans.
- Clear communication skills in English, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across local and regional teams.
- Bachelor's degree or above in Business, Economics, Marketing, Finance, Engineering, Data, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in social commerce, marketplace platforms, advertising products, merchant strategy, or campaign monetization.
- Familiarity with the UK e-commerce ecosystem and local merchant or brand landscape.
- Experience building dashboards, attribution frameworks, budget management routines, or operational playbooks for scaled business teams.
- Experience working in high-growth internet companies such as leading e-commerce, marketplace, or digital advertising platforms.
- Demonstrated success working across multiple stakeholders without direct authority in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

Important Note: Please be advised that this job posting is on behalf of a third-party agency. This is a 6-12 month temporary assignment managed by a third-party agency, who will be your employer. While you may be assigned to work at TikTok, you will not be a TikTok employee. All contractual terms, including payroll and benefits, will be handled by a third-party agency. By applying, you agree that the information provided in your application may be processed and retained by TikTok for recruitment purposes and shared with a third-party agency in accordance with TikTok's Applicant Privacy Notice https://lifeattiktok.com/legal/privacy

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

rows.title: Data Science Graduate
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Data Scientist Graduate is a key member of the client-facing Data Science Lab team in the European region. As a Data Scientist, you will be accountable for the development and delivery of analytics-driven strategies and solutions for Visa’s external clients in Europe. In this role, you will work collaboratively with VCA and a multitude of internal functions, their senior leaders, and our clients in promoting an insight-driven culture, creative analytic solutions, and best practices to drive business performance with a clear commercial ‘value’ and measurable ‘return’. Half of your day will involve delivering projects (coding/working with data), and the other half will be dedicated to discussing data requirements and managing internal and external meetings. Please bear in mind that our workload varies tremendously, as each project is very bespoke. Sometimes we might be delivering a CSV file; another time, a predictive machine learning model or segmentation. Whatever the solution is, you will be involved in the end-to-end process, starting from gathering clients’ requirements all the way to delivering actionable insights that enable our clients to make data-driven business decisions.

Principal Responsibilities

Promote the use of data science to solve business challenges for external clients, showcasing creative and impactful solutions.Collaborate with VCA consultants to identify and develop data science opportunities that support business development and revenue growth.Apply predictive modeling and machine learning techniques to improve client outcomes in areas like customer acquisition, retention, and profitability.Analyze VisaNet data to uncover key performance metrics and identify issuer P&L opportunities that drive growth for clients and Visa.Deliver business-centric insights through effective data visualization and storytelling that support strategic decision-making.Engage with internal and external stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into actionable data science solutions.Manage multiple data science projects, ensuring clear scope, methodology, and alignment with client goals and timelines.Develop and execute analytic plans using appropriate statistical and data mining techniques, while maintaining thorough project documentation.Enhance existing solutions by introducing new methodologies, tools, and best practices in the field of data science.Automate processes and stay current with emerging tools, software, and techniques to continuously improve efficiency and innovation.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

What we’re after:

Permanent right to work in the UK, please specify this on your CVGraduating in 2026, ready to start the job on January 2026Graduate/Postgraduate degree (Master’s or Ph.D.) in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Operational Research, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or equivalent experience.Fluent in English.Ability to communicate with impact and interest in working in a consulting-like environment and client-facing project roles.Familiarity with modern distributed systems, including Hadoop, SQL, MLP, and Apache Spark.Familiarity with one or more data analytics/programming tools such as Python.Knowledge of applying predictive modelling and machine learning techniques to problems.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

rows.title: Business Insights Analyst

Why This Role Matters 

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Offline & Online) strategy, to deliver trusted, actionable customer and commercial insight that drives profitable online growth by improving sales, conversion, and decision-making across our Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams. You will create visibility of performance, enable data-led decision-making, improve access to meaningful insights and champion the adoption of self-service analytics across the business. By transforming complex data into clear recommendations, you'll create clarity, enable confident decisions, and drive sustainable growth that shapes how millions of customers experience our brands so we can put a smile on our customers’ faces today and tomorrow.

What You'll Be Doing

Identify and quantify customer and commercial opportunities that drive profitable online growth, helping to improve sales, conversion and customer value across our channels. Deliver trusted customer, trading and performance insights that enable faster, more confident decision-making across the business. Partner closely with Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Analyse customer behaviour, digital journeys and conversion performance to uncover opportunities that enhance the customer experience and remove friction points. Evaluate the effectiveness of promotions, trading initiatives, product enhancements and A/B tests, ensuring investment is focused on the activities that deliver the greatest impact. Develop and evolve reporting, forecasting and advanced analytics solutions that improve understanding of performance drivers and future growth opportunities. Champion data-led ways of working by improving access to insights, driving adoption of self-service analytics and leveraging AI-enabled tools to support smarter decision-making. 

What You'll Bring

Experience in an eCommerce, retail or digital environment, with a strong understanding of the drivers behind sales, conversion and commercial performance. Strong digital analytics capability, including customer behaviour analysis, segmentation, journey analysis, funnel analysis and performance reporting. Advanced experience with analytical and visualisation tools such as GA4, SQL, Power BI, Looker and Excel. Experience delivering end-to-end analysis, translating complex data into clear insights and actionable commercial recommendations. Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation and performance measurement, including assessing impact, return on investment and optimisation opportunities. Strong commercial awareness, with exposure to decisions such as pricing, promotions, stock or investment prioritisation linked to measurable outcomes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, build alignment and tell compelling stories through data. 

How You Will Make An Impact

Enable faster, more confident decision-making by providing clear, trusted insight that helps teams understand opportunities, risks and the actions that will deliver the greatest commercial and customer impact. Help shape the priorities of Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams by bringing clarity to complex performance challenges and identifying the initiatives most likely to improve sales, conversion and customer outcomes. Turn customer, commercial and digital insights into tangible actions, ensuring recommendations translate into measurable improvements in business performance. Proactively uncover new growth opportunities and emerging risks, developing data-led hypotheses and recommendations that drive continuous optimisation across the customer journey. Influence key business decisions by combining compelling storytelling with evidence-based insight, building alignment across cross-functional stakeholders and helping teams move from insight to action. Drive a deeper understanding of the factors that influence customer behaviour and business performance, helping the organisation focus investment on the initiatives that generate the strongest returns. Simplify complexity and create clarity from multiple data sources, enabling teams to execute faster, prioritise effectively and make smarter decisions that support sustainable growth. 

Who We Are

You may not have heard of us, but you’ll know our brands! AS Watson is the world’s largest international health and beauty retailer, with over 17,000 stores across 31 markets serving over 5.3 billion customers each year.

From Superdrug, Kruidvat and Watsons to Marionnaud, The Perfume Shop and many more, our brands are loved by customers around the world. Behind them are passionate people who are encouraged to innovate, collaborate and grow.

Competitive Salary and Bonus Scheme Exclusive Discounts - Enjoy savings across our iconic brands. Holiday entitlement Hybrid Working Model Refer-a-friend schemeLearning and Development Opportunities - Grow your skills with tailored programmes. Ready to revolutionize healthcare, making it faster and more accessible than ever before?

How We Started

Founded in 2013 by Dwayne D’Souza, HeliosX was built on a simple but powerful idea: healthcare should be easier to access, faster to receive, and centred around the individual. From day one, we’ve grown without external funding; scaling profitably through technology, disciplined execution, and deep medical expertise. What started as a challenger idea has become one of the most significant healthcare platforms operating globally today.

Where We Are Now

We’ve earned the trust of millions of people worldwide through category-leading products and well-known brands, including MedExpress, Dermatica, ZipHealth, RocketRX, and Levity. A key driver of our success is vertical integration; we operate our own manufacturing and proprietary products, led by in-house medical teams, researchers, and pharmacists at the top of their fields.

In 2025, HeliosX treated more than 1.7 million patients globally and reached £781m in revenue, representing +337% year-on-year growth and cementing our position as the clear market leader in the UK. That growth translates into real-world outcomes: our weight-loss treatments helped patients lose 8.5 million kilograms of excess weight in 2025 alone, contributing to an estimated 1,300 fewer cardiac events. This is growth with measurable, life-changing impact at scale.

Today, we operate across four international markets, with successful launches in Germany and Canada and continued expansion in the US. We were also recently recognised in the Sunday Times Top 100 fastest-growing tech companies, further validation of both our momentum and our ambition.

Where We’re Going

2026 is another significant year for HeliosX. Our ambition is to surpass £1.1bn in revenue, continue expanding thoughtfully into new international markets and broaden our condition and treatment portfolio. As we scale, we're focused on building the technology, operational excellence and clinical capabilities that will support sustainable long-term growth. Joining HeliosX now means helping shape the systems, teams and products that will define the next chapter of digital healthcare. You'll be solving complex problems at pace, working alongside exceptional people and building products that genuinely improve lives at scale.

There’s never been a more exciting time to join HeliosX. Come be a part of making our dream of easier and faster healthcare a reality!

With over 60 team members located across Hong Kong, the UAE and the UK, dealing daily with queries across our 30+ offices in 23 jurisdictions, we truly embody our team's Global name.

Job Title: IT Analyst

Location: London

Competitive Salary And Benefits

Introduction to role:

Are you ready to turn frontline technology support into a catalyst for better decisions, faster science and ultimately improved patient outcomes? Join us to be the trusted first point of contact for colleagues across the UK, resolving issues quickly and enabling them to get the most from our digital tools and platforms.

In this role, you will provide dependable first- and second-line support across telephone, live chat, service desk, Genius Bar and desk-side channels. You will own incidents through to resolution or effective escalation, support hardware break fix activity, and contribute to IT projects that drive adoption and continuous improvement. You will also help colleagues build confidence with our core platforms by running training sessions and creating simple, practical how-to guides.

From day one, you will be supported to become a platform expert across a wide range of technologies, from CRM and collaboration tools to data cloud and analytics environments. How would you turn a tricky incident into a learning moment that lifts adoption across the business? If you thrive on solving problems, staying calm under pressure and making technology work better for everyone, this is your next step.

Accountabilities

Service Desk Excellence: Provide first- and second-line support via phone, chat, service desk, Genius Bar and desk-side channels to minimise disruption and improve user experience.

Incident Ownership: Diagnose and resolve common IT, device, software, access and connectivity issues; take full ownership through resolution or effective escalation.

Escalation Management: Partner with offshore 2nd line and broader 3rd line teams to escalate underlying or complex issues, ensuring timely, high-quality outcomes.

Platform Enablement: Deliver Level 1 system support for core technology platforms, including data quality checks, user access controls and escalation of data alerts to maintain platform integrity.

Knowledge Creation: Develop clear how-to guides, videos and process documentation; contribute to technical documentation such as process and data flows to raise colleague self-sufficiency.

Training and Adoption: Run targeted training sessions to reinforce best-practice use of tools ahead of business-critical processes, increasing confidence and consistency across teams.

Hardware and Release Support: Support hardware break fix, technology upgrades, releases and deployments to keep colleagues productive and protected.

Data and Access Stewardship: Refresh databases, grant database access and upload tables; help users address common questions such as extracting data from visualisation tools.

Continuous Improvement: Identify recurring issues, suggest improvements and contribute to better ways of working that enhance reliability, speed and user satisfaction.

 Degree-level education in information technology, computer science, engineering or

equivalent relevant experience

connectivity issues

procedures

approaches to improve productivity

Here, technology directly accelerates the discovery and delivery of life-changing medicines. You will work with modern platforms and emerging capabilities—from AI and machine learning to advanced analytics and imaging—alongside experts who bring different disciplines together in the same room to spark bold thinking. rows.title: Business Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Why This Role Matters 

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Offline & Online) strategy, to deliver trusted, actionable customer and commercial insight that drives profitable online growth by improving sales, conversion, and decision-making across our Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams. You will create visibility of performance, enable data-led decision-making, improve access to meaningful insights and champion the adoption of self-service analytics across the business. By transforming complex data into clear recommendations, you'll create clarity, enable confident decisions, and drive sustainable growth that shapes how millions of customers experience our brands so we can put a smile on our customers’ faces today and tomorrow.

What You'll Be Doing

Identify and quantify customer and commercial opportunities that drive profitable online growth, helping to improve sales, conversion and customer value across our channels. Deliver trusted customer, trading and performance insights that enable faster, more confident decision-making across the business. Partner closely with Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Analyse customer behaviour, digital journeys and conversion performance to uncover opportunities that enhance the customer experience and remove friction points. Evaluate the effectiveness of promotions, trading initiatives, product enhancements and A/B tests, ensuring investment is focused on the activities that deliver the greatest impact. Develop and evolve reporting, forecasting and advanced analytics solutions that improve understanding of performance drivers and future growth opportunities. Champion data-led ways of working by improving access to insights, driving adoption of self-service analytics and leveraging AI-enabled tools to support smarter decision-making. 

What You'll Bring

Experience in an eCommerce, retail or digital environment, with a strong understanding of the drivers behind sales, conversion and commercial performance. Strong digital analytics capability, including customer behaviour analysis, segmentation, journey analysis, funnel analysis and performance reporting. Advanced experience with analytical and visualisation tools such as GA4, SQL, Power BI, Looker and Excel. Experience delivering end-to-end analysis, translating complex data into clear insights and actionable commercial recommendations. Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation and performance measurement, including assessing impact, return on investment and optimisation opportunities. Strong commercial awareness, with exposure to decisions such as pricing, promotions, stock or investment prioritisation linked to measurable outcomes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, build alignment and tell compelling stories through data. 

How You Will Make An Impact

Enable faster, more confident decision-making by providing clear, trusted insight that helps teams understand opportunities, risks and the actions that will deliver the greatest commercial and customer impact. Help shape the priorities of Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams by bringing clarity to complex performance challenges and identifying the initiatives most likely to improve sales, conversion and customer outcomes. Turn customer, commercial and digital insights into tangible actions, ensuring recommendations translate into measurable improvements in business performance. Proactively uncover new growth opportunities and emerging risks, developing data-led hypotheses and recommendations that drive continuous optimisation across the customer journey. Influence key business decisions by combining compelling storytelling with evidence-based insight, building alignment across cross-functional stakeholders and helping teams move from insight to action. Drive a deeper understanding of the factors that influence customer behaviour and business performance, helping the organisation focus investment on the initiatives that generate the strongest returns. Simplify complexity and create clarity from multiple data sources, enabling teams to execute faster, prioritise effectively and make smarter decisions that support sustainable growth. 

Who We Are

You may not have heard of us, but you’ll know our brands! AS Watson is the world’s largest international health and beauty retailer, with over 17,000 stores across 31 markets serving over 5.3 billion customers each year.

From Superdrug, Kruidvat and Watsons to Marionnaud, The Perfume Shop and many more, our brands are loved by customers around the world. Behind them are passionate people who are encouraged to innovate, collaborate and grow.

What You Will Get From Us

Competitive Salary and Bonus Scheme Exclusive Discounts - Enjoy savings across our iconic brands. Holiday entitlement Hybrid Working Model Refer-a-friend schemeLearning and Development Opportunities - Grow your skills with tailored programmes. Mental Health and Wellbeing Support Life Assurance Interest Free Loans

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

THIS ROLE IS BASED IN BANGKOK, THAILAND (WITH RELOCATION PROVIDED)

Location: Bangkok, Thailand (*Not open for remote work)

Get to Know our Team:

As part of the Supply Analytics, you will be responsible for identifying new partners and opportunities, cultivating a relationship with them, and working together with them to deliver the best outcome for our end customers. You would also be responsible with managing the day-to-day interaction with the partner and working closely with other teams within Agoda to ensure the partners needs are met.

We design tailored business and product solutions with our partners and help them generate measurable value. Members of our team are empowered and supported to grow their market(s) or accounts. What you’ll Need to Succeed:

Comfortable presenting to senior leadership and C-suite.Experience in conducting A/B testing experimentationStrong experience in finding data insights and provide business recommendation to the businessA hacker’s mindset – the ability to build simple but clever and elegant solutions to new problems within significant resource, operational and time constraints through deep understanding of the business, creative problem solving, and a wide range of expertise in data, analytics, automation, programming, and prototyping.Excellent communicator with superior written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal communication skills.Data driven in both decision making and performance measurement.Extreme comfort in ambiguous, fast-paced environment.Ability to multi-task, prioritize and coordinate resources.

rows.title: Senior Associate Game Ops Manager
rows.descriptionText:
We are looking for a GameOps & MarCom Associate to join our team. This role combines data analysis and customer engagement optimisation with the hands-on execution of CRM communications and campaigns, with an approximately 50/50 split between the two areas.

 Data Analysis & Customer Engagement Optimisation

Use data to help us better understand our users and identify opportunities to improve engagement, monetisation, and overall performance.

You will work with large and complex datasets, supporting the full data journey — from extracting and analysing information to reporting on results and turning insights into practical recommendations. You’ll work closely with the wider team to understand user behaviour, measure the impact of engagement activities, and identify opportunities for optimisation.

 CRM Communications & Campaign Operations

Manage the day-to-day execution of outbound communications to our users, ensuring campaigns are well planned, correctly targeted, thoroughly tested, and aligned with the overall CRM calendar and business priorities.

Working closely with CRM, Marketing, Product, and other teams, you will:

W zależności od stanowiska i lokalizacji możesz być uprawniony(-a) do otrzymywania rocznych premii i świadczeń motywacyjnych, benefitów związanych ze zdrowiem i dobrostanem, płatnego czasu wolnego, programów emerytalnych, ochrony ubezpieczeniowej oraz innych lokalnych lub ustawowych świadczeń.

Location: London, UK

Working pattern: Full-time, on-site

Focus: UK projects, with exposure across the global BW ESS portfolio

About BW ESS

BW ESS is a global energy storage owner-operator, moving with speed to develop, deliver and operate market-leading projects. The business is active in the UK, Australia, Italy, Germany, Spain and Sweden. It has more than 540MWh of operating Battery Energy Storage Systems, with approximately 12GWh under construction and a development pipeline of several gigawatts.

Part of BW Group, BW ESS builds on decades of global infrastructure experience, takes a long-term view of projects and partnerships, and focuses on unlocking value throughout the energy storage asset lifecycle.

To find out more, visit: https://bw-ess.com/

How We Work

Our culture rests on a few clear foundations: talent density over team size, flexible people over fixed structures, context over control, results over processes, and transparent, clear feedback. We move fast, give people real ownership early, and expect strong judgement and accountability in return.

The Role

As Analyst, you will support the commercial, investment and development activity behind BW ESS’s UK BESS projects. The work spans financial modelling, project and market analysis, investment materials, and direct support to live negotiations.

Your focus will be the UK, but you will also have the opportunity to work across the wider BW ESS footprint.

What You’ll Do

Financial modelling and investment analysis. Build and maintain project models; assess valuations, returns, sensitivities and risks.Project and market assessment. Evaluate project feasibility and performance across commercial, technical, regulatory and market dimensions, while building a strong understanding of the UK power market.Reporting and presentations. Produce clear, high-quality analysis, reports and presentations, turning complex data into decision-ready recommendations.Commercial support. Support commercial negotiation activity with development partners, key suppliers, financial institutions, and technical, legal and market advisors.Stakeholder collaboration. Work with internal and external stakeholders to analyse project performance, identify areas for improvement, and provide recommendations for strategic decision-making.

What You’ll Bring

Background in investment banking, consultancy, infrastructure, energy, project finance or a similarly analytical commercial environment Strong analytical and problem-solving ability Data analysis, financial modelling and report preparation skills Strong proficiency with AI tools and a clear interest in using them responsibly and effectively Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint Knowledge of project finance and investment analysis Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment Entrepreneurial, hands-on and can-do mindset Experience or demonstrated interest in energy, renewable energy, infrastructure or power markets Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience, in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business, Mathematics or a related field 

Nice to have: Exposure to BESS, power markets or infrastructure transactions; experience in the UK market.

Why Join

You’ll work on some of the largest energy storage assets being built today, with visibility across the full asset lifecycle. The mandate is large and the scope for impact and progression is real.

Equal Opportunity

rows.title: Business Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Why This Role Matters 

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Offline & Online) strategy, to deliver trusted, actionable customer and commercial insight that drives profitable online growth by improving sales, conversion, and decision-making across our Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams. You will create visibility of performance, enable data-led decision-making, improve access to meaningful insights and champion the adoption of self-service analytics across the business. By transforming complex data into clear recommendations, you'll create clarity, enable confident decisions, and drive sustainable growth that shapes how millions of customers experience our brands so we can put a smile on our customers’ faces today and tomorrow.

What You'll Be Doing

Identify and quantify customer and commercial opportunities that drive profitable online growth, helping to improve sales, conversion and customer value across our channels. Deliver trusted customer, trading and performance insights that enable faster, more confident decision-making across the business. Partner closely with Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Analyse customer behaviour, digital journeys and conversion performance to uncover opportunities that enhance the customer experience and remove friction points. Evaluate the effectiveness of promotions, trading initiatives, product enhancements and A/B tests, ensuring investment is focused on the activities that deliver the greatest impact. Develop and evolve reporting, forecasting and advanced analytics solutions that improve understanding of performance drivers and future growth opportunities. Champion data-led ways of working by improving access to insights, driving adoption of self-service analytics and leveraging AI-enabled tools to support smarter decision-making. 

What You'll Bring

Experience in an eCommerce, retail or digital environment, with a strong understanding of the drivers behind sales, conversion and commercial performance. Strong digital analytics capability, including customer behaviour analysis, segmentation, journey analysis, funnel analysis and performance reporting. Advanced experience with analytical and visualisation tools such as GA4, SQL, Power BI, Looker and Excel. Experience delivering end-to-end analysis, translating complex data into clear insights and actionable commercial recommendations. Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation and performance measurement, including assessing impact, return on investment and optimisation opportunities. Strong commercial awareness, with exposure to decisions such as pricing, promotions, stock or investment prioritisation linked to measurable outcomes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, build alignment and tell compelling stories through data. 

How You Will Make An Impact

Enable faster, more confident decision-making by providing clear, trusted insight that helps teams understand opportunities, risks and the actions that will deliver the greatest commercial and customer impact. Help shape the priorities of Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams by bringing clarity to complex performance challenges and identifying the initiatives most likely to improve sales, conversion and customer outcomes. Turn customer, commercial and digital insights into tangible actions, ensuring recommendations translate into measurable improvements in business performance. Proactively uncover new growth opportunities and emerging risks, developing data-led hypotheses and recommendations that drive continuous optimisation across the customer journey. Influence key business decisions by combining compelling storytelling with evidence-based insight, building alignment across cross-functional stakeholders and helping teams move from insight to action. Drive a deeper understanding of the factors that influence customer behaviour and business performance, helping the organisation focus investment on the initiatives that generate the strongest returns. Simplify complexity and create clarity from multiple data sources, enabling teams to execute faster, prioritise effectively and make smarter decisions that support sustainable growth. 

Who We Are

You may not have heard of us, but you’ll know our brands! AS Watson is the world’s largest international health and beauty retailer, with over 17,000 stores across 31 markets serving over 5.3 billion customers each year.

From Superdrug, Kruidvat and Watsons to Marionnaud, The Perfume Shop and many more, our brands are loved by customers around the world. Behind them are passionate people who are encouraged to innovate, collaborate and grow.

What You Will Get From Us

Competitive Salary and Bonus Scheme Exclusive Discounts - Enjoy savings across our iconic brands. Holiday entitlement Hybrid Working Model Refer-a-friend schemeLearning and Development Opportunities - Grow your skills with tailored programmes. Mental Health and Wellbeing Support Life Assurance Interest Free Loans

rows.title: Senior Associate Game Ops Manager
rows.descriptionText:
We are looking for a GameOps & MarCom Associate to join our team. This role combines data analysis and customer engagement optimisation with the hands-on execution of CRM communications and campaigns, with an approximately 50/50 split between the two areas.

 Data Analysis & Customer Engagement Optimisation

Use data to help us better understand our users and identify opportunities to improve engagement, monetisation, and overall performance.

You will work with large and complex datasets, supporting the full data journey — from extracting and analysing information to reporting on results and turning insights into practical recommendations. You’ll work closely with the wider team to understand user behaviour, measure the impact of engagement activities, and identify opportunities for optimisation.

 CRM Communications & Campaign Operations

Manage the day-to-day execution of outbound communications to our users, ensuring campaigns are well planned, correctly targeted, thoroughly tested, and aligned with the overall CRM calendar and business priorities.

Working closely with CRM, Marketing, Product, and other teams, you will:

Plan and coordinate outbound communications in line with the CRM campaign calendar.Set up and launch campaigns and customer journeys within our Customer Engagement Platform.Create and maintain user segments using behavioural, transactional, and demographic data.Manage audience targeting, scheduling, campaign logic, and other configuration requirements.Test and QA campaigns before launch to ensure communications are delivered correctly.Coordinate timelines, dependencies, and requirements with relevant stakeholders.Monitor campaign performance and report on key KPIs and results.Analyse campaign outcomes and identify opportunities to improve engagement, conversion, and monetisation.Maintain clear campaign documentation and help build consistent, scalable processes.Identify opportunities to automate and simplify campaign execution and reporting.Help ensure we are reaching the right users, through the right channels, at the right time.

What We're Looking For

1+ years of work experience as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist, or Marcom Specialist.Extensive expertise in SQL and experience handling large and complex datasets.Proficiency with visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.Strong mathematical and quantitative analysis skills with a passion for numbers and data.Extensive experience with a Customer Engagement Platform, preferably Iterable.Hands-on experience planning and configuring CRM campaigns, journeys, or automated communications.Experience with audience segmentation and targeting using behavioral and transactional data.Understanding of CRM campaign metrics and benchmarks such as open rate, click-through rate, conversion, engagement, retention, and revenue.Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to campaign QA and execution.Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.Excellent communication and collaborator management skills, with the ability to work effectively with CRM, Marketing, Product, and Data teams.Ability to translate business requirements into data-driven audiences, campaigns, and actionable insights.Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and campaign requirements can change quickly.

Opis stanowiska mógł zostać sprawdzony i udoskonalony przy użyciu narzędzi wykorzystujących sztuczną inteligencję w celu poprawy przejrzystości, spójności i inkluzywności. Ostateczna treść, wymagania dotyczące stanowiska oraz decyzje rekrutacyjne podlegają weryfikacji przez człowieka i zatwierdzeniu przez Aristocrat. 

Filozofia wynagradzania

Oferujemy kompleksowy pakiet wynagrodzenia i świadczeń, zaprojektowany tak, aby pozostawać konkurencyjnym na rynku, wspierać dobrostan pracowników oraz doceniać ich wkład w nasz sukces. Nasze podejście opiera się na zasadzie wynagradzania za wyniki, nagradzając indywidualny wpływ i osiągnięcia. Twój indywidualny pakiet wynagrodzenia zostanie określony na podstawie takich czynników jak umiejętności, doświadczenie, kwalifikacje oraz lokalizacja.

W zależności od stanowiska i lokalizacji możesz być uprawniony(-a) do otrzymywania rocznych premii i świadczeń motywacyjnych, benefitów związanych ze zdrowiem i dobrostanem, płatnego czasu wolnego, programów emerytalnych, ochrony ubezpieczeniowej oraz innych lokalnych lub ustawowych świadczeń.

Szczegółowe informacje dotyczące wynagrodzenia i świadczeń dla tego stanowiska zostaną omówione podczas procesu rekrutacyjnego.
