rows.title: Business Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Why This Role Matters 

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Offline & Online) strategy, to deliver trusted, actionable customer and commercial insight that drives profitable online growth by improving sales, conversion, and decision-making across our Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams. You will create visibility of performance, enable data-led decision-making, improve access to meaningful insights and champion the adoption of self-service analytics across the business. By transforming complex data into clear recommendations, you'll create clarity, enable confident decisions, and drive sustainable growth that shapes how millions of customers experience our brands so we can put a smile on our customers’ faces today and tomorrow.

What You'll Be Doing

Identify and quantify customer and commercial opportunities that drive profitable online growth, helping to improve sales, conversion and customer value across our channels. Deliver trusted customer, trading and performance insights that enable faster, more confident decision-making across the business. Partner closely with Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Analyse customer behaviour, digital journeys and conversion performance to uncover opportunities that enhance the customer experience and remove friction points. Evaluate the effectiveness of promotions, trading initiatives, product enhancements and A/B tests, ensuring investment is focused on the activities that deliver the greatest impact. Develop and evolve reporting, forecasting and advanced analytics solutions that improve understanding of performance drivers and future growth opportunities. Champion data-led ways of working by improving access to insights, driving adoption of self-service analytics and leveraging AI-enabled tools to support smarter decision-making. 

What You'll Bring

Experience in an eCommerce, retail or digital environment, with a strong understanding of the drivers behind sales, conversion and commercial performance. Strong digital analytics capability, including customer behaviour analysis, segmentation, journey analysis, funnel analysis and performance reporting. Advanced experience with analytical and visualisation tools such as GA4, SQL, Power BI, Looker and Excel. Experience delivering end-to-end analysis, translating complex data into clear insights and actionable commercial recommendations. Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation and performance measurement, including assessing impact, return on investment and optimisation opportunities. Strong commercial awareness, with exposure to decisions such as pricing, promotions, stock or investment prioritisation linked to measurable outcomes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, build alignment and tell compelling stories through data. 

How You Will Make An Impact

Enable faster, more confident decision-making by providing clear, trusted insight that helps teams understand opportunities, risks and the actions that will deliver the greatest commercial and customer impact. Help shape the priorities of Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams by bringing clarity to complex performance challenges and identifying the initiatives most likely to improve sales, conversion and customer outcomes. Turn customer, commercial and digital insights into tangible actions, ensuring recommendations translate into measurable improvements in business performance. Proactively uncover new growth opportunities and emerging risks, developing data-led hypotheses and recommendations that drive continuous optimisation across the customer journey. Influence key business decisions by combining compelling storytelling with evidence-based insight, building alignment across cross-functional stakeholders and helping teams move from insight to action. Drive a deeper understanding of the factors that influence customer behaviour and business performance, helping the organisation focus investment on the initiatives that generate the strongest returns. Simplify complexity and create clarity from multiple data sources, enabling teams to execute faster, prioritise effectively and make smarter decisions that support sustainable growth. 

Who We Are

You may not have heard of us, but you’ll know our brands! AS Watson is the world’s largest international health and beauty retailer, with over 17,000 stores across 31 markets serving over 5.3 billion customers each year.

From Superdrug, Kruidvat and Watsons to Marionnaud, The Perfume Shop and many more, our brands are loved by customers around the world. Behind them are passionate people who are encouraged to innovate, collaborate and grow.

What You Will Get From Us

Competitive Salary and Bonus Scheme Exclusive Discounts - Enjoy savings across our iconic brands. Holiday entitlement Hybrid Working Model Refer-a-friend schemeLearning and Development Opportunities - Grow your skills with tailored programmes. Mental Health and Wellbeing Support Life Assurance Interest Free Loans

rows.title: Championships Development Programme 2027
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

We are excited to launch The AELTC's Championships Development Programme 2027. We are committed to creating more entry level roles in the sports and events industry and offering exposure to the internal workings of delivering a world-leading sports event. We have opportunities available in a wide range of business areas including Operations, Recruitment, Estate, Marketing & Commercial, Technology and many more. Throughout the business we are passionate about creating an outstanding experience for our members, employees, year-round guests, and everyone who visits The Championships. So, if you share our passion and have a guest-focused approach, we'd love to hear from you.

The programme will start on Wednesday 03 February 2026 for a fixed period working on a full-time basis Monday to Friday with occasional weekends and longer working hours during The Championships (28 June 2027 - 11 July 2027). You can find more information about each role below, listed by Department. If shortlisted, you will be invited to attend an in person Assessment Centre at The AELTC on Tuesday 17 November or Wednesday 18 November. Please note, at this time we will not be facilitating online interviews, so if you are unable to attend an on-site Assessment Centre, your application will not be shortlisted. This vacancy will close on Sunday 25 October and we will not accept any late applications.

What Are We Looking For?

Applicants must be 18 years or older and have the right to work in the UK (without the requirement for sponsorship) Enthusiasm and a positive attitude, with a strong willingness to learn and grow Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence in engaging with others Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and Word Strong numeracy skills and a high level of accuracy in data entry A commitment to upholding our core values of Heritage, Integrity, Respect, and Excellence The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team - flexibility is key, as our roles may involve remote work from home as well as on-site work at Wimbledon These roles are open to all individuals, and you do not need to be an undergraduate to apply 

What we offer

At Wimbledon, we're proud to have a work environment that's shaped by our heritage and commitment to excellence. This extends to ensuring every colleague feels part of something truly special. We're committed to supporting your well-being, personal growth and life beyond work. You'll also gain access to some uniquely Wimbledon experiences and the opportunity to be part of a world-renowned sporting event.

Financial Wellbeing

A salary of £26,936 (pro-rata) which will increase in line with the new London Living Wage announcementAn annual leave entitlement which will vary depending on contract lengthPension scheme with employer contributions up to 10.5%Paid overtime during the lead-up to and throughout The Championships

Physical Health & Mental Wellbeing

24/7 Employee Assistance ProgrammeOn‑site gym and fitness facilitiesTrained Mental Health First AidersProfessional & Personal Development, including a colleague development calendar

Exclusively Wimbledon

Free daily lunchComplimentary Championships ticketsRetail discounts, complimentary museum and tour tickets for friends and familyMatched charitable givingFree Community Sports Centre membershipA programme of social and sporting activities

Entry Level Roles Available Club Department

Club Office Assistant (February to September)

In this role you will work in the Club Office team to provide an excellent service to our Members. You will support both the Membership & Communications Manager and the Events Manager with Club Office administration and reception duties: weekly newsletters, updating noticeboards, preparing gifts, answering the phones, managing the Club Office email inbox, making name badges, preparing tickets and organising food and drink bookings. You will assist with the planning and delivery of social events as well as two exciting 3-day fixtures after The Championships, welcoming special visitors from around the world.

Estate Department

Energy & Environment Assistant (February to September)

The Energy and Environment team form part of the Estates team at Wimbledon and are responsible for leading the drive for net zero carbon emissions and nature positive outcomes across the organisation. On this journey, we have delivered projects such as the decarbonisation of the Aorangi Building by removing fossil fuel energy sources, wildflower planting across swathes of the estate, and converting kitchens form gas power to renewable electricity. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in corporate energy and environmental sustainability. Key focus points could include supporting energy efficiency projects on our net zero roadmap, facilitating ecological surveys in Wimbledon Park or supporting the sustainability communications strategy and carbon reporting. You'll have the chance to get hands on experience in the field of sustainability, making it an ideal position for those looking to break into or broaden their expertise in the field.

Estate Management Assistant (February to September)

The Estate Management team is responsible for the day-to-day management, maintenance and operation of the Estate’s buildings, assets, and facilities, as well as helping to prepare the grounds and infrastructure for the Championships each year. Behind the scenes, accurate and reliable data plays a vital role in supporting these activities. This role focuses on collecting, verifying, and maintaining estate information, including asset, space, and location records, to help ensure the wider team has access to high-quality data. The successful candidate will carry out surveys across the entire Estate, verify existing data, and update records to keep information accurate, up to date and fit for purpose.

Finance Department

Debenture Office Assistant (February to July)

This placement will support the team who are responsible for managing the relationships with debenture holders, one of our most premium guest groups. This guest group own debenture tickets for Centre Court and/or No.1 Court and have access to exclusive areas during The Championships. The team provide a range of services to these high-net worth individuals throughout the year and during The Championships. You will play an important part in delivering a world-class guest experience to them. This will involve connecting with them by phone and email to resolve their queries, supporting on a range of administrative tasks, maintaining records on databases, creating web and communications copy, assisting with planning engaging debenture host training sessions and supporting with the organisation of three large scale events outside of The Championships. You will have strong attention to detail, confidently thrive in guest facing situations, have strong communication skills and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment.

People & Culture Department

Recruitment Assistant (February to July)

In our People & Culture department the Recruitment Team provide a proactive recruitment administration service to attract, develop and retain the best possible talent to support the delivery of The Championships. We employ over 2,100 temporary colleagues each year and in this position you will provide administrative support for the recruitment campaign. This will include assisting with the smooth running of the Assessment Centres, recording right to work documents, monitoring and responding to emails, issuing contracts of employment, following system procedures to onboard new employees, uploading data for accreditation, and collating timesheets and recording hours.

Marketing & Commercial Department

eCommerce Assistant (February to July)

The Wimbledon Shop is a multi-channel retail business serving customers both on-site and around the world through our online shop. As part of the Retail, Merchandise & Licensing team, you'll play a key role in supporting the delivery of a best-in-class eCommerce experience for Wimbledon fans globally. This hands-on role offers a unique opportunity to gain experience in digital retail, online merchandising, customer experience, commercial reporting and product launches. You'll support the team through the build-up to The Championships, the event itself and post-event activity, working across a variety of projects that contribute directly to the success of one of the world's most iconic sporting brands.

Guest Research Assistant (February to August)

The need to understand the behaviours and attitudes of our different audiences year-round, during The Championships, and as global digital guests, has never been more important and this is a great opportunity to see how understanding more about our global audiences affects change across the business. You will support the guest data and insights team with the build, delivery and analysis of all guest insights, building surveys within a survey platform, conducting insight reports and analysing statistics and commentary to generate bespoke reports. We are looking for a data-driven candidate with an interest in analysing and interpreting data and trends.

Partnerships & Hospitality Assistant (February to August)

Reporting to the Hospitality Manager and Partnerships Manager, you will support the planning and delivery of both our Hospitality and Official Partner programmes in the lead-up to and during The Championships. You will assist with a range of operational, administrative and event delivery activities, including supporting partner events and activations, coordinating meetings and site visits, managing accreditation and access requirements, and helping deliver a best-in-class hospitality experience. During The Championships, you will work closely with clients, partners, suppliers and internal teams, supporting on-site operations and helping to ensure the successful delivery of both our Hospitality and Official Partner programmes. You should be highly organised, proactive and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

Retail Operations Assistant (February to July)

The Wimbledon Shop is a high-performing retail operation, running four major outlets and ten express shops across the grounds during The Championships and Qualifying. As part of the retail product and operations team, you’ll play a vital role in delivering a world-class retail experience to hundreds of thousands of visitors. This is a hands-on, fast-paced role that offers a unique opportunity to gain experience in large-scale retail operations, logistics, and event delivery. You’ll support the wider retail team through the build-up, live event, and post-Championships wrap-up, working alongside a temporary workforce of over 300 colleagues.

Technology Department

Technology, Data & AI Assistant (February to July)

The Technology, Data & AI Assistant is a development role designed to provide an early-career opportunity to gain practical experience of technology operations, data analysis and AI-enabled ways of working within a world-class sporting organisation.

Based within the Technology Services team, the role will support the delivery of technology services across the main site, whilst gaining exposure to a broad range of technology disciplines. The role will contribute to technology operations throughout the year and play a supporting role in preparations for and delivery of The Championships. This role will provide hands-on experience of how technology supports business operations, digital services, data-driven decision making and major event delivery, while developing transferable skills in communication, analysis, problem solving and stakeholder engagement.

Operations Department

Museum Collections Assistant (February to August)

The Museum & Collections team is responsible for the historic collection held by Wimbledon Lawn Tennis Museum. The collection consists of over one million items that tell the story of lawn tennis and The Championships. The purpose of this role is to support the Museum & Collections team to create access to the historic collection through collections care and documentation. This position will include cataloging items on our collections management system, carrying out collections research to improve incomplete documentation, and ensuring items are stored in appropriate way. During The Championships, you will assist with processing items collected to represent that year’s tournament. Through this role you will have an opportunity to develop excellent knowledge of museum documentation and collections management.

Operations Assistant (February to July)

The Operations Assistant will be brilliantly placed to get a holistic overview of the Operations department, and will help provide practical, administrative and coordination support to Venue Operations, Guest Experience, and Food & Drink teams, to support them to run smoothly and efficiently. The role will support day-to-day operational activity, maintain accurate information, coordinate internal processes, and act as a reliable point of contact for colleagues, suppliers, and stakeholders. The role offers a fantastic opportunity to develop a broad understanding of a world-class operations environment, gain exposure to multiple areas of the business, and build strong organisational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

rows.title: baringa.ai Fellowship
rows.descriptionText:
About Baringa

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Introducing the baringa.ai Fellowship - A selective cohort for exceptional postgraduate talent.

At Baringa, we blend technical expertise with real-world insight to make an impact. Work with experienced engineers and experts on real client challenges from day one. We seek curious, technically skilled individuals who simplify complex ideas, whether from study, research, or hands-on work. Join a small group of top talent, grow with experts, and build a career in AI.

We’re looking for people talented individuals who have recently completed their Masters or PhD, who want to take their technical depth and apply it to interesting and cutting edge challenges. You don't have to come from a traditional consulting background - because this is not a traditional consulting role! We expect that you might have spent time in research, built something outside your studies, or developed deep expertise in a particular area. What matters most is how you think, what you can do, and how quickly you can turn that into something useful.

Join a small cohort built around exceptional technical talent, with the chance to grow together and make an impact. You’ll work on challenging problems, learn from people at the top of their field and build a career at the forefront of AI.

Who We're Looking For

We're Particularly Interested In Postgraduate Talent With Backgrounds In

Computer Science, Maths, Physics, Engineering, Statistics and related STEM disciplines Machine learning, Artificial Intelligence, data science, software or systems engineering Research, modelling or computational work Strong coding ability Industrial placements, fellowships or substantial technical projects 

You don't need to have followed a traditional consulting path. We care about technical depth, curiosity, judgement and your potential to grow.

What You'll Get

Technical depth Work on challenging problems alongside people who are experts in their fields. Real-world application Apply your skills to live client challenges and see the impact of your work. Support and mentorship Learn from experienced engineers, consultants and subject matter experts. Accelerated development Build technical, consulting and commercial skills through the work you take on. Progression Your level and progression are based on what you demonstrate, not how long you've been working. 

The Cohort

We recruit a small group of Fellows each quarter, typically up to 5 people per intake.

The cohort gives you a group of peers from day one, and gives us a regular way to bring exceptional technical talent into Baringa. It sits between traditional Early Careers and experienced hiring: you don't need years of experience, but you do need the technical depth to contribute from the start.

How To Join

 Apply - Tell us about your background, technical interests and the work you’re proud of.Technical assessment - A focused assessment designed to understand how you approach technical problems, not just what you already know. Meet the team - An assessment day with people from our AI team to explore your technical thinking, consulting potential and fit. Join the cohort - Successful candidates join the next available quarterly intake. 

What a career at Baringa will give you

Putting People First.

Benefits

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include:

Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this.

Using business as a force for good.

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

Baringa Privacy Notices

For UK & EU

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our UK Recruitment Privacy Notice / EU Recruitment Privacy Notice, to evaluate your application and meet our legal and reporting obligations. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. For more information, please contact us at privacy@baringa.com

For the USA

Your personal data may be retained by Baringa for up to two years, as outlined in our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to support the recruitment process and internal reporting requirements. Where applicable, and in accordance with relevant federal and state laws, you may have the right to request access to or correction of your personal information. For further details, please contact privacy@baringa.com

For Australia & Singapore

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to assess your application and meet applicable reporting and legal obligations. In line with the Australian Privacy Act and Singapore’s Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA), you may have rights to access, correct, or request limited deletion of your personal data. For more information, please contact us at privacy@baringa.com

rows.title: Assistant Clinical Psychologist
rows.descriptionText:
To support and enhance the professional psychological care of clients within the 16-17 year old integrated service at Greenwich Time To Talk. Including, providing psychological assessment and low-intensity psychological interventions under the supervision of a qualified professional psychologist.

The postholder will work independently according to a plan agreed with a qualified psychologist and within the overall framework of the team’s policies and procedures.

They will assist with clinically related administration, conduct audits, collect statistics, and support service related research/projects.

To undertake protocol based psychological assessments applying psychological theory, including self-report measures, rating scales, direct scales, direct and indirect, structured observations and semi-structured interviews with clients, family members and others involved in the client’s care, under the supervision of a qualified professional psychologist.To assist in the formulation and delivery of care plans involving the psychological treatment and/or management of a client’s problems, under the supervision of a qualified professional psychologist, in the community.To assist in the co-ordination and running of therapeutic groups or clinical projects.To support audit and service development.To increase awareness and access to the 16-17 integrated service at Greenwich Time To Talk.

Oxleas offers a wide range of NHS healthcare services to people in community and secure environment settings. Our services include community health care such as district nursing and speech and language therapy, care for people with learning disabilities and mental health care such as psychiatry, nursing and therapies. Our multidisciplinary teams look after people of all ages and we work in close partnership with other parts of the NHS, local councils and the voluntary sector and through our new provider collaboratives. rows.title: UK Government and Public Services Researchers
rows.descriptionText:
Help make government work better for the people of the UK – join the Institute for Government.
Two roles available now to join the Institute for Government.
The UK Government team specialises in understanding how Whitehall, Westminster and the civil service – and the people therein – work. We develop rigorous innovative recommendations and programmes to improve these parts of the state. To do this, we work closely with ministers, MPs, special advisers and civil servants to inform our research and make the case for change. We are an enthusiastic, motivated team, and bring our diverse experience and perspectives – from digital consultancy to academia and parliament, to the civil service – to our work.
The public services team specialises in understanding the effectiveness of public services across the country as a whole and how and why performance varies in different places. We look at the funding of and demand for public services, and the impact of government policies on their performance and on the workforce that delivers them. We aim to identify examples of good practice, and consider why some innovations have worked and others have not, making recommendations for improvement.
We are looking for people who care about making government work better, and have the experience or expertise and motivation to develop the Institute’s thinking on how we do so.
This is a great opportunity for early-career professionals who understand the policy and political environment and value rigorous research communicated effectively through varied written outputs, media engagement and professional networks.
What you will do
You will play a central role in one of the IfG’s research teams, working with friendly and effective colleagues to help make government work better for the people of the UK.
There are two roles available: one in the UK government team and one in the public services team.
The research teams do a mixture of quantitative, qualitative, desk-based and in-person research, and organise regular panel events, roundtables, workshops and professional development opportunities with politicians, officials and other external experts.
As a researcher you will:
Work to build the Institute’s understanding of how government is performing, and how to make it work better. By leading work on smaller research projects, or leading parts of larger projects alongside colleagues and with support from your team, you will play a core role in the Institute’s research. This will include:
Shaping the Institute’s research programme by helping to develop project proposalsConducting rigorous qualitative and quantitative research and analysis, including literature reviews, background research, interviews with politicians, officials and academics, and undertaking data analysis.Engaging colleagues and stakeholders to develop creative and workable solutions to the challenges the state faces.
Communicate the Institute’s findings in order to help government work better by:
Writing compelling reports, setting out your research and arguments, and making the case for change.Writing and updating the Institute’s explainers to set out how government works.Commenting on the latest developments in government, sharing insights and expertise drawing on your research via social media and short-form videos.Engaging with the media, including TV and radio, to amplify the Institute’s messages and recommendations and discussing project findings.Working with our events team to organise and deliver public events, roundtables, podcasts and other kinds of discussion, and presenting our findings and recommendations in these forums.Developing strong relationships with your stakeholders.
Work collaboratively across the Institute by:
Lending your expertise to colleagues and drawing on their insights and research to contribute to the Institute’s overall mission and in line with our new strategy.Actively contributing to the culture and working health of the Institute. This includes working with our partnerships team to help secure funding for elements of our work, including supporting the development of funding proposals and liaising with partners about funded projects.
What we are looking for
Essential skills and experienceEnthusiasm for the Institute’s mission and understanding of our work.Relevant professional experience, and knowledge of UK politics, public policy, and the workings of government.Collaborative, team-oriented approach with excellent interpersonal skills and an ability to build and develop relationships at all levels.A hands-on, proactive attitude to work, the ability to manage your own workload and deadlines in consultation with colleagues, and a willingness to develop new knowledge and skills and seek help where needed.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to write clearly and persuasively and with strong attention to detail and able to tailor written outputs.A high level of attention to detail, including when producing high-quality work to tight deadlines.
DesirableResearch experience including novel ways of conducting qualitative or quantitative research and evaluation in similar fields.Experience of working with ministers, parliament, special advisers, civil service, devolved and local governments, or frontline public services.
How to applyTo apply, please follow this link: https://app.beapplied.com/apply/d6qejritss . 
Before applyingWe advise all applicants to read the full job pack on our website before applying.

rows.title: Qualitative Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Role Summary

Responsibilities: You will support development of our qualitative service offerings, while working on real-world evidence projects to generate and analyse qualitative data, providing insights into patient, caregiver and healthcare professional experiences. You will also work on projects that involve the detailed analysis and presentation of quantitative primary and secondary data, which are instrumental to the successful uptake of novel therapies Salary: £39,000 per annum Benefits: Discretionary profit share bonuses paid twice per year, hybrid and flexible working options, generous holiday allowance, private medical insurance, critical illness cover, income protection, full funding for external training and moreRole Type: Full-time, permanent Start Date: We are currently recruiting for start dates from January 2027 onwards, and you will be asked to state your availability on your application formApplication Deadlines: Whilst there are no set application deadlines, we strongly recommend applying as early as possible. The role, or particular start dates, may close when suitable candidates are foundLocation: This role is available in our Global Headquarters in Cambridge, as well as our, London, Manchester and Bristol offices

About the role

The Qualitative Analyst will play a central role in delivering and growing qualitative research within our real-world evidence offering. The role combines three areas of work: supporting the design and delivery of qualitative research projects, contributing to a broader range of evidence generation projects, and supporting leadership with growth and development of our qualitative capabilities and service offering across the company.

Qualitative research will be the main focus of the role. This may include developing research materials, conducting and analysing interviews or other qualitative data, and synthesising findings into clear, insightful deliverables. Outputs may include reports, slide sets, posters, manuscripts and other materials tailored to different audiences, helping clients understand patient, caregiver and healthcare professional experiences and use these insights to support evidence generation and decision-making. Alongside this, you will apply your skills flexibly across other evidence generation projects, such as Delphi panels, surveys and literature reviews. This breadth will give you exposure to a wide range of methodologies and disease areas, and an understanding of how qualitative insights complement other forms of evidence.

As one of the first members of our growing qualitative team, you will also have the opportunity to shape how the service develops. This includes sharing your expertise with colleagues through training and upskilling in qualitative methods, and supporting business development activities such as contributing to proposals, scoping new opportunities and helping to communicate the value of qualitative research to clients.

The work is structured on a project-by-project basis, and you will usually contribute to several projects across different disease areas at any one time. You will work in project teams alongside experienced colleagues, who provide one-to-one training in project management and effective client communication, as well as in the wider evidence generation methods used across the team. Delivering project work requires close collaboration with clients and, following a successful induction period, you will increasingly participate in teleconferences and face-to-face meetings with clients and external stakeholders.

Key responsibilities will include:

Developing qualitative research materials and conducting and analysing interviews and other qualitative dataSynthesising qualitative findings into clear, insightful deliverables tailored to different audiences, including reports, slide sets, posters and manuscriptsContributing to other evidence generation projects, including Delphi panels, surveys and literature reviewsSupporting the development of qualitative expertise across the company by training and upskilling colleagues in qualitative methodsSupporting business development for qualitative research, including contributing to proposals and helping to identify and scope new opportunitiesCollaborating closely with clients and external stakeholders, including participating in teleconferences and face-to-face meetingsSupporting project management and client communication while managing several projects across different disease areasWorking with teams across the company to build a broad understanding of our service offerings and how qualitative insights support real-world evidence generation and decision-making

A Day in the Life of an Analyst

To learn more about a typical day for an Analyst at Costello Medical, please click here: Working At Costello Medical | Costello Medical

About Costello Medical

Costello Medical is a rapidly growing global healthcare agency specialising in medical communications, market access and health economic and outcomes research. We work with a wide range of clients, including the industry's most successful pharmaceutical and medical technology companies, patient and public health bodies and charitable organisations. We have been listed on the Top 100 Best Companies to Work For list since 2017, as well as receiving B Corporation Accreditation in 2022. Please click here to learn more about us, our work and our mission: https://www.costellomedical.com/

Requirements

About you

In addition to the specific scientific skills and experience you need to succeed in your role, we have developed a framework that details the key skills, approaches and mindsets that are essential for all Analysts to display in order to excel in their role with us. Embodying these will support your growth and development throughout your career at Costello Medical.

Essential Requirements for this role:

An undergraduate degree level qualification in a scientific discipline (minimum 2.1 or equivalent) in a scientific, health-related or social science discipline. Postgraduate qualifications (minimum 2.1 or equivalent) would be an advantage, but they are not a requirement for the role. We welcome applications from candidates with a diverse range of specialisms, including but not limited to biology, chemistry, pharmacy, medicine, psychology, public health, health sciences and sociologyHands-on experience of conducting qualitative research, including developing research materials such as interview or focus group guides, and conducting interviews or other forms of qualitative data collection, preferably outside of a taught university setting (university sponsored research would be considered relevant)Experience applying qualitative analysis methods, such as thematic analysis, framework analysis or qualitative content analysis, to interpret interview and other qualitative dataAn aptitude for, and experience of, planning and writing scientific documents, which could include lab reports, dissertations, poster or oral presentations, articles for websites or student magazines, peer-reviewed scientific publications, book chapters, grant applications, and regulatory documentsA flexible approach to work, with a willingness to apply your skills to other evidence generation (including quantitative and mixed-methods projects) An ability to share your qualitative expertise with others, for example by training, mentoring or supporting colleagues who are new to qualitative methodsAn interest in contributing to the growth of a new service area, including supporting business development activities such as proposal writing and communicating the value of qualitative research to clientsA self-motivated and enthusiastic approach, with a genuine interest in healthcare and an eagerness to learn and develop your skillsAn exceptional level of attention to detailStrong analytical skillsExcellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage your time to work across multiple projects at the same time and prioritise tasks appropriately to maximise productivityExceptional written English, which you will use in client work, email communication and internal messagingEffective verbal communication skills, which you will use when working with colleagues and clients, and when engaging with research participantsThe ability to tailor your communication style to a variety of audiences, including patients and caregivers, healthcare professionals, patient groups, suppliers, clients, non-scientific colleagues and governmental bodiesA proactive mindset, including the ability to recognise challenges and suggest solutions with limited guidanceA collaborative approach to working, where you share knowledge with others in your team to promote the attainment of a common objective, and work together to overcome obstacles to successThe self-awareness to reflect on your own work and performance, alongside a willingness to take ownership of your work and the development of your careerA willingness to get involved with, and contribute to, your wider teamEmbodying Costello Medical's values, which includes being committed to delivering quality work, championing innovation in healthcare, acting with integrity and supporting your colleagues as they would support youFluency in NVivo (or other qualitative analysis software), Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint

Benefits

What we offer

Alongside our award-winning company culture, where every team member is celebrated, respected, and has their voice heard, we are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package which includes:

A starting salary of £39,000 per annum, as well as a discretionary profit share bonus paid twice per year. Please note that we have established salary bands that ensures a fair and consistent approach for all applicants, eliminating the need for individual negotiations25 days' annual leave plus bank and public holidays, as well as a holiday buy and sell schemeFlexible working hours and the chance to work from home for up to half of your working time after passing probationFlexible benefits scheme offering cash payments, additional pension contributions and morePrivate Medical Insurance which offers comprehensive cover on a "medical history disregard" basisPaid study leave and funding for external qualificationsCritical Illness Cover, Income Protection and Life AssurancePaid and unpaid sabbaticals based on length of service

Please click here to learn about our full reward package and the other benefits of working for Costello Medical: https://www.costellomedical.com/careers/benefits-package-in-the-uk/

Hybrid Working Policy: We believe that having face-to-face time in the office holds many benefits and is central to ensuring that the community we have created, where people have a workplace, they belong to and feel part of, is never lost. At the same time, we recognise that homeworking can improve work life balance, reduce commuting times and costs, and provide the opportunity to juggle personal commitments.

Therefore, we offer flexible working arrangements that allow our colleagues who have passed probation to work from home for up to half of the time, measured across a 2-week rolling period. During your probationary period (normally the first 6 months of the role), you will be able to work from home for 1 day per week.

The Application Process

You are required to submit your CV and a cover letter via our online application form. In your cover letter, you must explain why you think you would be suited to the role and why you would like to join Costello Medical, with examples to support both. Your CV should clearly state the dates of all qualifications and grades achieved where applicable.

Then, our recruitment process includes a proofreading and written assessment for you to complete in your own time. If successful, you will be invited to an interview which will include a short presentation you can prepare for in advance.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce and, throughout the recruitment process, there are a number of reasonable adjustments we can provide. Please click here to learn more.

Please note that, whilst we embrace AI to innovate and improve processes, your role may involve confidential data that cannot be uploaded to AI. Therefore, it is important for us to assess your own skills and abilities, so we recommend that you do not rely solely on this technology to generate any application materials.

Visa Sponsorship

Due to the Skilled Worker visa regulations, you will only be eligible for visa sponsorship if you meet at least one of the following criteria:

You are classified as a New Entrant. This means you are under the age of 26, currently studying in the UK or a recent graduate in the UK (Please read more about the New Entrant criteria: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/skilled-worker-visa-caseworker-guidance/skilled-worker-caseworker-guidance-accessible#bookmark63)You have a PhD in a STEM subject You have a PhD in a subject that is relevant to the Qualitative Analyst role 

You will be asked to provide details of your right to work in the UK within your application, which will be used to help assess your eligibility for visa sponsorship.

Please check the following link to read more about the criteria on the UK government website: https://www.gov.uk/skilled-worker-visa/when-you-can-be-paid-less. Please contact recruitment@costellomedical.com should you have any questions.

rows.descriptionText:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

rows.title: Business Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Why This Role Matters 

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Offline & Online) strategy, to deliver trusted, actionable customer and commercial insight that drives profitable online growth by improving sales, conversion, and decision-making across our Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams. You will create visibility of performance, enable data-led decision-making, improve access to meaningful insights and champion the adoption of self-service analytics across the business. By transforming complex data into clear recommendations, you'll create clarity, enable confident decisions, and drive sustainable growth that shapes how millions of customers experience our brands so we can put a smile on our customers’ faces today and tomorrow.

What You'll Be Doing

Identify and quantify customer and commercial opportunities that drive profitable online growth, helping to improve sales, conversion and customer value across our channels. Deliver trusted customer, trading and performance insights that enable faster, more confident decision-making across the business. Partner closely with Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Analyse customer behaviour, digital journeys and conversion performance to uncover opportunities that enhance the customer experience and remove friction points. Evaluate the effectiveness of promotions, trading initiatives, product enhancements and A/B tests, ensuring investment is focused on the activities that deliver the greatest impact. Develop and evolve reporting, forecasting and advanced analytics solutions that improve understanding of performance drivers and future growth opportunities. Champion data-led ways of working by improving access to insights, driving adoption of self-service analytics and leveraging AI-enabled tools to support smarter decision-making. 

What You'll Bring

Experience in an eCommerce, retail or digital environment, with a strong understanding of the drivers behind sales, conversion and commercial performance. Strong digital analytics capability, including customer behaviour analysis, segmentation, journey analysis, funnel analysis and performance reporting. Advanced experience with analytical and visualisation tools such as GA4, SQL, Power BI, Looker and Excel. Experience delivering end-to-end analysis, translating complex data into clear insights and actionable commercial recommendations. Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation and performance measurement, including assessing impact, return on investment and optimisation opportunities. Strong commercial awareness, with exposure to decisions such as pricing, promotions, stock or investment prioritisation linked to measurable outcomes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, build alignment and tell compelling stories through data. 

How You Will Make An Impact

Enable faster, more confident decision-making by providing clear, trusted insight that helps teams understand opportunities, risks and the actions that will deliver the greatest commercial and customer impact. Help shape the priorities of Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams by bringing clarity to complex performance challenges and identifying the initiatives most likely to improve sales, conversion and customer outcomes. Turn customer, commercial and digital insights into tangible actions, ensuring recommendations translate into measurable improvements in business performance. Proactively uncover new growth opportunities and emerging risks, developing data-led hypotheses and recommendations that drive continuous optimisation across the customer journey. Influence key business decisions by combining compelling storytelling with evidence-based insight, building alignment across cross-functional stakeholders and helping teams move from insight to action. Drive a deeper understanding of the factors that influence customer behaviour and business performance, helping the organisation focus investment on the initiatives that generate the strongest returns. Simplify complexity and create clarity from multiple data sources, enabling teams to execute faster, prioritise effectively and make smarter decisions that support sustainable growth. 

Who We Are

You may not have heard of us, but you’ll know our brands! AS Watson is the world’s largest international health and beauty retailer, with over 17,000 stores across 31 markets serving over 5.3 billion customers each year.

From Superdrug, Kruidvat and Watsons to Marionnaud, The Perfume Shop and many more, our brands are loved by customers around the world. Behind them are passionate people who are encouraged to innovate, collaborate and grow.

What You Will Get From Us

Competitive Salary and Bonus Scheme Exclusive Discounts - Enjoy savings across our iconic brands. Holiday entitlement Hybrid Working Model Refer-a-friend schemeLearning and Development Opportunities - Grow your skills with tailored programmes. Mental Health and Wellbeing Support Life Assurance Interest Free Loans

rows.title: Data Science Graduate
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Data Scientist Graduate is a key member of the client-facing Data Science Lab team in the European region. As a Data Scientist, you will be accountable for the development and delivery of analytics-driven strategies and solutions for Visa’s external clients in Europe. In this role, you will work collaboratively with VCA and a multitude of internal functions, their senior leaders, and our clients in promoting an insight-driven culture, creative analytic solutions, and best practices to drive business performance with a clear commercial ‘value’ and measurable ‘return’. Half of your day will involve delivering projects (coding/working with data), and the other half will be dedicated to discussing data requirements and managing internal and external meetings. Please bear in mind that our workload varies tremendously, as each project is very bespoke. Sometimes we might be delivering a CSV file; another time, a predictive machine learning model or segmentation. Whatever the solution is, you will be involved in the end-to-end process, starting from gathering clients’ requirements all the way to delivering actionable insights that enable our clients to make data-driven business decisions.

Principal Responsibilities

Promote the use of data science to solve business challenges for external clients, showcasing creative and impactful solutions.Collaborate with VCA consultants to identify and develop data science opportunities that support business development and revenue growth.Apply predictive modeling and machine learning techniques to improve client outcomes in areas like customer acquisition, retention, and profitability.Analyze VisaNet data to uncover key performance metrics and identify issuer P&L opportunities that drive growth for clients and Visa.Deliver business-centric insights through effective data visualization and storytelling that support strategic decision-making.Engage with internal and external stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into actionable data science solutions.Manage multiple data science projects, ensuring clear scope, methodology, and alignment with client goals and timelines.Develop and execute analytic plans using appropriate statistical and data mining techniques, while maintaining thorough project documentation.Enhance existing solutions by introducing new methodologies, tools, and best practices in the field of data science.Automate processes and stay current with emerging tools, software, and techniques to continuously improve efficiency and innovation.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

What we’re after:

Permanent right to work in the UK, please specify this on your CVGraduating in 2026, ready to start the job on January 2026Graduate/Postgraduate degree (Master’s or Ph.D.) in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Operational Research, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or equivalent experience.Fluent in English.Ability to communicate with impact and interest in working in a consulting-like environment and client-facing project roles.Familiarity with modern distributed systems, including Hadoop, SQL, MLP, and Apache Spark.Familiarity with one or more data analytics/programming tools such as Python.Knowledge of applying predictive modelling and machine learning techniques to problems.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

rows.title: AI Data Scientist (12 Month Day Rate Contractor)
rows.descriptionText:
Job Introduction

Handelsbanken combines a long-established relationship banking model with secure, resilient, and customer-focused technology. Our technology teams enable the Bank’s decentralised way of working, delivering systems built for stability, trust, and long-term value.

We are on a multi-year technology and digital transformation journey to enhance customer experience and improve how colleagues work together. By modernising platforms, simplifying processes, and better connecting data and systems, we help relationship teams focus on customers and less on complexity.

Our decentralised culture extends to technology. Teams are trusted to take ownership, make informed decisions, and deliver sustainable, high-quality solutions. We value engineering excellence, pragmatic problem-solving, and strong collaboration across technology, business, and risk.

We offer technologists the opportunity to build lasting careers, deepen their expertise, and contribute to meaningful change. We look for people who care about quality, security, long-term impact, and who want to shape the future of a relationship-led bank.

We also recognise that flexibility can support people to perform at their best, and that it looks different for everyone. While arrangements will depend on the requirements of the role and the needs of the business, we are open to having a conversation around what flexibility could look like for you.

Check our Handelsbanken website for further information

The opportunity 

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with data, models, and advanced analytics across the bank. You will develop, deploy, and continuously improve data science and machine learning solutions that support strategic and operational decision-making. You'll explore analytical approaches to complex business challenges, identify opportunities for value creation, and deliver data-driven insights that drive business outcomes.

Working across the full data science lifecycle, from problem definition and exploration through to deployment, monitoring, and evaluation, you'll collaborate closely with stakeholders across the organisation to understand business needs and translate them into effective analytical solutions. You will also play a key role in communicating insights clearly and effectively, ensuring decisions are grounded in robust analysis and evidence.

In this role, you'll have the freedom to investigate new analytical questions, the support of experienced colleagues, and opportunities to experiment with emerging tools, techniques, and methodologies in a collaborative and innovative environment.

Key responsibilities

Developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining machine learning and statistical models in production environments. Building scalable data science solutions using Python and SQL. Applying software engineering best practices, including version control (Git), code reviews, testing, and documentation. Using MLOps practices to support model deployment, monitoring, governance, and continuous improvement. Working with large and complex datasets Evaluating emerging technologies and analytical techniques to identify opportunities for innovation and business value. Ensuring models and analytical solutions meet regulatory, governance, and risk management standards within a financial services environment. Contribute to backlog refinement and sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives Reinforce Agile ways of working, using pair programming, DORA insights and best practices to help to foster an environment of continuous improvement within the team 

What we’re looking for

Research (by Harvard University) shows that women are particularly likely to second guess themselves and not apply - so if you are worried you don't meet all the criteria, get in touch anyhow and let us do the worrying…

Strong practical knowledge of statistics, mathematics, and machine learning techniques, with experience developing, validating, deploying, and monitoring predictive and analytical models in production environments.Advanced Python and SQL skills, with experience using tools such as Jupyter/JupyterHub to conduct data exploration, develop machine learning solutions, and support production workflows.Hands-on experience applying machine learning techniques using frameworks such as XGBoost, PyTorch, or similar technologies to solve complex business problems and deliver measurable value. Experience translating business requirements into actionable analytical solutions, working closely with stakeholders to identify opportunities, define approaches, and deliver data-driven outcomes.Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience working with modern data platforms, software engineering best practices, and data science tooling to develop scalable and maintainable analytical solutions. Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or other emerging AI technologies is advantageous. 

Why join Handelsbanken

We want everyone at Handelsbanken to feel supported, motivated, and able to do great work. That’s why, alongside brilliant colleagues, meaningful work and training and development opportunities, we provide a variety of benefits designed with your wellbeing in mind.

In addition, there is a flexible benefits package with the key highlights detailed below.

Application next steps

Your journey with us begins once you have submitted your application. One of our Handelsbanken Talent Acquisition Partners will be reviewing your details and will later organise a phone conversation if your experience aligns with our requirements, we will extend an invitation for you to participate in an interview.

This advert will be live for a minimum of two weeks. However, please note that after the two weeks, the closing date could change at any time depending on the number of responses received.

The Bank is deeply committed to embedding good equality and diversity practice into all of our activities. This is so that we are an inclusive, welcoming and inspiring place to work that encourages everyone to apply, regardless of socio-economic background, age, disability, pregnancy and/or parental status, race (including colour, nationality, and ethnic or national origin), veteran status, marital and civil partnership status, religion or belief, sex, gender reassignment or sexual orientation.

rows.title: Associate Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Description

The opportunity

ICF supports governments and organisations on challenges in areas such as energy, the environment, aviation, health and public policy. Our data science team works with subject matter experts to turn evidence and data into practical solutions for clients in the UK and EU.

You will join an established team and contribute to data science and AI work across varied client projects. Working with more experienced colleagues, you will prepare data, test analytical approaches, help develop prototypes and communicate what the results mean. You will gain exposure to the consulting process, learning how to turn complex client questions into practical analyses and communicate findings to a range of audiences.

What You Will Do

Work with data scientists and subject matter experts to understand project questions, available data and appropriate outputs.Clean, combine and explore datasets, write clear Python and document your assumptions and checks.Build and compare straightforward statistical or machine learning models, use suitable baselines and help evaluate accuracy, limitations and potential bias.Contribute to prototypes using methods suited to the problem, including language models where appropriate, and test outputs carefully before sharing them.Prepare charts, concise written findings and presentation material, explain your work to colleagues and, with support, to clients and subject matter experts.Use feedback and code review to improve your work, and contribute to reproducible project files and team knowledge sharing.

What You Will Bring

Hands-on experience applying data science through a project, research, internship or commercial work.Experience using Python gained through employment, an internship, research or substantial personal or academic projects.A grounding in statistics and common machine learning methods, such as regression or classification, and experience of training, testing and model evaluation.Care with data quality, documentation and clear, reproducible code, willingness to learn version control and collaborative development practices.Curiosity about real client problems, willingness to ask questions and ability to explain your thinking in clear written and spoken English.A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative or social science field.

Useful Additional Experience

Exposure to public policy, government, research or evaluation.Hands-on exploration of large language models, including checking responses against source material, experience with AI agents is welcome but not required.Experience with Git, cloud services, data visualisation, collaborative projects or presenting technical work to a nontechnical audience.

What You Can Expect

You will learn from colleagues with a range of technical and subject expertise while contributing to complex, varied projects. We will support your career development through ongoing training, feedback and opportunities to deepen both your data science and consulting skills. As your experience grows, you will take on more responsibility in shaping and delivering solutions.

About Euromonitor

rows.title: Business Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Why This Role Matters 

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Offline & Online) strategy, to deliver trusted, actionable customer and commercial insight that drives profitable online growth by improving sales, conversion, and decision-making across our Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams. You will create visibility of performance, enable data-led decision-making, improve access to meaningful insights and champion the adoption of self-service analytics across the business. By transforming complex data into clear recommendations, you'll create clarity, enable confident decisions, and drive sustainable growth that shapes how millions of customers experience our brands so we can put a smile on our customers’ faces today and tomorrow.

What You'll Be Doing

Identify and quantify customer and commercial opportunities that drive profitable online growth, helping to improve sales, conversion and customer value across our channels. Deliver trusted customer, trading and performance insights that enable faster, more confident decision-making across the business. Partner closely with Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Analyse customer behaviour, digital journeys and conversion performance to uncover opportunities that enhance the customer experience and remove friction points. Evaluate the effectiveness of promotions, trading initiatives, product enhancements and A/B tests, ensuring investment is focused on the activities that deliver the greatest impact. Develop and evolve reporting, forecasting and advanced analytics solutions that improve understanding of performance drivers and future growth opportunities. Champion data-led ways of working by improving access to insights, driving adoption of self-service analytics and leveraging AI-enabled tools to support smarter decision-making. 

What You'll Bring

Experience in an eCommerce, retail or digital environment, with a strong understanding of the drivers behind sales, conversion and commercial performance. Strong digital analytics capability, including customer behaviour analysis, segmentation, journey analysis, funnel analysis and performance reporting. Advanced experience with analytical and visualisation tools such as GA4, SQL, Power BI, Looker and Excel. Experience delivering end-to-end analysis, translating complex data into clear insights and actionable commercial recommendations. Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation and performance measurement, including assessing impact, return on investment and optimisation opportunities. Strong commercial awareness, with exposure to decisions such as pricing, promotions, stock or investment prioritisation linked to measurable outcomes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, build alignment and tell compelling stories through data. 

How You Will Make An Impact

Enable faster, more confident decision-making by providing clear, trusted insight that helps teams understand opportunities, risks and the actions that will deliver the greatest commercial and customer impact. Help shape the priorities of Trading and Product & Customer Experience teams by bringing clarity to complex performance challenges and identifying the initiatives most likely to improve sales, conversion and customer outcomes. Turn customer, commercial and digital insights into tangible actions, ensuring recommendations translate into measurable improvements in business performance. Proactively uncover new growth opportunities and emerging risks, developing data-led hypotheses and recommendations that drive continuous optimisation across the customer journey. Influence key business decisions by combining compelling storytelling with evidence-based insight, building alignment across cross-functional stakeholders and helping teams move from insight to action. Drive a deeper understanding of the factors that influence customer behaviour and business performance, helping the organisation focus investment on the initiatives that generate the strongest returns. Simplify complexity and create clarity from multiple data sources, enabling teams to execute faster, prioritise effectively and make smarter decisions that support sustainable growth. 

Who We Are

You may not have heard of us, but you’ll know our brands! AS Watson is the world’s largest international health and beauty retailer, with over 17,000 stores across 31 markets serving over 5.3 billion customers each year.

From Superdrug, Kruidvat and Watsons to Marionnaud, The Perfume Shop and many more, our brands are loved by customers around the world. Behind them are passionate people who are encouraged to innovate, collaborate and grow.

What You Will Get From Us

Competitive Salary and Bonus Scheme Exclusive Discounts - Enjoy savings across our iconic brands. Holiday entitlement Hybrid Working Model Refer-a-friend schemeLearning and Development Opportunities - Grow your skills with tailored programmes. Mental Health and Wellbeing Support Life Assurance Interest Free Loans

Job Summary

The Consulting Senior Analyst I will be a key contributor to our consulting practice, bringing expertise in the energy and chemical sectors to deliver insightful market analysis and strategic advice to our clients. Projects will revolve around multiple business lines including energy, feedstocks, olefins, plastics, aromatics, inorganics, syngas, and other materials.

This position requires experienced graduates with a strong background in analytics and market consultancy.

The position is based at our London office and will require working closely with our global team on a regular basis.

About The Team

Dow Jones Energy enables energy and chemical stakeholders around the global to improve operational efficiency and make strategic decisions with deep insights, future outlooks, price discovery and consultation from a celebrated team of subject matter experts. We offer short- and long-term market coverage for more than 200 core building-block chemicals with a full suite of advisory services and top-tier events held around the globe. Our bespoke consulting team has experience from upstream oil, gas, and minerals operations to chemicals, plastics and downstream end-use markets. This rich expertise equips us with a deep understanding of the industry’s most significant challenges, allowing us to collaborate closely and deliver the best solution that fits the needs of our clients. The worldwide chemical and energy industry looks to Dow Jones Energy to guide decisions and help manage risk across the entire value chain.

You Will

Conduct comprehensive research and analysis for consulting projects.Review and analyse market and pricing data from Dow Jones Energy’s internal databases and publications and carry out secondary / desk research as required.Apply deep knowledge of the energy/petrochemical/chemical sector to deliver commercial and techno-economic recommendations.Collaborate with cross-functional consulting and research teams to drive project success.Act as a key team member and lead execution of project specific tasks, ensuring timely delivery and client satisfaction.Assist in preparation of project proposals for the clients.Utilize understanding and expertise in the energy/petrochemical/chemical sector to provide commercial or techno-economic insights to the consulting projects.Contribute to team discussions on various consulting projects as a knowledgeable stakeholder.

You Have

A minimum of B.Sc./B.Eng./B.Tech. degree in chemical engineering or chemistry or equivalent is required.A postgraduate degree in science or business management will be considered as an advantage.Demonstrable f experience in a commercial or techno-economic role in the energy, refining or petrochemical industry or within energy/refining/petrochemical market consultancy is required.Broad understanding of the energy and petrochemicals business, the structure of industry, the production technologies, and economic aspects such as energy and chemical markets and pricing is desirable.Proven track record of analytics and market consultancy work is essential.Strong analytical skills with the ability to conduct thorough research and analysis.Good command of the English language in written and spoken forms.Experience in writing analytical reports is desirable.Excellent communication skills for effective client interaction and team collaboration.Additional language skills are a plus.Proficiency in MS Office suite of programs.

If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application or participating in an interview due to a disability, email us at talentresourceteam@dowjones.com. Please put "Reasonable Accommodation" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. This inbox will not be monitored for application status updates.

Please refer to the privacy notice at the bottom of this page for submitting any data access, deletion, or other data subject rights requests, where permitted under your local laws and regulations.

Dow Jones is a global provider of news and business information, delivering content to consumers and organizations around the world across multiple formats, including print, digital, mobile and live events. Dow Jones has produced unrivaled quality content for more than 130 years and today has one of the world’s largest newsgathering operations globally.

It is home to leading publications and products including the flagship Wall Street Journal, America’s largest newspaper by paid circulation; Barron’s, MarketWatch, Mansion Global, Financial News, Dow Jones Risk & Compliance and Dow Jones Newswires. Dow Jones is a division of News Corp (Nasdaq: NWS, NWSA; ASX: NWS, NWSLV).
