Job Description

Business Unit / Role Specific Info 

Global Merchant & Network Services brings together American Express' merchant and network-related businesses. This includes the management of our relationships across the globe with both the millions of merchants who accept American Express, as well as our partners in countries and territories that deliver card acceptance, issuance and innovation.

The American Express business has two core types of customers. The Card Members that use our cards to make purchases, and the businesses that accept them. In Global Merchant & Network Services, we primarily focus on the businesses that accept our cards. We bring together the businesses that manage and evolve the company’s relationships with the millions of merchants around the world that accept American Express, as well as the team that runs the company’s payment network and manages bank partnerships globally. This is an exciting time for GMNS. We are expanding global acceptance of our cards, driving greater usage of our network, leveraging our modern capabilities to capture broader revenue streams, and driving innovation both in-house and with partners. To put the scale of our global reach in numbers: 

 More than 80 million global locations accept American Express payment products   We operate in 198 countries and territories   We have 140+ million cards in force, that perform 12 billion transactions per year and contribute more than $1.5 trillion in network volume   We have 190+ partners who either issue cards on our network, and/or sign new businesses to accept Amex on our behalf  

The Global Merchant & Network Pricing (GMNP) team is responsible for the single largest source of revenue for American Express: merchant discount revenue. The team works closely with multiple business partners to determine pricing structures that encourage merchant acceptance of American Express, while striving to improve coverage and merchant satisfaction. Ultimately, the team drives merchant revenue and profit growth through customer-centric pricing principles, flexible pricing architecture, and innovative pricing solutions.

Responsibilities

How will you make an impact in this role?

 Develop actionable insights and provide analytical support for strategic merchant pricing initiatives.  Work alongside senior leaders in the Pricing and Client Management organizations in a fast-paced environment to support high-profile projects that have significant impact on American Express.  Develop pricing approaches or constructs based on quantitative data analysis and provide recommendations on key financial / commercial terms.  Leverage internal and external data, competitive intelligence, and industry research to inform pricing strategies and maintain pricing integrity.  Evaluate business cases for various merchant pricing scenarios, model P&L impacts, and perform sensitivity analyses to drive agile business decisions.  Build relationships with partners in the Client Management organization that drive team accountability and achieve stated goals. 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

 Currently enrolled in a full-time Master’s degree program (MBA preferred).  Critical thinking: Ability to work through unstructured problems and develop clear, data-driven insights.  Relationship management and collaboration skills: Ability to influence others in situations where there may be different goals.  Intellectual curiosity: High-intellectual curiosity, creative thinker who is willing to question traditional ways of doing things and develop new approaches to old challenges.  Effective communicator and influencer: Excellent written and oral communication skills, with strong executive presence with the ability to appropriately structure information to drive decision-making.  Entrepreneurial spirit: Proactive self-starter who excels in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that places a premium on driving results.  Problem solving: Strong analytical and financial acumen, including familiarity with financial modeling and sensitivity analysis in Excel.

 Master’s degree candidates with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028.  2 years’ minimum of professional experience in strategy, consulting, finance, analytics or related.  Graduate students enrolled in one of the areas below or related field:   Finance  Business  Accounting  Experience in the payments industry or consulting a plus  SAS / SQL a plus

From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

rows.title: AI Summer Intern – Data Science & AI

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
We are seeking a highly motivated and talented individual to join Trinity Life Sciences as an AI Intern on our Data Science & AI team. In this role, the intern will assist in developing and implementing artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, and analytics solutions for various applications supporting Trinity’s pharmaceutical and life sciences clients. Projects may include generative AI, predictive analytics, forecasting, segmentation, patient finding, HCP targeting, and other advanced analytical solutions. Interns will work closely with our team of data scientists, consultants, and engineers to research, design, and implement cutting-edge AI and data science solutions.

Interns develop their skills through undergoing extensive formal and informal training, as well as receiving mentorship that encourages them to stretch their skills in a real-world setting. This is a 9-week internship program based out of Trinity’s office in New York, NY – interns will be required to work in a hybrid work model, coming into the office about 2–3 days per week.

This is a 9-week, in-person summer internship and the program will run from mid-June 14 to mid-August 2027. Interns will be paid $35/hour and can expect to work 40 hours/week.

Applicants for this position must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship. Trinity is unable to consider candidates requiring sponsorship for visas, including but not limited to TN, H1-B, F-1, and STEM OPT.

Position Responsibilities

Assist in developing and implementing AI, machine learning, and generative AI solutions as part of projects for Trinity’s life sciences clients.Conduct research to identify AI models, analytical approaches, tools, and implementation techniques suited for specific client and business use cases.Analyze and evaluate the performance of AI models and solutions.Test and validate AI models and analytical approaches using real-world healthcare and life sciences data.Collaborate with team members to design and develop model enhancements, refinements, and proof-of-concept solutions.Support the Data Science & AI team in developing materials for business-development activities, including AI-related proposals, pitches, solution overviews, and presentations.Assist in preparing technical reports, presentations, documentation, and other materials that clearly communicate analytical approaches and findings.

Position Requirements

Candidates should be enrolled in a graduate or undergraduate program in computer science, data science, engineering, statistics, mathematics, or a related field. Trinity is targeting current Juniors, or students in a master’s program with 1 year left in their studies.

Required Skills

Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, SQL).Familiarity with artificial intelligence, machine learning, large language models, and/or agentic frameworks.Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Value-Added Skills

Experience developing AI, machine learning, or generative AI solutions in an academic or corporate setting. Familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Pytorch or KerasExperience working with large language models, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) flows. Experience with natural language processing (NLP), image processing, or other applied AI techniques.Experience analyzing healthcare, pharmaceutical, claims, clinical, commercial, or other real-world data.Experience translating technical concepts and analytical findings into presentations, technical documentation, or materials for nontechnical audiences.

About Us

Trinity powers the future of life sciences commercialization through the fusion of human and artificial intelligence. By blending deep therapeutic expertise and trusted human ingenuity with a purpose-built technology platform, Trinity accelerates clarity and confidence at every step of the commercialization journey—from pre-launch to scale to loss of exclusivity. For more than 30 years, the world’s leading pharmaceutical, biotech, and medtech companies have relied on Trinity’s foresight, execution, and partnership to deliver confident product launches, decisive market advantage, and measurable patient impact. During that time, Trinity expanded from its first office in Waltham, MA to 1,300 professionals across 14 offices and five continents, setting new industry standards in quality, responsiveness, and client partnership. For more information, visit Trinity at www.trinitylifesciences.com.

Trinity’s Commitment to Inclusion & Engagement (I&E)

Trinity Life Sciences is an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals. At Trinity, inclusion and engagement are at the heart of how we work and grow together. We’ve evolved from a traditional “DEI” framework to Inclusion & Engagement (I&E)—a model that moves beyond representation to focus on connection, collaboration, and shared purpose. Every role at Trinity plays a part in fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute fully. By embedding I&E principles into our culture, we ensure that belonging and engagement are not standalone initiatives—they are part of how we build teams, make decisions, and deliver excellence every day. Trinity will not tolerate any form of discrimination or harassment and encourages applicants of all ages and identities. For more information about Trinity’s commitment to Inclusion and Engagement please visit Inclusion & Engagement | Culture of Belonging at Trinity Life Sciences.

Location

Technology Services

Technology Services (TS) is responsible for delivering all enterprise infrastructure, applications and related end user technology services across all Brookfield business groups.

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

Analyst, Business Applications – Technology Services Group

The Technology Services Group (TSG) is an internal function responsible for delivering a consistent technology infrastructure and a standard suite of tools and applications across our Asset Management business.

We are seeking a highly adaptable and business-oriented Analyst to join the Business Applications team in our New York office. This role sits at the intersection of:

Technology Data & reporting Marketing operations Investor relations workflows Business process optimization Enterprise application management 

The ideal candidate is someone who combines strong analytical thinking and technical curiosity with a highly collaborative, consultative personality. This is not a pure engineering role, but it is also not a traditional marketing or operations role. We are looking for someone who can comfortably move between business conversations, workflow design, data analysis, system configuration, and platform governance.

This individual will help manage and optimize Brookfield’s enterprise marketing and investor applications ecosystem, support business stakeholders across multiple teams, improve reporting and operational visibility, and help scale technology-enabled workflows across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Support and help oversee a portfolio of enterprise applications used across marketing, investor relations, fundraising, communications, events, and business operations. Serve as a day-to-day partner to business stakeholders, helping teams optimize workflows and improve operational efficiency through technology. Configure, maintain, and enhance systems such as Salesforce, Monday.com, marketing platforms, event systems, reporting tools, DAM platforms, and related business applications. Build and optimize workflows, automations, dashboards, and operational processes within enterprise platforms. Support the development and maintenance of operational and marketing reporting across multiple systems. Analyze data trends, platform usage, and business processes to identify opportunities for improvement. Assist in connecting and organizing data across enterprise applications to improve visibility and decision-making. Meet directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements, understand operational pain points, and propose scalable technology-enabled solutions. Translate business needs into structured workflows, reporting solutions, automation logic, and application enhancements. Help business teams adopt best practices across enterprise applications. Support application governance efforts including user access, permissions, system hygiene, documentation, taxonomy management, and process standardization. Help evaluate new tools, integrations, and operational technologies. Partner with vendors, consultants, and internal teams on implementations, enhancements, and support. Assist with troubleshooting, issue resolution, testing, and system rollout activities. Develop a strong understanding of Brookfield’s operations and functional areas, with a focus on aligning project work to broader business objectives.  Actively support and embody Brookfield’s core values in day-to-day work and team interactions. 

Qualifications & Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Marketing, Communications, Data Analytics, or a related field. 2–4 years of experience in consulting, business operations, marketing operations, technology operations, CRM administration, enterprise applications, or related analytical roles. Strong familiarity with enterprise applications, particularly CRM platforms and business productivity tools (Salesforce experience strongly preferred). Experience building workflows, automations, dashboards, or operational processes within software platforms. Strong communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable working directly with senior business stakeholders. Ability to gather requirements, manage ambiguity, and balance multiple projects simultaneously. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. Technical curiosity and willingness to learn new platforms quickly. Experience with reporting, operational analytics, or data visualization strongly preferred. Experience within financial services, marketing, investor relations, or consulting is a plus, but not required.

Base Salary: $85K - $95K

Our compensation structure is comprised of a base salary and a short-term incentive program (cash bonus). Cash compensation tends to vary based on geography to account for local market conditions and is set to be market competitive. Compensation decisions are based on a number of factors including relative experience, overall years of experience, industry experience, education and designations.

Brookfield is committed to maintaining a Positive Work Environment that is safe and respectful; our shared success depends on it. Accordingly, we do not tolerate workplace discrimination, violence or harassment.

We are proud to create a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are grateful for your interest in this position, however, only candidates selected for pre-screening will be contacted.

- Help the business & team prioritize effectively based on the company objectives & influence decision making across global stakeholders

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.

We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Why Card Customer Resiliency

There has never been a better time to work at the heart of Capital One’s mission. The Card Customer Resiliency team has embarked on an unprecedented journey to modernize our technology, elevate the voice of our most vulnerable customers, and innovate rapidly to define industry norms of what caring for customers truly means. Every member of our team is united in our passion to treat customers with dignity, clarity and respect. We build the experiences that allow struggling customers to responsibly manage their debt and understand what is best for them in the long-run.

Approximately 1 in 4 adult Americans has a Capital One Card at any moment in time. Due to the excellence of our credit expertise in underwriting, we lend deeper than any of our competitors, at scale. Because of this, over 20 million of our Card customers typically go delinquent in a given year, the largest pool of DQ customers in America. Our team cares for these customers in their most vulnerable moment, whether it’s enabling relief when hurricanes hit or crafting affordable payment plans that work for our customers and for Capital One. Managing credit risk isn’t just about understanding access to credit, but holistically understanding what happens when that access doesn’t take the path intended.

We are looking for a Senior Associate Product Manager to join the Customer Resiliency team. The Customer Resiliency team, composed of Collections and Recoveries, is embedded within the Mainstreet Card team. We have end-to-end ownership of our customer and drive meaningful P&L impact each quarter.

About The Role

US Card Recoveries will be the first line of business to migrate to Capital One’s next generation of data infrastructure - the ‘Modern Core’. This move will unlock the full power of our enterprise platforms for Recoveries, thereby accelerating new product launches, increasing Card recoveries by an estimated $200M per year, and meaningfully changing the trajectory of our customers’ path back to credit.

The Recoveries modernization to Modern Core is a critical first phase of integrating Recoveries platforms and surrounding business processes with the new Modern Core infrastructure. As we head toward the finish line of critical migration intent, we will turn our focus to the final decommissioning of the legacy agent and subsequent UI platforms, as well as thinking more strategically about the future of Recoveries agent workflows.

In this role, you will lead the future of Recoveries agent experiences powered by our agent-facing tool. You will lead critical transition initiatives, starting with supporting the legacy agent UI decommissioning and chart the long-term destination state for how Recoveries agents interact with platform tools. By designing streamlined workflows, you will empower agents to bring humanity and simplicity to complex customer interactions while driving core business value. You’ll work with design, marketing, operations, compliance, business analysts, and tech to envision the future destination of Recoveries agent experiences and bring those visions to life. You’ll partner with the team reinventing Collection and Recoveries Platforms, under the “Real Time Intelligent Collections” (RTIC) program, to jointly lead Recoveries into a future of real-time, personalized experiences.

The ideal candidate will:

Have solid product management experience working within full stack software and web environmentsHave the balanced decision making, teamwork, and product skills to manage the Recoveries customer experiencesHas experience navigating legacy system retirements, platform migrations, or workflow modernization effortsHave exceptional judgment and stakeholder management skills to create a unified customer experience roadmap that balances short-term urgent needs with experimenting for the futureBe comfortable in deep partnership with a broad coalition of functions; great decision making is a team sport and you need to be comfortable being all about the teamDeeply respect the importance of keeping our promises to customers and doing so in a provably well-managed wayBe an active partner to the RTIC platform reinvention, helping reimagine the future of Collections experiences as we sunset our legacy platformsAspire to be a general manager who owns key results and is willing to roll up their sleeves to bring new experiences to market

Key Responsibilities:

Drive Legacy Platform Decommissioning: Lead the product strategy, technical execution, and operational alignment to successfully sunset legacy tools and transition agents seamlessly to modern systemsShape Recoveries Agent-Tool Strategy: Define the overarching vision and strategic roadmap for the application within the Recoveries domain, establishing modern standard practices for agent softwareOptimize Agent Workflows: Design and deliver intuitive, high-impact agent experiences that optimize daily operational workflows, reduce task friction, and increase agent efficiencyBuild Destination State Experiences: Partner across Design, Operations, Tech, Compliance, and Business Analysts to envision and deliver the next generation of agent platform capabilityCross-Platform Collaboration: Partner with platform modernization initiatives and the Collections agent experience teams to integrate real-time intelligence and personalizations into agent-facing toolsMaintain Well-Managed Standards: Deeply respect compliance and regulatory requirements, ensuring all delivered experiences are provably well-managed and fulfill promises to customers and agents alike

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:

Human Centered You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature designYou'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

Business Focused Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needsYou’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

Technology Driven You’ll work autonomously in an agile environment, to conduct research and develop features that utilize new and evolving technology You’ll collaborate with designers, technologists, data scientists and subject-matter experts to build cutting edge solutions to help customersYou’ll deliver well-managed product platforms for customers by seeking to understand technology trends and architecture strategy

Transformational Leadership By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teamsYou’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert
Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree or military experienceAt least 1 year of product management experience or at least 1 year of experience in product design, agile delivery, business analysis, data science, or software engineering

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering 1+ years translating business strategy or analysis into consumer facing digital products1+ years of experience working on core product platforms powering digital experiences1+ years working with cross functional teams as a product owner in an agile development process

At Informa, no two days and no two people are the same, and you'll find the freedom, opportunity and support of a fantastic community to make a real impact.

We are home to over 10,000 colleagues across 30 countries and are a member of the UK’s FTSE 100 group of leading public companies.

In Global Support, we provide expert guidance and hands-on support to the Informa Group and Informa’s many business teams. Across tech, finance, legal, corporate development, HR, communications, operations and many other areas, we work collaboratively and flexibly to help our brands serve their customers and help the company succeed.

Job Description

This is a hybrid role (3 days/week in office) and based out of our New Hyde Park, NY office.

We are seeking an experienced Payroll Administrator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for payroll processing operations, maintaining employee data accuracy, and ensuring compliance with tax regulations in a fast-paced environment supporting over 4,500 colleagues.

Process new hires, terminations, and employee data changes in a timely and accurate mannerCollaborate with the HRSSO Team to maintain and update employee dataIssue tax forms and related documents to employees and relevant authoritiesInitiate and process direct deposit changesCreate and maintain Excel reports for payroll analysis and reconciliationMaintain and upload General Ledger filesDevelop and update Payroll training documentsSupport bi-weekly payroll processing for a large workforce

Additional Information

The pay range for this position is $70,000-$85,000 annually, depending on experience.

We believe that great things happen when people connect face-to-face. That's why we work in-person with each other, or with customers and partners.

We work hard to make sure Life at Informa is rewarding, supportive and enjoyable for everyone. Here’s some of what you can expect when you join us. But don’t just take our word for it – see what our colleagues have to say at LifeAt.Informa.com

Great community: a welcoming culture with in-person and online social events, our fantastic Walk the World charity day and active colleague groups and networks promoting a positive, supportive, and collaborative work environmentBroader impact: take up to four days per year to volunteer, with charity match funding available tooCareer opportunity: the opportunity to develop your career with bespoke training and learning, mentoring platforms and on-demand access to thousands of courses on LinkedIn Learning. We’re not solely focused on a checklist of skills. We champion energy and ambition and look for colleagues who will roll up their sleeves, join in and help make things happen. If it sounds like a match and you have most – although not all – of the skills and experience listed, we welcome your application.

If you would like to request reasonable adjustments or accommodations to assist your participation in the hiring process and/or in the advertised position, please inform the appropriate Talent Acquisition Partner for the role once they have been in touch. Your request will be reviewed and considered in confidence. At Informa, you'll find inclusive experiences and environments where all perspectives and backgrounds are welcomed. rows.title: Strategy Associate

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Strategy Associate on Harvey's Transformation Office, you will be the analytical and content engine behind how we help the world's most sophisticated legal and professional services organizations adopt AI. Reporting to the Transformation Strategy Partner, you'll turn raw inputs — usage data, client context, and engagement learnings — into the playbooks, frameworks, analyses, and executive-ready materials that make transformation repeatable, scalable, and measurable.

This is a high-ownership, high-leverage role inside a function that is still being built from the ground up. You'll work across the full arc of transformation: helping size where Harvey can have the most impact, building the methodology that scales it, and supporting the strategic engagements that prove it out. You'll partner closely with Legal Engineering, GTM, and Customer Success, and gain direct exposure to senior partners, General Counsel, and Harvey leadership. Strong performers will grow into owning engagements of their own.

This is a builder's role for someone early in their career who wants disproportionate ownership, range, and visibility.

Travel: up to ~25% of the time.

What You'll Do

Turn data into insight. Pull, structure, and analyze adoption and usage data across accounts to understand what drives transformation. Build the models, dashboards, and impact analyses that tell us what's working, where the gaps are, and where Harvey can create the most value. You make the numbers tell a clear story.

Build playbooks and frameworks that scale. Take what works in individual engagements and codify it into reusable playbooks, templates, and methodology. You're not producing one-off decks; you're building the operating system of the Transformation Office so every engagement gets faster, sharper, and more repeatable.

Capture best practices from strategic transformation engagements. Synthesize lessons learned from engagements into repeatable materials, stakeholder maps, workflow analyses, and tracking that keep engagements on plan. Sit close to live client work, own discrete workstreams, and take on more end-to-end responsibility as you grow.

Build executive-ready communications. Translate complex analysis into crisp narratives, decks, and one-pagers for senior partners, GCs, and internal leadership. You can hold a high bar on both rigor and polish, and you make complex things feel simple.

Drive cross-functional coordination. Act as connective tissue across Legal Engineering, GTM, and Customer Success — chasing down inputs, aligning teams, and making sure things actually move. You surface risk early and keep work on track without being asked.

Synthesize learnings and feed thought leadership. Capture patterns across engagements and turn them into internal knowledge and external thought leadership that sharpens how the market — and Harvey — thinks about AI transformation.

Travel required: up to 25% of the time.

What You Have

2–3 years at a top-tier strategy consulting firm (MBB — McKinsey, BCG, Bain — or equivalent), where you owned analytically rigorous workstreams on real, complex client problems.Exceptional quantitative and data analysis skills. You are deeply comfortable in Excel/Sheets, can structure messy data into clear insight, and build analyses leaders trust. Familiarity with BI tools (e.g. Omni, Looker, Tableau) or SQL is a plus, not a requirement.A track record of building playbooks, frameworks, or repeatable methodology — not just polished one-off deliverables.Exposure to transformation, change management, and strategy work, ideally in or adjacent to legal, financial services, or professional services.Outstanding written and verbal communication. You make complex things simple, write with precision, and can hold your own in a room with senior stakeholders.Comfort operating in ambiguity and a bias to action. You thrive where the playbook is still being written, and you'd rather ship and iterate than wait for perfect information.Genuine curiosity about AI and what it means for the future of professional work. You don't need to be a technologist, but you need to care deeply about the problem.

Compensation

$116,000 - 159,500 USD

Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices here.

Harvey is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

rows.descriptionText:
About Basis

Basis builds real agents that do real work in the real economy. Our agents operate for hours at a time, performing end-to-end work for some of the largest accounting firms in the world.

We recently raised $100M at >$1B valuation and are racing to deploy the most advanced applied ML at production scale.

Our investors include: Khosla Ventures (Keith Rabois & Vinod Khosla), Accel (Miles Clements), Google Ventures, Nat Friedman & Daniel Gross, Adam D'Angelo, Jeff Dean, Jack Altman, Noam Brown, Kyle Vogt, Amjad Masad, Clem Delangue and many other operators/technical leaders.

"Basis is on the frontier of building production-grade, long-horizon agents. They've pushed the limits of what we thought our models could do on real-world, economically valuable, complex accounting tasks. They've been a great collaborator in helping us shape what the future of agents looks like." — Prashant Mital, Applied AI Lead, OpenAI

About The Role

We're scaling our founding BDR team to build our outbound motion from the ground up. Basis has grown entirely through inbound — word of mouth, referrals, customers finding us. Now we're going outbound for the first time, and this is the person who figures out how it works. You'll partner directly with the Director of Business Development and our founding Account Executive team to find the right accounts, crack the messaging, and turn a blank page into a repeatable playbook.

This is a builder role — for someone early in their career who wants to create something, not just execute someone else's system, with a clear path into a closing or leadership role as Basis scales.

📍 Location: NYC, Flatiron office. In-person team.

What You'll Be Doing

Build the outbound playbook from scratch: Test different channels, messages, and approaches until you find what works, then systematize it for the team that comes after you.Find the messaging that lands: Inbound customers came to us already convinced — outbound is a different muscle. Figure out how to talk about Basis in a way that makes in-house accounting and finance teams want to take a meeting. Write, test, learn, rewrite.Research and prioritize the right accounts: Determine which companies we should be talking to, in what order, and why. Build the targeting logic, not just the list.Get meetings with the right people: Convert your outreach into conversations with controllers, CFOs, and finance leaders — and calibrate your approach until you're booking them consistently.Feed intel back into the business: You're the first person talking to the market at scale. What you hear — objections, competitors, pain points — shapes how we position, sell, and build. Document it and share it.Set up the infrastructure: Own the tools, the tracking, and the reporting that lets us understand what's working.

What You'll Bring

High agency: You figure out what needs to happen, do it, and when it doesn't work, you try something else — without being given a playbook.First principles thinker: You ask why something should work, build from there, and arrive at approaches that are actually suited to Basis and our customers — rather than copying what other companies do and hoping it works.Coachable: You know how to think for yourself but don't reinvent the wheel. When someone with more context points you in a direction, you take it seriously and build on it.Creative: You find angles other people miss. You write things people actually want to read.Natural leader: You're the first person in this role — and won't be the last. How you work and the standards you set become the template for everyone who comes after you.Strong communicator: You write clearly and concisely. You can hold a conversation, handle pushback, and get to the point.All-in: This is not a 9-5, we have a massive opportunity ahead of us and are looking to further accelerate our velocity. We are optimizing for the best folks and happy to compensate generously.

What We’d Love To See

1–2 years in sales or business development, preferably a role with a heavy outbound motionExperience in high pace environments such as high growth startups or door-to-door salesHigh levels of adoption of AI in your day-to-dayExperience with outbound tools (Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, HubSpot, or similar)

Benefits At Basis

We offer a competitive and thoughtful benefits package designed to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being:

Health & Wellness: Premium Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage; Life Insurance; and 6 coaching & 6 therapy sessions through Spring Health.Basis will cover 100% of your Wellhub Gold membership.Wellhub gives you access to gyms like Lifetime, SoulCycle, NYSC and so many more - as well as access to wellness apps like Strava & Headspace!Time off: Unlimited PTO + 12 paid company holidays.In-Office Perks: Daily meal stipends, a fully stocked kitchen, and $300 toward your custom desk setup.Financial Benefits: Pre-tax commuter benefits and 401(k) retirement planTeam Culture: Monthly office activities and frequent optional team happy hours.Parental Leave

The People team at Dow Jones is dedicated to attracting, developing, and retaining world-class talent that drives our mission forward. Job Description

Analyst, Business Applications – Technology Services Group

The Technology Services Group (TSG) is an internal function responsible for delivering a consistent technology infrastructure and a standard suite of tools and applications across our Asset Management business.

We are seeking a highly adaptable and business-oriented Analyst to join the Business Applications team in our New York office. This role sits at the intersection of:

Technology Data & reporting Marketing operations Investor relations workflows Business process optimization Enterprise application management 

The ideal candidate is someone who combines strong analytical thinking and technical curiosity with a highly collaborative, consultative personality. This is not a pure engineering role, but it is also not a traditional marketing or operations role. We are looking for someone who can comfortably move between business conversations, workflow design, data analysis, system configuration, and platform governance.

This individual will help manage and optimize Brookfield’s enterprise marketing and investor applications ecosystem, support business stakeholders across multiple teams, improve reporting and operational visibility, and help scale technology-enabled workflows across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Support and help oversee a portfolio of enterprise applications used across marketing, investor relations, fundraising, communications, events, and business operations. Serve as a day-to-day partner to business stakeholders, helping teams optimize workflows and improve operational efficiency through technology. Configure, maintain, and enhance systems such as Salesforce, Monday.com, marketing platforms, event systems, reporting tools, DAM platforms, and related business applications. Build and optimize workflows, automations, dashboards, and operational processes within enterprise platforms. Support the development and maintenance of operational and marketing reporting across multiple systems. Analyze data trends, platform usage, and business processes to identify opportunities for improvement. Assist in connecting and organizing data across enterprise applications to improve visibility and decision-making. Meet directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements, understand operational pain points, and propose scalable technology-enabled solutions. Translate business needs into structured workflows, reporting solutions, automation logic, and application enhancements. Help business teams adopt best practices across enterprise applications. Support application governance efforts including user access, permissions, system hygiene, documentation, taxonomy management, and process standardization. Help evaluate new tools, integrations, and operational technologies. Partner with vendors, consultants, and internal teams on implementations, enhancements, and support. Assist with troubleshooting, issue resolution, testing, and system rollout activities. Develop a strong understanding of Brookfield’s operations and functional areas, with a focus on aligning project work to broader business objectives.  Actively support and embody Brookfield’s core values in day-to-day work and team interactions.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Marketing, Communications, Data Analytics, or a related field. 2–4 years of experience in consulting, business operations, marketing operations, technology operations, CRM administration, enterprise applications, or related analytical roles. Strong familiarity with enterprise applications, particularly CRM platforms and business productivity tools (Salesforce experience strongly preferred). Experience building workflows, automations, dashboards, or operational processes within software platforms. Strong communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable working directly with senior business stakeholders. Ability to gather requirements, manage ambiguity, and balance multiple projects simultaneously. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. Technical curiosity and willingness to learn new platforms quickly. Experience with reporting, operational analytics, or data visualization strongly preferred. Experience within financial services, marketing, investor relations, or consulting is a plus, but not required.

rows.title: Strategy Associate

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Strategy Associate on Harvey's Transformation Office, you will be the analytical and content engine behind how we help the world's most sophisticated legal and professional services organizations adopt AI. Reporting to the Transformation Strategy Partner, you'll turn raw inputs — usage data, client context, and engagement learnings — into the playbooks, frameworks, analyses, and executive-ready materials that make transformation repeatable, scalable, and measurable.

This is a high-ownership, high-leverage role inside a function that is still being built from the ground up. You'll work across the full arc of transformation: helping size where Harvey can have the most impact, building the methodology that scales it, and supporting the strategic engagements that prove it out. You'll partner closely with Legal Engineering, GTM, and Customer Success, and gain direct exposure to senior partners, General Counsel, and Harvey leadership. Strong performers will grow into owning engagements of their own.

This is a builder's role for someone early in their career who wants disproportionate ownership, range, and visibility.

Travel: up to ~25% of the time.

What You'll Do

Turn data into insight. Pull, structure, and analyze adoption and usage data across accounts to understand what drives transformation. Build the models, dashboards, and impact analyses that tell us what's working, where the gaps are, and where Harvey can create the most value. You make the numbers tell a clear story.

Build playbooks and frameworks that scale. Take what works in individual engagements and codify it into reusable playbooks, templates, and methodology. You're not producing one-off decks; you're building the operating system of the Transformation Office so every engagement gets faster, sharper, and more repeatable.

Capture best practices from strategic transformation engagements. Synthesize lessons learned from engagements into repeatable materials, stakeholder maps, workflow analyses, and tracking that keep engagements on plan. Sit close to live client work, own discrete workstreams, and take on more end-to-end responsibility as you grow.

Build executive-ready communications. Translate complex analysis into crisp narratives, decks, and one-pagers for senior partners, GCs, and internal leadership. You can hold a high bar on both rigor and polish, and you make complex things feel simple.

Drive cross-functional coordination. Act as connective tissue across Legal Engineering, GTM, and Customer Success — chasing down inputs, aligning teams, and making sure things actually move. You surface risk early and keep work on track without being asked.

Synthesize learnings and feed thought leadership. Capture patterns across engagements and turn them into internal knowledge and external thought leadership that sharpens how the market — and Harvey — thinks about AI transformation.

Travel required: up to 25% of the time.

What You Have

2–3 years at a top-tier strategy consulting firm (MBB — McKinsey, BCG, Bain — or equivalent), where you owned analytically rigorous workstreams on real, complex client problems.Exceptional quantitative and data analysis skills. You are deeply comfortable in Excel/Sheets, can structure messy data into clear insight, and build analyses leaders trust. Familiarity with BI tools (e.g. Omni, Looker, Tableau) or SQL is a plus, not a requirement.A track record of building playbooks, frameworks, or repeatable methodology — not just polished one-off deliverables.Exposure to transformation, change management, and strategy work, ideally in or adjacent to legal, financial services, or professional services.Outstanding written and verbal communication. You make complex things simple, write with precision, and can hold your own in a room with senior stakeholders.Comfort operating in ambiguity and a bias to action. You thrive where the playbook is still being written, and you'd rather ship and iterate than wait for perfect information.Genuine curiosity about AI and what it means for the future of professional work. You don't need to be a technologist, but you need to care deeply about the problem.

Compensation

$116,000 - 159,500 USD

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Gap

Gap has always been about optimistic American style. Starting with our very first store on Ocean Avenue in San Francisco, opened almost 50 years ago by Doris and Don Fisher. The thread that’s run through those five decades is the phenomenal people that make up our brand - our employees and our customers. People who are rooted in the legacy that makes Gap what it is, but who are also focused on the future. People who want to leave the world better than they found it.

We’ve built our brand on staying true to our roots while always being out in front of what’s next. If you want to be part of an iconic American brand, and help lead the way for where we’re headed, we’d love to have you join us.

About The Role

Gap Inc. is transforming how its brands use data and AI to make faster, more precise commercial decisions, and the Analyst, Pricing Analytics is where that analytical work gets executed. This role is the analytical foundation of the GAP brand's pricing intelligence function: the person who runs the day-to-day analytics, builds models that assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory, and validates outputs from pricing agents so the team has accurate, well-structured insight ready to inform pricing decisions. Reporting to the Manager, Pricing Analytics, you will support the execution of specific pricing analytics work streams within a single brand, spanning strategic pricing principles, discount spend, and in-season performance. You will develop and run repeatable analyses, track competitive price positioning, and produce clean, accurate analysis that your manager and team bring to Merchandising, Planning, and Finance partners. This role is designed for someone who is analytically precise, curious, and eager to build their skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment.

What you'll do

Execute Pricing Analytics 

Develop and execute repeatable analytics to inform the brand's pricing strategy, architecture, and tactics. Build models to assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory. Support in-season analytics, including reconciling execution against forecasted performance and actuals and building "what if" scenarios for pricing strategies. Support analysis of discount spend and the measurement of the brand's strategic pricing principles. Identify opportunities to refine pricing strategies and provide actionable recommendations to cross-functional partners. 

Support Competitive Price Positioning 

Analyze internal and external data to guide competitive price positioning. Track competitive price positioning, communicating how the brand is executing compared to aligned benchmarks and validating that we are "doing what we say." 

Support Cross-Functional Partners 

Collaborate with Merchandising and Planning teams to improve pricing processes and ensure compliance. Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners on strategic pricing initiatives. Support continuous process improvement and cross-functional decision-making. Partner with the Manager, Pricing Analytics on ad-hoc pricing projects and initiatives that enhance overall pricing strategy and business performance. 

Apply AI and Contribute to the Function 

Apply quality checks to outputs from pricing agents, flagging inconsistencies or gaps before analysis moves forward. Simplify and automate repeatable, value-driven processes. Contribute to documentation of analytics processes and benchmarks as the function builds out its standards. 

Who you are

Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required. Preferred emphasis on analytics, data science, mathematics, business, supply chain, industrial engineering, finance, accounting, or economics. 1–3 years of experience in pricing analytics, competitive intelligence, or a related field; internship experience is welcome. Able to manipulate large data sets to interpret patterns and learnings; strong foundational understanding of data structures and algorithms. Problem solving and decision quality: able to use rigorous logic and some statistical methods to solve problems. Financial and business acumen: ability to evaluate financial and business indicators and translate data into actionable information to drive results; proficiency in retail math preferred. Systems and tools acumen: proficiency in Microsoft Excel with an aptitude to learn technical applications quickly; proficiency in Python and/or SQL preferred.

Leadership & Mindset 

Analytically precise: you take ownership of your work and hold a high personal bar for accuracy. Have a willingness to learn and be wrong. You must be able to speak with candor, listen for understanding, and receive feedback with humility. Curious and eager to grow, with a collaborative mindset that serves you well on a cross-functional team. Operate with a high degree of personal accountability to follow through with what you say you will do. Clear, focused communication needed, including an ability to simplify complex topics. Possess strong organizational and time management skills, with strong listening, written, and oral communication skills. Effective teamwork and partnership, and a genuine interest in building skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment. 

Salary Range: $76,400.00 - $95,500.00

Employee pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

Benefits at Gap

rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
The Global Monetization Strategy and Operations (MSO) team enables sustainable growth in TikTok's advertising business. We partner with business leaders on strategy setting, revenue planning, and pricing and incentive policy, and we improve the tools and processes sales teams rely on every day.

We turn complex business decisions into operating models that scale, protecting both customer outcomes and long-term profitability. You will shape the strategy and the operating models behind TikTok's advertising business.

The high-performing Global Monetization Strategy and Operations (MSO) organization is essential to enabling TikTok's advertising business growth. We partner with business leaders in strategy setting, revenue planning, sales and client incentive policy-making, driving operational effectiveness in tooling and sales processes, and ensuring productive and fruitful partnerships cross-functionally across internal teams.

Responsibilities
- Drive sales partnering, strategy & operations to the Global Accounts GBS team 
- Act as the thought partner to senior sales leaders and provide high level strategic direction to the Global Accounts business
- Help the business & team prioritize effectively based on the company objectives & influence decision making across global stakeholders
- Identify revenue opportunities and translate them into concrete go-to-market levers by conducting rigorous quantitative & qualitative analysis and developing deep business & market understanding; drive cross-functional programs based on the levers identified, track progress and measure impact
- Manage business planning & ongoing business reviews: bottom up planning, forecasting, analysis, partnering with leadership teams in maintaining an accurate sales pipeline, revenue attainment tracking etc
- Partner with central teams to define and authoritatively enforce sales & client policies; partner with counterparts in other sales teams and regions to resolve conflicts, all with a positive attitude and a desire to do what is best for the business as a whole.
- Partner with central teams to craft Global Accounts specific incentive structures that incentivize specific sales & client behaviors.
- Identify deficiencies in processes & tools and partner with internal teams to develop and implement solutions; drive the adoption of new solutions, as well as provide ongoing training & documentation.
- Foster cross functional collaboration: Cultivating and maintaining strong working relationships with critical business partners (e.g. Sales, Product, MarSci, Legal, Finance etc).

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- 3+ years work experience working in a fast-paced environment & similar function (e.g. strategy & operations teams in other companies, consulting, finance etc).
- Advanced analytical skills; ability to gather, clean, and structure data for analysis and modeling using SQL and/or programming languages (e.g. Python, R), and BI visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI).
- Strong problem solving & communication skills; ability to translate data into insights & synthesize findings into narratives to influence leadership decisions.
- Experience working cross-functionally with various internal teams, including Finance, Sales, Systems, and Product.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Proficient in Microsoft Office and/or Google Suite, especially Excel and Google Sheets. Experience with data visualization software, BI tools, or SQL is a plus.
- Experience using CRM Platforms(Salesforce, Dynamics, etc), Order Management Systems(Operative, Prisma, etc), and Compensation Platforms (Anaplan/Xactly/SPIFF) is a plus.
- Excellent communication (verbal & written), interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to independently multi-task & help the team prioritize and manage time effectively.
- Experience working in a fast-moving, often uncertain environment and adapting to changes.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

As a Pricefx Technical Analyst you will support the delivery of technology solutions within our Software and Product Innovation practice, with a focus on Pricing, Promotions & Revenue Management. You will help translate business needs into functional and technical solutions, support implementation activities, and contribute to client service workstreams that require careful problem solving and clear communication. This role combines software delivery knowledge with analytical thinking, giving you exposure to end-to-end project execution and the chance to build your personal brand while working through complex client needs.

As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex situations, manage assigned workstreams, and develop deliverables with a client-focused mindset. You will use critical thinking to break down issues, interpret data to inform recommendations, and guide junior team members while maintaining professional and technical standards. In this role at PwC, you will build meaningful client connections, deepen your understanding of the business context, and navigate ambiguity while contributing to technology implementations and delivery activities.

Responsibilities

 Implementing Pricefx solutions by translating business requirements into functional and technical deliverables Supporting client-facing delivery activities across pricing, promotions, and revenue management workstreams Analyzing business processes and system configurations to identify gaps, dependencies, and improvement opportunities Developing user stories, test scenarios, and release materials to support solution delivery and deployment Performing data review, validation, and troubleshooting across pricing platforms and integrated systems Coordinating project tasks, timelines, and risks to keep workstreams moving through each delivery phase Interpreting feedback from clients and internal teams to refine solution design and address emerging needs Applying SDLC, software testing, and technology integration knowledge to support implementation activities Collaborating across functional teams to resolve technical issues and advance implementation milestones Mentoring junior team members by reviewing deliverables and sharing practical implementation approaches

What You Must Have

 At least a Bachelor's degree At least 3 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

 At least one of the following: Pricefx Config Engineer Certification and/or Project CE — Certified Configuration Engineer Developing and maintaining Pricefx ETL pipelines and data warehouse processes using data modeling and ETL architecture best practices Enhancing Pricefx functionality through REST APIs, Groovy, JavaScript, and SQL within a SAFe agile environment Using Git, XML, JSON, and related APIs to support Pricefx data integration and interchange Building meaningful client connections and anticipating team needs Managing ambiguity while analyzing complex pricing and revenue challenges Using critical thinking to translate data into recommendations Applying Pricefx, pricing, promotions, or revenue management skills Demonstrating client support, delivery planning, and project management Mentoring junior team members while growing technical skills

The salary range for this position is: $77,000 - $202,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. About Luminace: Luminace is a leading distributed energy infrastructure platform focused on developing, financing, owning, and operating solar, storage, community solar, and other distributed energy assets across North America. As the business continues to scale, Luminace is building a modern finance organization that combines sophisticated financial analysis, strategic decision support, advanced analytics, and technology-enabled modeling. We are seeking a highly analytical finance professional who thrives in complex environments and is passionate about leveraging both finance and technology to drive business decisions
Luminace offers a multitude of career opportunities. Our dynamic organization is focused on our mission to optimize and drive value across our renewable energy portfolio, advancing the transition to a sustainable, clean energy future. Our value also extends well beyond the clean energy we produce. From our extensive renewable power fleet, we make positive economic, social, and environmental impacts in the communities where we live and work.
We attract high-performing individuals who are driven to make an impact in a fast-paced and collaborative environment. We encourage collaboration across all levels of experience to promote learning, generate best ideas, and deliver quality results, with the aim for growth and career development.
Position Overview: The Senior Financial Analyst, FP&A - Development reports to the Senior Manager, FP&A and serves as a key finance business partner to the Development, Construction, Engineering, and Technical Sales organizations.
This role is responsible for supporting the financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and performance management of Luminace's development pipeline. The successful candidate will leverage large and complex data sets to identify trends, assess business performance, develop key performance indicators (KPIs), and provide actionable insights that support investment decisions and strategic growth initiatives.
This position will play a critical role in preparing executive-level reporting for senior leadership, investors, and the Board of Directors. The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen, advanced analytical capabilities, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to translate complex information into meaningful business insights.This position will be based in our New York City office five days per week, with occasional work-from-home flexibility and periodic travel to our Baltimore office.
Key Responsibilities:Financial Planning, Forecasting & AnalysisPartner with Development, Engineering, Construction, Technical Sales, Corporate Finance, and FP&A teams to support forecasting, planning, and reporting for the development pipeline.Lead the annual budgeting process and periodic forecasting cycles, coordinating across multiple stakeholders to ensure alignment with business objectives.Develop and maintain driver-based forecasting models to improve visibility into project economics, capital requirements, resource needs, and business outcomes.Perform monthly variance analysis and proactively identify risks, opportunities, and emerging business trends.
 KPI Development & Performance ManagementDevelop, track, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) across the development and construction lifecycle.Monitor business performance against financial and operational objectives and provide recommendations to improve results.Analyze milestone achievement, project progression, and development performance while explaining deviations from plan and expected outcomes.
 Data Analytics & Business InsightsTransform data into meaningful insights that support strategic decision-making and improve operational performance.Ensure data integrity, consistency, and accuracy across planning, forecasting, reporting, and business performance processes.Identify opportunities to automate reporting and improve analytical processes through technology and data-driven solutions. Executive, Board & Investor ReportingPrepare monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages for senior leadership, investors, and the Board of Directors.Deliver insightful financial and operational commentary that clearly communicates key drivers, risks, opportunities, and business performance.Support preparation of executive presentations and Board materials by synthesizing complex information into concise and actionable recommendations. Business Partnership & Strategic SupportServe as a trusted finance partner to cross-functional business leaders, helping evaluate investment decisions and strategic initiatives.Challenge assumptions, provide objective financial perspectives, and support fact-based decision-making.Partner with FP&A leadership on special projects, strategic analyses, and ad hoc requests as needed.
Requirements:Undergraduate degree in Accounting or Finance4-7 years of financial planning and analysis or relevant experienceDemonstrated experience working with large and complex data sets to generate business insights and recommendations.Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; proficiency assessment may be administered.Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.Experience developing KPIs, performance metrics, and driver-based forecasting models.Excellent written and verbal communication skills.Strong understanding of US GAAP; IFRS knowledge is a plus.Complex modeling experience is a plusExperience with OneStream, Salesforce, Microsoft D365, ThinkCell, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Alteryx, or similar analytical tools is preferred.Prior experience in renewable energy, infrastructure, real estate development, construction, or project-based industries is preferred.
Qualifications:Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.Ability to synthesize complex financial and operational information into clear, actionable insights.Strong executive communication and presentation skills.Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.A proactive mindset with intellectual curiosity and a desire to understand the underlying drivers of business performance.Confidence to challenge assumptions and influence decision-making through data and analysis.Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.Ability to prioritize competing demands and operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.High degree of ownership, accountability, and follow-through.Collaborative approach with commitment to teamwork and continuous improvement.

Job Description

Who We Are
Creative Artists Agency (CAA) is the leading entertainment and sports agency, with global expertise in filmed and live entertainment, digital media, publishing, sponsorship sales and endorsements, licensing, media finance, consumer investing, fashion, trademark licensing, and philanthropy. Distinguished by its culture of collaboration and exceptional client service, CAA’s diverse workforce identifies, innovates, and amplifies opportunities for the people and organizations that shape culture and inspire the world. The trailblazer of the agency business, CAA was the first to build a sports business, create an investment bank, launch a venture fund, found technology start-up companies, establish a philanthropic arm, build a business in China, and form a brand marketing services division, among other innovations.

The Department

CAA Brand Consulting is a strategy-led, full-service marketing agency with expertise in Cultural and Consumer Insights, Data and Analytics, Talent/Influencer and Property Partnership Advisory, Experiential, Social Impact, Creative Services, and Content and Digital Strategy. These integrated capabilities come together to offer solutions from planning through execution, and we pull in a collective perspective of expertise with each client brief to ensure we are tapping into diverse thinking and building strategies reflective of the marketplace and culture we work within.

The Role
The Business Operations Analyst, Data Science & Innovation supports the CAA Brand Consulting team, splitting time between hands-on support for the group's AI applications and workflow implementation work and the operational rhythm that keeps the broader Business Operations function running. This role helps test, document, and maintain the agentic workflows and tools the team ships, while also owning usage tracking, reporting, vendor administration, and other operational support that lets senior team members focus on higher-level decisions. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and has a working knowledge of AI tools, and is comfortable moving between hands-on workflow support and day-to-day business operations.

Essential Functions:
AI Workflow & Tools Support:

Test, document, and maintain agentic workflows and tooling on approved enterprise AI platforms; partner with cross-functional teams to engineer, standardize, and refine prompt patterns and templates.Oversee and scale the team's shared AI component library, establishing reusable architectural frameworks to accelerate build cycles and ensure consistency across new workflows.Facilitate the integration and deployment of proprietary AI systems and internal tooling to support account and functional teams across the organizationTrack and analyze live workflow metrics to identify performance drift, technical issues, or usage decline, proactively mitigating risks to safeguard end-user experience.Coordinate with Insights & Analytics, Strategy, and other functional teams to support the rollout and integration of AI applications across the business unit.

Operations & Reporting:

Manage usage and spend tracking dashboards and help assemble the monthly reporting cadence to Finance.Oversee vendor portal administration, managing provisioning workflows, role-based access tiers, and platform compliance across functional teams.Manage the intake process for new workflow requests, feeding the use case inventory, and quarterly build slate.Drive daily operational continuity across the Business Operations function, coordinating departmental workflows, cross-functional stakeholder communication, and meeting enablement to optimize team capacity.

Preferred Skills:Agency experience, ideally within sports & entertainmentMBA or other advanced degree in operations or a related field, a plus.Familiarity with tracking and maintaining budgets and financial concepts.Familiarity with AI platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity, Lovable, Cursor, or similar.

Location
This role will be hybrid, located in our New York office. The Brand Consulting department offers a flexible work schedule and requires a minimum of three days per week on-site.

The annual base salary range for this position is as follows:

New York, NY: $74,000 - $88,000

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About MS Reinsurance MS Reinsurance is a global reinsurer domiciled in Switzerland. With underwriting offices in Zurich, Bermuda, Miami and New York, MS Reinsurance provides best-in-class reinsurance products and services to clients around the world. As part of the world-leading insurance group MS&AD, MS Reinsurance is a trusted, long-term partner, helping clients turn risks into opportunities through deep technical expertise and bespoke reinsurance solutions.
About the roleThe purpose of this role is to assist the pricing actuaries. The role works closely with the Pricing actuarial team to assist with identifying the requirements and specifications of the pricing models and contributing to their continuous improvement. This will include providing support in the embedding of robust actuarial methods as well as model calibration. This position will provide assistance to the pricing actuaries in respect of case pricing and rate monitoring and ad hoc support with the claims reserving process. The Pricing Analyst will also work closely with the Pricing team and provide support with projects enabling them to be delivered in a collaborative manner.
Your responsibilitiesDeliver timely and accurate actuarial input that contributes to underwriting decision making and MS AAG financial targets. Tasks include: data manipulation and preparation; reconciliation of data between submissions; analysis and explanation of large or unusual claim movements.Produce draft pricing results for discussion with actuaries/underwriters to including explanation of cost drivers and material movements.Review and validate rate change calculations in accordance with MS Reinsurance’s technical pricing framework.Develop a detailed technical understanding of existing pricing models in order to assist with future development and refinement. Contribute to the development and parameterization of new pricing models within MS Reinsurance’s technical pricing framework.Assist in the production and validation of portfolio pricing statistics.Collaborate and share knowledge with the wider pricing and actuarial team on pricing approaches and analyses.Assistance with other pricing team activities as appropriate.
Your profileUniversity Degree in math, computer science, physics or similar.At least 2 CAS exams passed and making good progress towards ACAS/FCAS.2-3 years of relevant work experience.Experience with reinsurance pricing preferred.Experience working with ISO/Verisk data products preferred.Strong quantitative analytical skills.Strong IT skills particularly MS Excel, VBA and SQL experience desirable.Knowledge of data visualization tools (MS Power BI or QlikView) and programming (R or Python) desirable.Must be well organized with the ability to use initiative and self-manage whilst being able to work effectively in a team environment.Strong communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with multiple departments within the organization.
Why work with us?Make your mark with us. At MS Reinsurance, we’re big enough to make a difference and small enough that everyone counts.We offer an entrepreneurial culture, where there’s less hierarchy and more action, and room for innovation. Here, you’ll have the power to drive real change and shape our path ahead.Join a place where ambition can become reality, with development and platforms that support where you want to go next. Together, we'll help you discover your potential as we expand ours.We live day-to-day by our values: collaborative, progressive, empowering, and responsible. This means you’ll join a team which upholds mutual trust and treats each other with respect. While teamwork is at the heart of our approach to reinsurance, we don’t expect our team to think alike; at MS Re, we don’t just welcome your differences, we believe they’re essential to our success.
Does this sound like a culture you want to be part of? Find out more about what we offer on our website and apply today!
In case of questions, please contact us via email: careers@msreinsurance.com
Note that we will only consider applicants eligible to work in New York.
Salary Range: $100,000-$140,000
MS Reinsurance is the market-facing brand of the risk carrying legal entity MS Amlin AG, a global reinsurer domiciled in Switzerland and operating in Bermuda as MS Amlin AG, Bermuda Branch, in the United States through MS Amlin Reinsurance Managers, Inc, and in Labuan, Malaysia as MS Amlin AG, Labuan Branch.”
