parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

This role is within WPP Media, where you will be instrumental in delivering accurate, insightful analytics for EY’s business-to-business media campaigns. You’ll pull and validate campaign data from Tableau, Power BI, and advertising manager platforms, then turn media metrics into clear visualizations and recurring client deliverables. You’ll work closely with investment, planning, and analytics teams to ensure live campaigns are fully captured and reported accurately. You’ll also build relationships with EY’s analytics team and gradually contribute to client status meetings.

As the only fully dedicated onshore analytics resource supporting this account, you’ll have meaningful ownership and visibility across a high-volume client portfolio. You’ll work with experienced managers, directors, and offshore analytics colleagues while developing your capabilities in data visualization, client communication, and project management. With structured onboarding and support from the outgoing team member, this role offers a strong platform for continued growth in client analytics.

Key Responsibilities

Pull, organize, and validate campaign data from Tableau, Power BI, and advertising manager platforms.Create recurring client deliverables and data visualizations that clearly communicate media performance.Track live campaigns across EY service lines and ensure complete, accurate reporting coverage.Partner with investment and planning teams to gather campaign inputs and resolve data gaps.Manage multiple reporting workflows and deadlines across a high-volume B2B media portfolio.Apply quality checks to datasets, dashboards, visualizations, and client-facing deliverables.Translate media metrics into clear summaries that support client understanding and decision-making.Collaborate with the EY analytics team and respond to requests with professionalism, clarity, and sound judgment.Contribute to client status meetings and build confidence in client-facing communication over time.Maintain clear documentation and support consistent processes across the account.

Skills And Experience

1–2 years of relevant experience in analytics, media analytics, marketing analytics, campaign reporting, or a related field.Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including experience organizing and analyzing large datasets.Fluency in Tableau and/or Power BI for data extraction, analysis, and visualization.Experience pulling and interpreting data directly from advertising manager or media platforms.Strong attention to detail and a consistent approach to data validation and quality assurance.Ability to manage multiple priorities, campaigns, stakeholders, and recurring deliverables.Clear written and verbal communication skills, with an interest in developing client-facing capabilities.Effective cross-functional collaboration with investment, planning, analytics, and client teams.Experience with business-to-business campaigns, media metrics, or professional services clients preferred.Familiarity with multiple client service lines, campaign reporting workflows, or additional data visualization tools is a plus.

Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

WPP Media is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the New York City Human Rights Law. Employment decisions are made without regard to legally protected characteristics.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, go to https://mybenefits.wpp.com/public/welcome for more details.

US Pay Range

$45,000 - $90,000 USD

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Gap

Gap has always been about optimistic American style. Starting with our very first store on Ocean Avenue in San Francisco, opened almost 50 years ago by Doris and Don Fisher. The thread that’s run through those five decades is the phenomenal people that make up our brand - our employees and our customers. People who are rooted in the legacy that makes Gap what it is, but who are also focused on the future. People who want to leave the world better than they found it.

We’ve built our brand on staying true to our roots while always being out in front of what’s next. If you want to be part of an iconic American brand, and help lead the way for where we’re headed, we’d love to have you join us.

About The Role

Gap Inc. is transforming how its brands use data and AI to make faster, more precise commercial decisions, and the Analyst, Pricing Analytics is where that analytical work gets executed. This role is the analytical foundation of the GAP brand's pricing intelligence function: the person who runs the day-to-day analytics, builds models that assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory, and validates outputs from pricing agents so the team has accurate, well-structured insight ready to inform pricing decisions. Reporting to the Manager, Pricing Analytics, you will support the execution of specific pricing analytics work streams within a single brand, spanning strategic pricing principles, discount spend, and in-season performance. You will develop and run repeatable analyses, track competitive price positioning, and produce clean, accurate analysis that your manager and team bring to Merchandising, Planning, and Finance partners. This role is designed for someone who is analytically precise, curious, and eager to build their skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment.

What you'll do

Execute Pricing Analytics 

Develop and execute repeatable analytics to inform the brand's pricing strategy, architecture, and tactics. Build models to assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory. Support in-season analytics, including reconciling execution against forecasted performance and actuals and building "what if" scenarios for pricing strategies. Support analysis of discount spend and the measurement of the brand's strategic pricing principles. Identify opportunities to refine pricing strategies and provide actionable recommendations to cross-functional partners. 

Support Competitive Price Positioning 

Analyze internal and external data to guide competitive price positioning. Track competitive price positioning, communicating how the brand is executing compared to aligned benchmarks and validating that we are "doing what we say." 

Support Cross-Functional Partners 

Collaborate with Merchandising and Planning teams to improve pricing processes and ensure compliance. Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners on strategic pricing initiatives. Support continuous process improvement and cross-functional decision-making. Partner with the Manager, Pricing Analytics on ad-hoc pricing projects and initiatives that enhance overall pricing strategy and business performance. 

Apply AI and Contribute to the Function 

Apply quality checks to outputs from pricing agents, flagging inconsistencies or gaps before analysis moves forward. Simplify and automate repeatable, value-driven processes. Contribute to documentation of analytics processes and benchmarks as the function builds out its standards. 

Who you are

Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required. Preferred emphasis on analytics, data science, mathematics, business, supply chain, industrial engineering, finance, accounting, or economics. 1–3 years of experience in pricing analytics, competitive intelligence, or a related field; internship experience is welcome. Able to manipulate large data sets to interpret patterns and learnings; strong foundational understanding of data structures and algorithms. Problem solving and decision quality: able to use rigorous logic and some statistical methods to solve problems. Financial and business acumen: ability to evaluate financial and business indicators and translate data into actionable information to drive results; proficiency in retail math preferred. Systems and tools acumen: proficiency in Microsoft Excel with an aptitude to learn technical applications quickly; proficiency in Python and/or SQL preferred.

Leadership & Mindset 

Analytically precise: you take ownership of your work and hold a high personal bar for accuracy. Have a willingness to learn and be wrong. You must be able to speak with candor, listen for understanding, and receive feedback with humility. Curious and eager to grow, with a collaborative mindset that serves you well on a cross-functional team. Operate with a high degree of personal accountability to follow through with what you say you will do. Clear, focused communication needed, including an ability to simplify complex topics. Possess strong organizational and time management skills, with strong listening, written, and oral communication skills. Effective teamwork and partnership, and a genuine interest in building skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment. 

Salary Range: $76,400.00 - $95,500.00

Employee pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

Benefits at Gap

Merchandise discount for our brands: 50% off regular-priced merchandise at Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic and Athleta, and 30% off at Outlet for all employees.One of the most competitive Paid Time Off plans in the industry.*Employees can take up to five “on the clock” hours each month to volunteer at a charity of their choice.*Extensive 401(k) plan with company matching for contributions up to four percent of an employee’s base pay.*Employee stock purchase plan.*Medical, dental, vision and life insurance.*See more of the benefits we offer.For eligible employees

We are committed to recruiting, hiring, training and promoting qualified people of all backgrounds, and make all employment decisions without regard to any protected status. parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Gap

Gap has always been about optimistic American style. Starting with our very first store on Ocean Avenue in San Francisco, opened almost 50 years ago by Doris and Don Fisher. The thread that’s run through those five decades is the phenomenal people that make up our brand - our employees and our customers. People who are rooted in the legacy that makes Gap what it is, but who are also focused on the future. People who want to leave the world better than they found it.

We’ve built our brand on staying true to our roots while always being out in front of what’s next. If you want to be part of an iconic American brand, and help lead the way for where we’re headed, we’d love to have you join us.

About The Role

Gap Inc. is transforming how its brands use data and AI to make faster, more precise commercial decisions, and the Analyst, Pricing Analytics is where that analytical work gets executed. This role is the analytical foundation of the GAP brand's pricing intelligence function: the person who runs the day-to-day analytics, builds models that assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory, and validates outputs from pricing agents so the team has accurate, well-structured insight ready to inform pricing decisions. Reporting to the Manager, Pricing Analytics, you will support the execution of specific pricing analytics work streams within a single brand, spanning strategic pricing principles, discount spend, and in-season performance. You will develop and run repeatable analyses, track competitive price positioning, and produce clean, accurate analysis that your manager and team bring to Merchandising, Planning, and Finance partners. This role is designed for someone who is analytically precise, curious, and eager to build their skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment.

What you'll do

Execute Pricing Analytics 

Develop and execute repeatable analytics to inform the brand's pricing strategy, architecture, and tactics. Build models to assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory. Support in-season analytics, including reconciling execution against forecasted performance and actuals and building "what if" scenarios for pricing strategies. Support analysis of discount spend and the measurement of the brand's strategic pricing principles. Identify opportunities to refine pricing strategies and provide actionable recommendations to cross-functional partners. 

Support Competitive Price Positioning 

Analyze internal and external data to guide competitive price positioning. Track competitive price positioning, communicating how the brand is executing compared to aligned benchmarks and validating that we are "doing what we say." 

Support Cross-Functional Partners 

Collaborate with Merchandising and Planning teams to improve pricing processes and ensure compliance. Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners on strategic pricing initiatives. Support continuous process improvement and cross-functional decision-making. Partner with the Manager, Pricing Analytics on ad-hoc pricing projects and initiatives that enhance overall pricing strategy and business performance. 

Apply AI and Contribute to the Function 

Apply quality checks to outputs from pricing agents, flagging inconsistencies or gaps before analysis moves forward. Simplify and automate repeatable, value-driven processes. Contribute to documentation of analytics processes and benchmarks as the function builds out its standards. 

Who you are

Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required. Preferred emphasis on analytics, data science, mathematics, business, supply chain, industrial engineering, finance, accounting, or economics. 1–3 years of experience in pricing analytics, competitive intelligence, or a related field; internship experience is welcome. Able to manipulate large data sets to interpret patterns and learnings; strong foundational understanding of data structures and algorithms. Problem solving and decision quality: able to use rigorous logic and some statistical methods to solve problems. Financial and business acumen: ability to evaluate financial and business indicators and translate data into actionable information to drive results; proficiency in retail math preferred. Systems and tools acumen: proficiency in Microsoft Excel with an aptitude to learn technical applications quickly; proficiency in Python and/or SQL preferred.

Leadership & Mindset 

Analytically precise: you take ownership of your work and hold a high personal bar for accuracy. Have a willingness to learn and be wrong. You must be able to speak with candor, listen for understanding, and receive feedback with humility. Curious and eager to grow, with a collaborative mindset that serves you well on a cross-functional team. Operate with a high degree of personal accountability to follow through with what you say you will do. Clear, focused communication needed, including an ability to simplify complex topics. Possess strong organizational and time management skills, with strong listening, written, and oral communication skills. Effective teamwork and partnership, and a genuine interest in building skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment. 

Salary Range: $76,400.00 - $95,500.00

Employee pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

With a billion rides per year and counting, Lyft is solving hard problems in a rapidly growing domain with a lot of data and creative solutions in Rider, Driver, Marketplace, and beyond. While traditional approaches to optimization and problem decomposition are sufficient to disrupt transportation, building a next-generation platform for low-cost, ultra-immersive transportation to improve people's lives warrants modern ML utilizing petabyte-scale data. Our highly motivated Machine Learning Engineers work on these challenging problems and define solutions to directly impact various aspects of our core business.

The Fulfillment group, within the Marketplace at Lyft, is responsible for determining what inventory can be reliably offered for a given rider session and fulfilling rider requests. The group comprises several sub-teams that generate feasible offers for riders, match rider requests with drivers, and maintain a distributed state machine to track rides and drivers from request through completion.

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Fulfillment team and lead the design, development, and deployment of state-of-the-art machine learning systems. This role requires a strategic thinker who can balance high-level system architecture with hands-on technical implementation. You will collaborate across teams to shape the future of ride-sharing by leveraging machine learning and data science.

Responsibilities

Design, build, and deploy machine learning models for real-time applications, including translating state-of-the-art research into production-ready solutionsDesign and implement feature pipelines, model training workflows, and serving infrastructure using Lyft's ML platformEvaluate ML system performance against business KPIs, run experiments, and drive continuous model improvementPartner with ML engineers, product managers, data scientists, and software engineers to align ML initiatives with business goalsLeverage data-driven insights to inform and refine ML strategies and solutionsWrite production-level code and participate in code reviews to ensure quality and share knowledge across the team

Experience:

BS/MS in Computer Science, or a related field2+ years of experience in machine learning modeling or related fieldsExperience with deep learning technologies for recommendation systems, including TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworksUnderstanding of statistical concepts such as hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and performance evaluation metrics for machine learningExperience with translating state-of-the-art ML research into production systemsProficiency in Python, Golang, or other programming languageProven ability to tackle ambiguous problems and deliver solutions at scaleStrong communication and interpersonal skills for effective cross-functional collaboration

Benefits:

Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolledMental health benefitsFamily building benefitsChild care and pet benefits401(k) plan with company match to help save for your futureIn addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligibleSubsidized commuter benefitsMonthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. We are seeking a highly motivated and talented individual to join Trinity Life Sciences as an AI Intern on our Data Science & AI team. In this role, the intern will assist in developing and implementing artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, and analytics solutions for various applications supporting Trinity’s pharmaceutical and life sciences clients. Projects may include generative AI, predictive analytics, forecasting, segmentation, patient finding, HCP targeting, and other advanced analytical solutions. Interns will work closely with our team of data scientists, consultants, and engineers to research, design, and implement cutting-edge AI and data science solutions.

Interns develop their skills through undergoing extensive formal and informal training, as well as receiving mentorship that encourages them to stretch their skills in a real-world setting. This is a 9-week internship program based out of Trinity’s office in New York, NY – interns will be required to work in a hybrid work model, coming into the office about 2–3 days per week.

This is a 9-week, in-person summer internship and the program will run from mid-June 14 to mid-August 2027. Interns will be paid $35/hour and can expect to work 40 hours/week.

Applicants for this position must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship. Trinity is unable to consider candidates requiring sponsorship for visas, including but not limited to TN, H1-B, F-1, and STEM OPT.

Assist in developing and implementing AI, machine learning, and generative AI solutions as part of projects for Trinity’s life sciences clients.Conduct research to identify AI models, analytical approaches, tools, and implementation techniques suited for specific client and business use cases.Analyze and evaluate the performance of AI models and solutions.Test and validate AI models and analytical approaches using real-world healthcare and life sciences data.Collaborate with team members to design and develop model enhancements, refinements, and proof-of-concept solutions.Support the Data Science & AI team in developing materials for business-development activities, including AI-related proposals, pitches, solution overviews, and presentations.Assist in preparing technical reports, presentations, documentation, and other materials that clearly communicate analytical approaches and findings.

Position Requirements

Candidates should be enrolled in a graduate or undergraduate program in computer science, data science, engineering, statistics, mathematics, or a related field. Trinity is targeting current Juniors, or students in a master’s program with 1 year left in their studies.

Required Skills

Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, SQL).Familiarity with artificial intelligence, machine learning, large language models, and/or agentic frameworks.Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Value-Added Skills

Experience developing AI, machine learning, or generative AI solutions in an academic or corporate setting. Familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Pytorch or KerasExperience working with large language models, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) flows. Experience with natural language processing (NLP), image processing, or other applied AI techniques.Experience analyzing healthcare, pharmaceutical, claims, clinical, commercial, or other real-world data.Experience translating technical concepts and analytical findings into presentations, technical documentation, or materials for nontechnical audiences.

About Us

Trinity powers the future of life sciences commercialization through the fusion of human and artificial intelligence. By blending deep therapeutic expertise and trusted human ingenuity with a purpose-built technology platform, Trinity accelerates clarity and confidence at every step of the commercialization journey—from pre-launch to scale to loss of exclusivity. For more than 30 years, the world’s leading pharmaceutical, biotech, and medtech companies have relied on Trinity’s foresight, execution, and partnership to deliver confident product launches, decisive market advantage, and measurable patient impact. During that time, Trinity expanded from its first office in Waltham, MA to 1,300 professionals across 14 offices and five continents, setting new industry standards in quality, responsiveness, and client partnership. For more information, visit Trinity at www.trinitylifesciences.com.

Trinity’s Commitment to Inclusion & Engagement (I&E)

Every role at Trinity plays a part in fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute fully. By embedding I&E principles into our culture, we ensure that belonging and engagement are not standalone initiatives—they are part of how we build teams, make decisions, and deliver excellence every day. Technology Services

Technology Services (TS) is responsible for delivering all enterprise infrastructure, applications and related end user technology services across all Brookfield business groups.

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. Job Description

Analyst, Business Applications – Technology Services Group

The Technology Services Group (TSG) is an internal function responsible for delivering a consistent technology infrastructure and a standard suite of tools and applications across our Asset Management business.

We are seeking a highly adaptable and business-oriented Analyst to join the Business Applications team in our New York office. This role sits at the intersection of:

Technology Data & reporting Marketing operations Investor relations workflows Business process optimization Enterprise application management 

The ideal candidate is someone who combines strong analytical thinking and technical curiosity with a highly collaborative, consultative personality. This is not a pure engineering role, but it is also not a traditional marketing or operations role. We are looking for someone who can comfortably move between business conversations, workflow design, data analysis, system configuration, and platform governance.

This individual will help manage and optimize Brookfield’s enterprise marketing and investor applications ecosystem, support business stakeholders across multiple teams, improve reporting and operational visibility, and help scale technology-enabled workflows across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Support and help oversee a portfolio of enterprise applications used across marketing, investor relations, fundraising, communications, events, and business operations. Serve as a day-to-day partner to business stakeholders, helping teams optimize workflows and improve operational efficiency through technology. Configure, maintain, and enhance systems such as Salesforce, Monday.com, marketing platforms, event systems, reporting tools, DAM platforms, and related business applications. Build and optimize workflows, automations, dashboards, and operational processes within enterprise platforms. Support the development and maintenance of operational and marketing reporting across multiple systems. Analyze data trends, platform usage, and business processes to identify opportunities for improvement. Assist in connecting and organizing data across enterprise applications to improve visibility and decision-making. Meet directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements, understand operational pain points, and propose scalable technology-enabled solutions. Translate business needs into structured workflows, reporting solutions, automation logic, and application enhancements. Help business teams adopt best practices across enterprise applications. Support application governance efforts including user access, permissions, system hygiene, documentation, taxonomy management, and process standardization. Help evaluate new tools, integrations, and operational technologies. Partner with vendors, consultants, and internal teams on implementations, enhancements, and support. Assist with troubleshooting, issue resolution, testing, and system rollout activities. Develop a strong understanding of Brookfield’s operations and functional areas, with a focus on aligning project work to broader business objectives.  Actively support and embody Brookfield’s core values in day-to-day work and team interactions. 

Qualifications & Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Marketing, Communications, Data Analytics, or a related field. 2–4 years of experience in consulting, business operations, marketing operations, technology operations, CRM administration, enterprise applications, or related analytical roles. Strong familiarity with enterprise applications, particularly CRM platforms and business productivity tools (Salesforce experience strongly preferred). Experience building workflows, automations, dashboards, or operational processes within software platforms. Strong communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable working directly with senior business stakeholders. Ability to gather requirements, manage ambiguity, and balance multiple projects simultaneously. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. Technical curiosity and willingness to learn new platforms quickly. Experience with reporting, operational analytics, or data visualization strongly preferred. Experience within financial services, marketing, investor relations, or consulting is a plus, but not required.

Base Salary: $85K - $95K

Our compensation structure is comprised of a base salary and a short-term incentive program (cash bonus). Cash compensation tends to vary based on geography to account for local market conditions and is set to be market competitive. Compensation decisions are based on a number of factors including relative experience, overall years of experience, industry experience, education and designations.

Brookfield is committed to maintaining a Positive Work Environment that is safe and respectful; our shared success depends on it. Accordingly, we do not tolerate workplace discrimination, violence or harassment.

We are proud to create a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are grateful for your interest in this position, however, only candidates selected for pre-screening will be contacted.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Gap

Gap has always been about optimistic American style. Starting with our very first store on Ocean Avenue in San Francisco, opened almost 50 years ago by Doris and Don Fisher. The thread that’s run through those five decades is the phenomenal people that make up our brand - our employees and our customers. People who are rooted in the legacy that makes Gap what it is, but who are also focused on the future. People who want to leave the world better than they found it.

We’ve built our brand on staying true to our roots while always being out in front of what’s next. If you want to be part of an iconic American brand, and help lead the way for where we’re headed, we’d love to have you join us.

About The Role

Gap Inc. is transforming how its brands use data and AI to make faster, more precise commercial decisions, and the Analyst, Pricing Analytics is where that analytical work gets executed. This role is the analytical foundation of the GAP brand's pricing intelligence function: the person who runs the day-to-day analytics, builds models that assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory, and validates outputs from pricing agents so the team has accurate, well-structured insight ready to inform pricing decisions. Reporting to the Manager, Pricing Analytics, you will support the execution of specific pricing analytics work streams within a single brand, spanning strategic pricing principles, discount spend, and in-season performance. You will develop and run repeatable analyses, track competitive price positioning, and produce clean, accurate analysis that your manager and team bring to Merchandising, Planning, and Finance partners. This role is designed for someone who is analytically precise, curious, and eager to build their skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment.

What you'll do

Execute Pricing Analytics 

Develop and execute repeatable analytics to inform the brand's pricing strategy, architecture, and tactics. Build models to assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory. Support in-season analytics, including reconciling execution against forecasted performance and actuals and building "what if" scenarios for pricing strategies. Support analysis of discount spend and the measurement of the brand's strategic pricing principles. Identify opportunities to refine pricing strategies and provide actionable recommendations to cross-functional partners. 

Support Competitive Price Positioning 

Analyze internal and external data to guide competitive price positioning. Track competitive price positioning, communicating how the brand is executing compared to aligned benchmarks and validating that we are "doing what we say." 

Support Cross-Functional Partners 

Collaborate with Merchandising and Planning teams to improve pricing processes and ensure compliance. Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners on strategic pricing initiatives. Support continuous process improvement and cross-functional decision-making. Partner with the Manager, Pricing Analytics on ad-hoc pricing projects and initiatives that enhance overall pricing strategy and business performance. 

Apply AI and Contribute to the Function 

Apply quality checks to outputs from pricing agents, flagging inconsistencies or gaps before analysis moves forward. Simplify and automate repeatable, value-driven processes. Contribute to documentation of analytics processes and benchmarks as the function builds out its standards. 

Who you are

Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required. Preferred emphasis on analytics, data science, mathematics, business, supply chain, industrial engineering, finance, accounting, or economics. 1–3 years of experience in pricing analytics, competitive intelligence, or a related field; internship experience is welcome. Able to manipulate large data sets to interpret patterns and learnings; strong foundational understanding of data structures and algorithms. Problem solving and decision quality: able to use rigorous logic and some statistical methods to solve problems. Financial and business acumen: ability to evaluate financial and business indicators and translate data into actionable information to drive results; proficiency in retail math preferred. Systems and tools acumen: proficiency in Microsoft Excel with an aptitude to learn technical applications quickly; proficiency in Python and/or SQL preferred.

Leadership & Mindset 

Analytically precise: you take ownership of your work and hold a high personal bar for accuracy. Have a willingness to learn and be wrong. You must be able to speak with candor, listen for understanding, and receive feedback with humility. Curious and eager to grow, with a collaborative mindset that serves you well on a cross-functional team. Operate with a high degree of personal accountability to follow through with what you say you will do. Clear, focused communication needed, including an ability to simplify complex topics. Possess strong organizational and time management skills, with strong listening, written, and oral communication skills. Effective teamwork and partnership, and a genuine interest in building skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment. 

Salary Range: $76,400.00 - $95,500.00

Employee pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

Benefits at Gap

Merchandise discount for our brands: 50% off regular-priced merchandise at Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic and Athleta, and 30% off at Outlet for all employees.One of the most competitive Paid Time Off plans in the industry.*Employees can take up to five “on the clock” hours each month to volunteer at a charity of their choice.*Extensive 401(k) plan with company matching for contributions up to four percent of an employee’s base pay.*Employee stock purchase plan.*Medical, dental, vision and life insurance.*See more of the benefits we offer.For eligible employees

Gap Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We are committed to recruiting, hiring, training and promoting qualified people of all backgrounds, and make all employment decisions without regard to any protected status. We have received numerous awards for our long-held commitment to equality and will continue to foster a diverse and inclusive environment of belonging. rows.descriptionText:
Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.

We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Why Card Customer Resiliency

There has never been a better time to work at the heart of Capital One’s mission. The Card Customer Resiliency team has embarked on an unprecedented journey to modernize our technology, elevate the voice of our most vulnerable customers, and innovate rapidly to define industry norms of what caring for customers truly means. Every member of our team is united in our passion to treat customers with dignity, clarity and respect. We build the experiences that allow struggling customers to responsibly manage their debt and understand what is best for them in the long-run.

Approximately 1 in 4 adult Americans has a Capital One Card at any moment in time. Due to the excellence of our credit expertise in underwriting, we lend deeper than any of our competitors, at scale. Because of this, over 20 million of our Card customers typically go delinquent in a given year, the largest pool of DQ customers in America. Our team cares for these customers in their most vulnerable moment, whether it’s enabling relief when hurricanes hit or crafting affordable payment plans that work for our customers and for Capital One. Managing credit risk isn’t just about understanding access to credit, but holistically understanding what happens when that access doesn’t take the path intended.

We are looking for a Senior Associate Product Manager to join the Customer Resiliency team. The Customer Resiliency team, composed of Collections and Recoveries, is embedded within the Mainstreet Card team. We have end-to-end ownership of our customer and drive meaningful P&L impact each quarter.

About The Role

US Card Recoveries will be the first line of business to migrate to Capital One’s next generation of data infrastructure - the ‘Modern Core’. This move will unlock the full power of our enterprise platforms for Recoveries, thereby accelerating new product launches, increasing Card recoveries by an estimated $200M per year, and meaningfully changing the trajectory of our customers’ path back to credit.

The Recoveries modernization to Modern Core is a critical first phase of integrating Recoveries platforms and surrounding business processes with the new Modern Core infrastructure. As we head toward the finish line of critical migration intent, we will turn our focus to the final decommissioning of the legacy agent and subsequent UI platforms, as well as thinking more strategically about the future of Recoveries agent workflows.

In this role, you will lead the future of Recoveries agent experiences powered by our agent-facing tool. You will lead critical transition initiatives, starting with supporting the legacy agent UI decommissioning and chart the long-term destination state for how Recoveries agents interact with platform tools. By designing streamlined workflows, you will empower agents to bring humanity and simplicity to complex customer interactions while driving core business value. You’ll work with design, marketing, operations, compliance, business analysts, and tech to envision the future destination of Recoveries agent experiences and bring those visions to life. You’ll partner with the team reinventing Collection and Recoveries Platforms, under the “Real Time Intelligent Collections” (RTIC) program, to jointly lead Recoveries into a future of real-time, personalized experiences.

The ideal candidate will:

Have solid product management experience working within full stack software and web environmentsHave the balanced decision making, teamwork, and product skills to manage the Recoveries customer experiencesHas experience navigating legacy system retirements, platform migrations, or workflow modernization effortsHave exceptional judgment and stakeholder management skills to create a unified customer experience roadmap that balances short-term urgent needs with experimenting for the futureBe comfortable in deep partnership with a broad coalition of functions; great decision making is a team sport and you need to be comfortable being all about the teamDeeply respect the importance of keeping our promises to customers and doing so in a provably well-managed wayBe an active partner to the RTIC platform reinvention, helping reimagine the future of Collections experiences as we sunset our legacy platformsAspire to be a general manager who owns key results and is willing to roll up their sleeves to bring new experiences to market

Key Responsibilities:

Drive Legacy Platform Decommissioning: Lead the product strategy, technical execution, and operational alignment to successfully sunset legacy tools and transition agents seamlessly to modern systemsShape Recoveries Agent-Tool Strategy: Define the overarching vision and strategic roadmap for the application within the Recoveries domain, establishing modern standard practices for agent softwareOptimize Agent Workflows: Design and deliver intuitive, high-impact agent experiences that optimize daily operational workflows, reduce task friction, and increase agent efficiencyBuild Destination State Experiences: Partner across Design, Operations, Tech, Compliance, and Business Analysts to envision and deliver the next generation of agent platform capabilityCross-Platform Collaboration: Partner with platform modernization initiatives and the Collections agent experience teams to integrate real-time intelligence and personalizations into agent-facing toolsMaintain Well-Managed Standards: Deeply respect compliance and regulatory requirements, ensuring all delivered experiences are provably well-managed and fulfill promises to customers and agents alike

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:

Human Centered You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature designYou'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

Business Focused Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needsYou’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

Technology Driven You’ll work autonomously in an agile environment, to conduct research and develop features that utilize new and evolving technology You’ll collaborate with designers, technologists, data scientists and subject-matter experts to build cutting edge solutions to help customersYou’ll deliver well-managed product platforms for customers by seeking to understand technology trends and architecture strategy

Transformational Leadership By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teamsYou’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert
Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree or military experienceAt least 1 year of product management experience or at least 1 year of experience in product design, agile delivery, business analysis, data science, or software engineering

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering 1+ years translating business strategy or analysis into consumer facing digital products1+ years of experience working on core product platforms powering digital experiences1+ years working with cross functional teams as a product owner in an agile development process

rows.title: Analyst - Pricing Analytics

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Gap

Gap has always been about optimistic American style. Starting with our very first store on Ocean Avenue in San Francisco, opened almost 50 years ago by Doris and Don Fisher. The thread that’s run through those five decades is the phenomenal people that make up our brand - our employees and our customers. People who are rooted in the legacy that makes Gap what it is, but who are also focused on the future. People who want to leave the world better than they found it.

We’ve built our brand on staying true to our roots while always being out in front of what’s next. If you want to be part of an iconic American brand, and help lead the way for where we’re headed, we’d love to have you join us.

About The Role

Gap Inc. is transforming how its brands use data and AI to make faster, more precise commercial decisions, and the Analyst, Pricing Analytics is where that analytical work gets executed. This role is the analytical foundation of the GAP brand's pricing intelligence function: the person who runs the day-to-day analytics, builds models that assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory, and validates outputs from pricing agents so the team has accurate, well-structured insight ready to inform pricing decisions. Reporting to the Manager, Pricing Analytics, you will support the execution of specific pricing analytics work streams within a single brand, spanning strategic pricing principles, discount spend, and in-season performance. You will develop and run repeatable analyses, track competitive price positioning, and produce clean, accurate analysis that your manager and team bring to Merchandising, Planning, and Finance partners. This role is designed for someone who is analytically precise, curious, and eager to build their skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment.

What you'll do

Execute Pricing Analytics 

Develop and execute repeatable analytics to inform the brand's pricing strategy, architecture, and tactics. Build models to assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory. Support in-season analytics, including reconciling execution against forecasted performance and actuals and building "what if" scenarios for pricing strategies. Support analysis of discount spend and the measurement of the brand's strategic pricing principles. Identify opportunities to refine pricing strategies and provide actionable recommendations to cross-functional partners. 

Support Competitive Price Positioning 

Analyze internal and external data to guide competitive price positioning. Track competitive price positioning, communicating how the brand is executing compared to aligned benchmarks and validating that we are "doing what we say." 

Support Cross-Functional Partners 

Collaborate with Merchandising and Planning teams to improve pricing processes and ensure compliance. Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners on strategic pricing initiatives. Support continuous process improvement and cross-functional decision-making. Partner with the Manager, Pricing Analytics on ad-hoc pricing projects and initiatives that enhance overall pricing strategy and business performance. 

Apply AI and Contribute to the Function 

Apply quality checks to outputs from pricing agents, flagging inconsistencies or gaps before analysis moves forward. Simplify and automate repeatable, value-driven processes. Contribute to documentation of analytics processes and benchmarks as the function builds out its standards. 

Who you are

Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required. Preferred emphasis on analytics, data science, mathematics, business, supply chain, industrial engineering, finance, accounting, or economics. 1–3 years of experience in pricing analytics, competitive intelligence, or a related field; internship experience is welcome. Able to manipulate large data sets to interpret patterns and learnings; strong foundational understanding of data structures and algorithms. Problem solving and decision quality: able to use rigorous logic and some statistical methods to solve problems. Financial and business acumen: ability to evaluate financial and business indicators and translate data into actionable information to drive results; proficiency in retail math preferred. Systems and tools acumen: proficiency in Microsoft Excel with an aptitude to learn technical applications quickly; proficiency in Python and/or SQL preferred.

Leadership & Mindset 

Analytically precise: you take ownership of your work and hold a high personal bar for accuracy. Have a willingness to learn and be wrong. You must be able to speak with candor, listen for understanding, and receive feedback with humility. Curious and eager to grow, with a collaborative mindset that serves you well on a cross-functional team. Operate with a high degree of personal accountability to follow through with what you say you will do. Clear, focused communication needed, including an ability to simplify complex topics. Possess strong organizational and time management skills, with strong listening, written, and oral communication skills. parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Gap

Gap has always been about optimistic American style. Starting with our very first store on Ocean Avenue in San Francisco, opened almost 50 years ago by Doris and Don Fisher. The thread that’s run through those five decades is the phenomenal people that make up our brand - our employees and our customers. People who are rooted in the legacy that makes Gap what it is, but who are also focused on the future. People who want to leave the world better than they found it.

We’ve built our brand on staying true to our roots while always being out in front of what’s next. If you want to be part of an iconic American brand, and help lead the way for where we’re headed, we’d love to have you join us.

About The Role

Gap Inc. is transforming how its brands use data and AI to make faster, more precise commercial decisions, and the Analyst, Pricing Analytics is where that analytical work gets executed. This role is the analytical foundation of the GAP brand's pricing intelligence function: the person who runs the day-to-day analytics, builds models that assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory, and validates outputs from pricing agents so the team has accurate, well-structured insight ready to inform pricing decisions. Reporting to the Manager, Pricing Analytics, you will support the execution of specific pricing analytics work streams within a single brand, spanning strategic pricing principles, discount spend, and in-season performance. You will develop and run repeatable analyses, track competitive price positioning, and produce clean, accurate analysis that your manager and team bring to Merchandising, Planning, and Finance partners. This role is designed for someone who is analytically precise, curious, and eager to build their skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment.

What you'll do

Execute Pricing Analytics 

Develop and execute repeatable analytics to inform the brand's pricing strategy, architecture, and tactics. Build models to assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory. Support in-season analytics, including reconciling execution against forecasted performance and actuals and building "what if" scenarios for pricing strategies. Support analysis of discount spend and the measurement of the brand's strategic pricing principles. Identify opportunities to refine pricing strategies and provide actionable recommendations to cross-functional partners. 

Support Competitive Price Positioning 

Analyze internal and external data to guide competitive price positioning. Track competitive price positioning, communicating how the brand is executing compared to aligned benchmarks and validating that we are "doing what we say." 

Support Cross-Functional Partners 

Collaborate with Merchandising and Planning teams to improve pricing processes and ensure compliance. Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners on strategic pricing initiatives. Support continuous process improvement and cross-functional decision-making. Partner with the Manager, Pricing Analytics on ad-hoc pricing projects and initiatives that enhance overall pricing strategy and business performance. 

Apply AI and Contribute to the Function 

Apply quality checks to outputs from pricing agents, flagging inconsistencies or gaps before analysis moves forward. Simplify and automate repeatable, value-driven processes. Contribute to documentation of analytics processes and benchmarks as the function builds out its standards. 

Who you are

Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required. Preferred emphasis on analytics, data science, mathematics, business, supply chain, industrial engineering, finance, accounting, or economics. 1–3 years of experience in pricing analytics, competitive intelligence, or a related field; internship experience is welcome. Able to manipulate large data sets to interpret patterns and learnings; strong foundational understanding of data structures and algorithms. Problem solving and decision quality: able to use rigorous logic and some statistical methods to solve problems. Financial and business acumen: ability to evaluate financial and business indicators and translate data into actionable information to drive results; proficiency in retail math preferred. Systems and tools acumen: proficiency in Microsoft Excel with an aptitude to learn technical applications quickly; proficiency in Python and/or SQL preferred.

Leadership & Mindset 

Analytically precise: you take ownership of your work and hold a high personal bar for accuracy. Have a willingness to learn and be wrong. You must be able to speak with candor, listen for understanding, and receive feedback with humility. Curious and eager to grow, with a collaborative mindset that serves you well on a cross-functional team. Operate with a high degree of personal accountability to follow through with what you say you will do. Clear, focused communication needed, including an ability to simplify complex topics. Possess strong organizational and time management skills, with strong listening, written, and oral communication skills. Effective teamwork and partnership, and a genuine interest in building skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment. 

Salary Range: $76,400.00 - $95,500.00

Employee pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

Benefits at Gap

Merchandise discount for our brands: 50% off regular-priced merchandise at Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic and Athleta, and 30% off at Outlet for all employees.One of the most competitive Paid Time Off plans in the industry.*Employees can take up to five “on the clock” hours each month to volunteer at a charity of their choice.*Extensive 401(k) plan with company matching for contributions up to four percent of an employee’s base pay.*Employee stock purchase plan.*Medical, dental, vision and life insurance.*See more of the benefits we offer.For eligible employees

rows.descriptionText:
Trexquant is a systematic hedge fund where we use thousands of statistical algorithms to trade equity, futures and other markets globally. Starting with many data sets, we develop large sets of features and use various machine learning methods to discover trading signals and effectively combine them into market-neutral portfolios. We are looking for data scientists, physicists, engineers, economists and programmers to develop the next generation of machine learning strategies that can accurately predict the future movements of liquid financial assets. 
As a Quantitative Researcher you will be involved in developing market-neutral signals, parsing and analyzing large data sets and collaborating with the Data and Strategy Research team to build a diverse set of predictive models. While we are open to researchers in any asset class we are currently focusing on roles in equities, futures, commodities, and event driven research. 
Responsibilities

 Design, implement, and optimize various machine learning models aimed at predicting liquid assets using a wide set of financial data and a vast library of trading signals Parse and analyze large datasets to identify actionable alpha signals and develop strategies for systematic trading Investigate and implement state-of-the-art academic research in the field of quantitative finance Continuously innovate and improve existing models by integrating new data sources and advanced techniques to boost performance and scalability Collaborate closely with a team of experienced quantitative researchers to conduct experiments, backtest hypotheses, and refine strategies through rigorous simulations and data analysis 


Requirements

 BS/MS/PhD degree in any stem field 2+ years in a systematic trading environment Passion for machine learning  Fluent with programming languages like Python Strong problem-solving skills Ability to work effectively both as an individual and a team player

Competitive salary plus bonus based on individual and company performanceCollaborative, Casual, and friendly work environmentPPO Health, dental and vision insurance premiums fully covered for you and your dependentsPre-tax commuter benefitsWeekly company meals

Base salary is one component of Trexquant's total compensation package, which may also include a discretionary, performance-based bonus. This position is classified as overtime-exempt.

About Digital Asset & The Canton Network

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Uniquely combining privacy, compliance, and scalability, Canton enables real-time, secure settlement across multiple asset classes. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney— we are on a mission to transform finance— and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

About The Role

We’re hiring the first Analyst on our newly formed Operations team, reporting directly to the Director of Strategy & Operations. This is a ground-floor opportunity to help define how a fast-growing blockchain infrastructure company runs — from executive governance and cross-functional workflow management to the data and AI systems that support company-wide decision making.

You’ll work across Finance, Legal, Product, and Engineering, and you’ll have direct exposure to how a Series F, venture-backed crypto infrastructure company operates at the executive level. We’re looking for someone early in their career who is hungry to learn, comfortable owning the unglamorous details as well as the strategic ones, and excited to bring modern data and AI tools into how the team works.

rows.title: Quantum Security Intern 2027 - Cloud Compliance & Security Tooling
rows.descriptionText:
Introduction

IBM Quantum is building and operating some of the world's most advanced quantum computing systems, delivered to clients and researchers through IBM Cloud. As the program scales, protecting the security and compliance of the cloud infrastructure behind it is a growing priority. We're looking for a Quantum Security Intern to help strengthen the compliance posture of our IBM Cloud accounts and improve the security tooling our team relies on day to day.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quantum Security Intern, you will work alongside the IBM Quantum security team on two connected priorities: raising the compliance posture of our IBM Cloud accounts, and improving the tooling we use to monitor and act on security risk. Your responsibilities will include:

Assess IBM Cloud account configurations (IAM policies, access controls, encryption, logging/audit trails) against internal and industry compliance frameworks, and identify and document gaps.Design, build, and enhance automated tooling - scripts, dashboards, and checks - that continuously monitor cloud account compliance and flag deviations as they occur.Support remediation of identified security and compliance findings in partnership with cloud and infrastructure engineering teams.Improve existing security tooling and workflows, reducing manual effort and closing gaps in current coverage across IBM Cloud accounts.Document security controls, compliance evidence, and tooling runbooks to support internal reviews and audits.Partner with the broader IBM Security and Quantum engineering organizations to evaluate and pilot new security and compliance tools.Present findings, tooling improvements, and recommendations to the team throughout the internship.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, or a related technical field.Foundational understanding of cloud security concepts, including IAM, encryption, network security, and logging/monitoring.Working knowledge of at least one scripting or programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Bash) for building automation and tooling.Familiarity with cloud platforms (IBM Cloud, AWS, Azure, or GCP) and their security/compliance features.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Exposure to compliance frameworks or standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks).Coursework or project experience related to quantum computing.Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform) or CI/CD security tooling.Familiarity with security scanning, SIEM, or cloud security posture management (CSPM) tools.

rows.title: Analyst - Pricing Analytics

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Gap

Gap has always been about optimistic American style. Starting with our very first store on Ocean Avenue in San Francisco, opened almost 50 years ago by Doris and Don Fisher. The thread that’s run through those five decades is the phenomenal people that make up our brand - our employees and our customers. People who are rooted in the legacy that makes Gap what it is, but who are also focused on the future. People who want to leave the world better than they found it.

We’ve built our brand on staying true to our roots while always being out in front of what’s next. If you want to be part of an iconic American brand, and help lead the way for where we’re headed, we’d love to have you join us.

About The Role

Gap Inc. is transforming how its brands use data and AI to make faster, more precise commercial decisions, and the Analyst, Pricing Analytics is where that analytical work gets executed. This role is the analytical foundation of the GAP brand's pricing intelligence function: the person who runs the day-to-day analytics, builds models that assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory, and validates outputs from pricing agents so the team has accurate, well-structured insight ready to inform pricing decisions. Reporting to the Manager, Pricing Analytics, you will support the execution of specific pricing analytics work streams within a single brand, spanning strategic pricing principles, discount spend, and in-season performance. You will develop and run repeatable analyses, track competitive price positioning, and produce clean, accurate analysis that your manager and team bring to Merchandising, Planning, and Finance partners. This role is designed for someone who is analytically precise, curious, and eager to build their skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment.

What you'll do

Execute Pricing Analytics 

Develop and execute repeatable analytics to inform the brand's pricing strategy, architecture, and tactics. Build models to assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory. Support in-season analytics, including reconciling execution against forecasted performance and actuals and building "what if" scenarios for pricing strategies. Support analysis of discount spend and the measurement of the brand's strategic pricing principles. Identify opportunities to refine pricing strategies and provide actionable recommendations to cross-functional partners. 

Support Competitive Price Positioning 

Analyze internal and external data to guide competitive price positioning. Track competitive price positioning, communicating how the brand is executing compared to aligned benchmarks and validating that we are "doing what we say." 

Support Cross-Functional Partners 

Collaborate with Merchandising and Planning teams to improve pricing processes and ensure compliance. Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners on strategic pricing initiatives. Support continuous process improvement and cross-functional decision-making. Partner with the Manager, Pricing Analytics on ad-hoc pricing projects and initiatives that enhance overall pricing strategy and business performance. 

Apply AI and Contribute to the Function 

Apply quality checks to outputs from pricing agents, flagging inconsistencies or gaps before analysis moves forward. Simplify and automate repeatable, value-driven processes. Contribute to documentation of analytics processes and benchmarks as the function builds out its standards. 

Who you are

Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required. Preferred emphasis on analytics, data science, mathematics, business, supply chain, industrial engineering, finance, accounting, or economics. 1–3 years of experience in pricing analytics, competitive intelligence, or a related field; internship experience is welcome. Able to manipulate large data sets to interpret patterns and learnings; strong foundational understanding of data structures and algorithms. Problem solving and decision quality: able to use rigorous logic and some statistical methods to solve problems. Financial and business acumen: ability to evaluate financial and business indicators and translate data into actionable information to drive results; proficiency in retail math preferred. Systems and tools acumen: proficiency in Microsoft Excel with an aptitude to learn technical applications quickly; proficiency in Python and/or SQL preferred.

Leadership & Mindset 

Analytically precise: you take ownership of your work and hold a high personal bar for accuracy. Have a willingness to learn and be wrong. You must be able to speak with candor, listen for understanding, and receive feedback with humility. Curious and eager to grow, with a collaborative mindset that serves you well on a cross-functional team. Distinguished by its culture of collaboration and exceptional client service, CAA’s diverse workforce identifies, innovates, and amplifies opportunities for the people and organizations that shape culture and inspire the world. The trailblazer of the agency business, CAA was the first to build a sports business, create an investment bank, launch a venture fund, found technology start-up companies, establish a philanthropic arm, build a business in China, and form a brand marketing services division, among other innovations.

The Department

CAA Brand Consulting is a strategy-led, full-service marketing agency with expertise in Cultural and Consumer Insights, Data and Analytics, Talent/Influencer and Property Partnership Advisory, Experiential, Social Impact, Creative Services, and Content and Digital Strategy. These integrated capabilities come together to offer solutions from planning through execution, and we pull in a collective perspective of expertise with each client brief to ensure we are tapping into diverse thinking and building strategies reflective of the marketplace and culture we work within.

The Role
The Business Operations Analyst, Data Science & Innovation supports the CAA Brand Consulting team, splitting time between hands-on support for the group's AI applications and workflow implementation work and the operational rhythm that keeps the broader Business Operations function running. This role helps test, document, and maintain the agentic workflows and tools the team ships, while also owning usage tracking, reporting, vendor administration, and other operational support that lets senior team members focus on higher-level decisions. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and has a working knowledge of AI tools, and is comfortable moving between hands-on workflow support and day-to-day business operations.

AI Workflow & Tools Support:

Test, document, and maintain agentic workflows and tooling on approved enterprise AI platforms; partner with cross-functional teams to engineer, standardize, and refine prompt patterns and templates.Oversee and scale the team's shared AI component library, establishing reusable architectural frameworks to accelerate build cycles and ensure consistency across new workflows.Facilitate the integration and deployment of proprietary AI systems and internal tooling to support account and functional teams across the organizationTrack and analyze live workflow metrics to identify performance drift, technical issues, or usage decline, proactively mitigating risks to safeguard end-user experience.Coordinate with Insights & Analytics, Strategy, and other functional teams to support the rollout and integration of AI applications across the business unit.
