parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Strategy Associate on Harvey's Transformation Office, you will be the analytical and content engine behind how we help the world's most sophisticated legal and professional services organizations adopt AI. Reporting to the Transformation Strategy Partner, you'll turn raw inputs — usage data, client context, and engagement learnings — into the playbooks, frameworks, analyses, and executive-ready materials that make transformation repeatable, scalable, and measurable.

This is a high-ownership, high-leverage role inside a function that is still being built from the ground up. You'll work across the full arc of transformation: helping size where Harvey can have the most impact, building the methodology that scales it, and supporting the strategic engagements that prove it out. You'll partner closely with Legal Engineering, GTM, and Customer Success, and gain direct exposure to senior partners, General Counsel, and Harvey leadership. Strong performers will grow into owning engagements of their own.

This is a builder's role for someone early in their career who wants disproportionate ownership, range, and visibility.

Travel: up to ~25% of the time.

What You'll Do

Turn data into insight. Pull, structure, and analyze adoption and usage data across accounts to understand what drives transformation. Build the models, dashboards, and impact analyses that tell us what's working, where the gaps are, and where Harvey can create the most value. You make the numbers tell a clear story.

Build playbooks and frameworks that scale. Take what works in individual engagements and codify it into reusable playbooks, templates, and methodology. You're not producing one-off decks; you're building the operating system of the Transformation Office so every engagement gets faster, sharper, and more repeatable.

Capture best practices from strategic transformation engagements. Synthesize lessons learned from engagements into repeatable materials, stakeholder maps, workflow analyses, and tracking that keep engagements on plan. Sit close to live client work, own discrete workstreams, and take on more end-to-end responsibility as you grow.

Build executive-ready communications. Translate complex analysis into crisp narratives, decks, and one-pagers for senior partners, GCs, and internal leadership. You can hold a high bar on both rigor and polish, and you make complex things feel simple.

Drive cross-functional coordination. Act as connective tissue across Legal Engineering, GTM, and Customer Success — chasing down inputs, aligning teams, and making sure things actually move. You surface risk early and keep work on track without being asked.

Synthesize learnings and feed thought leadership. Capture patterns across engagements and turn them into internal knowledge and external thought leadership that sharpens how the market — and Harvey — thinks about AI transformation.

Travel required: up to 25% of the time.

What You Have

2–3 years at a top-tier strategy consulting firm (MBB — McKinsey, BCG, Bain — or equivalent), where you owned analytically rigorous workstreams on real, complex client problems.Exceptional quantitative and data analysis skills. You are deeply comfortable in Excel/Sheets, can structure messy data into clear insight, and build analyses leaders trust. Familiarity with BI tools (e.g. Omni, Looker, Tableau) or SQL is a plus, not a requirement.A track record of building playbooks, frameworks, or repeatable methodology — not just polished one-off deliverables.Exposure to transformation, change management, and strategy work, ideally in or adjacent to legal, financial services, or professional services.Outstanding written and verbal communication. You make complex things simple, write with precision, and can hold your own in a room with senior stakeholders.Comfort operating in ambiguity and a bias to action. You thrive where the playbook is still being written, and you'd rather ship and iterate than wait for perfect information.Genuine curiosity about AI and what it means for the future of professional work. You don't need to be a technologist, but you need to care deeply about the problem.

Compensation

$116,000 - 159,500 USD

About Gap

Gap has always been about optimistic American style. Starting with our very first store on Ocean Avenue in San Francisco, opened almost 50 years ago by Doris and Don Fisher. The thread that’s run through those five decades is the phenomenal people that make up our brand - our employees and our customers. People who are rooted in the legacy that makes Gap what it is, but who are also focused on the future. People who want to leave the world better than they found it.

We’ve built our brand on staying true to our roots while always being out in front of what’s next. If you want to be part of an iconic American brand, and help lead the way for where we’re headed, we’d love to have you join us.

About The Role

Gap Inc. is transforming how its brands use data and AI to make faster, more precise commercial decisions, and the Analyst, Pricing Analytics is where that analytical work gets executed. This role is the analytical foundation of the GAP brand's pricing intelligence function: the person who runs the day-to-day analytics, builds models that assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory, and validates outputs from pricing agents so the team has accurate, well-structured insight ready to inform pricing decisions. Reporting to the Manager, Pricing Analytics, you will support the execution of specific pricing analytics work streams within a single brand, spanning strategic pricing principles, discount spend, and in-season performance. You will develop and run repeatable analyses, track competitive price positioning, and produce clean, accurate analysis that your manager and team bring to Merchandising, Planning, and Finance partners. This role is designed for someone who is analytically precise, curious, and eager to build their skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment.

What you'll do

Execute Pricing Analytics 

Develop and execute repeatable analytics to inform the brand's pricing strategy, architecture, and tactics. Build models to assess the impact of pricing changes on sales, margin, and inventory. Support in-season analytics, including reconciling execution against forecasted performance and actuals and building "what if" scenarios for pricing strategies. Support analysis of discount spend and the measurement of the brand's strategic pricing principles. Identify opportunities to refine pricing strategies and provide actionable recommendations to cross-functional partners. 

Support Competitive Price Positioning 

Analyze internal and external data to guide competitive price positioning. Track competitive price positioning, communicating how the brand is executing compared to aligned benchmarks and validating that we are "doing what we say." 

Support Cross-Functional Partners 

Collaborate with Merchandising and Planning teams to improve pricing processes and ensure compliance. Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners on strategic pricing initiatives. Support continuous process improvement and cross-functional decision-making. Partner with the Manager, Pricing Analytics on ad-hoc pricing projects and initiatives that enhance overall pricing strategy and business performance. 

Apply AI and Contribute to the Function 

Apply quality checks to outputs from pricing agents, flagging inconsistencies or gaps before analysis moves forward. Simplify and automate repeatable, value-driven processes. Contribute to documentation of analytics processes and benchmarks as the function builds out its standards. 

Who you are

Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required. Preferred emphasis on analytics, data science, mathematics, business, supply chain, industrial engineering, finance, accounting, or economics. 1–3 years of experience in pricing analytics, competitive intelligence, or a related field; internship experience is welcome. Able to manipulate large data sets to interpret patterns and learnings; strong foundational understanding of data structures and algorithms. Problem solving and decision quality: able to use rigorous logic and some statistical methods to solve problems. Financial and business acumen: ability to evaluate financial and business indicators and translate data into actionable information to drive results; proficiency in retail math preferred. Systems and tools acumen: proficiency in Microsoft Excel with an aptitude to learn technical applications quickly; proficiency in Python and/or SQL preferred.

Leadership & Mindset 

Analytically precise: you take ownership of your work and hold a high personal bar for accuracy. Have a willingness to learn and be wrong. You must be able to speak with candor, listen for understanding, and receive feedback with humility. Curious and eager to grow, with a collaborative mindset that serves you well on a cross-functional team. Operate with a high degree of personal accountability to follow through with what you say you will do. Clear, focused communication needed, including an ability to simplify complex topics. Possess strong organizational and time management skills, with strong listening, written, and oral communication skills. Effective teamwork and partnership, and a genuine interest in building skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment. 

Salary Range: $76,400.00 - $95,500.00

Employee pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

rows.title: New Grad AI Engineer

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Nuvo

We’re Redefining the $11T B2B Commerce and Payments Market

Nuvo is bringing B2B commerce online.

While technology has reshaped consumer commerce, the business-to-business (B2B) economy — three times larger— has lagged behind.

From coffee to lumber, every product we use has been traded through a complex supply chain of suppliers, manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers. Despite the massive scale of this market, most businesses manage their trading relationships and commerce activities using outdated methods like paper forms, PDFs, emails, faxes, phone calls, and spreadsheets, making processes slow and inefficient.

Much like how Shopify, Stripe and Square have transformed how consumer companies transact, we aim to do the same for B2B companies.

About The Role

We are looking for smart engineers to help build category-defining products. Our problems span scaling AI agents, multi-agent workflows that automate risk and payments, and running agents on large scale data. You'll partner with our engineering, design and product teams to help shape the roadmap, solve real world problems and build our 0-1 products. Your work will have huge impact: on team culture, on our customers and on the economy.

What You’ll Do

Build the AI systems that automate real trade workflows: collections, credit decisioning, payments operations, and the manual work that slows the physical economy down.Turn LLMs and agents into reliable, production-grade features, not demos, with the evals and guardrails to back them.Write high-quality, clean and performant code and partner with platform and product engineers to ship end to end.Help shape how Nuvo builds with AI as both the field and our product move quickly.Use the best tools for the job. What matters is whether the system works in production, not which model or framework you used.

What You Bring

Strong CS fundamentals plus hands-on experience building with modern ML or LLMs (coursework, research, internships, or projects you can show).Good judgment about where AI genuinely helps versus where it adds risk, and a rigorous approach to evaluating output quality.The ability to communicate technical solutions and tradeoffs clearly.Excitement to work in an early-stage team solving ambiguous problems with a strong bias for action.

rows.title: Quantum EDA Software Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Introduction

At IBM Research, we are the innovation engine of IBM. Exploring what'ss next in computing and shaping the technologies the world will rely on tomorrow. From advancing AI and hybrid cloud to pioneering practical quantum computing, we anticipate challenges and unlock new opportunities for clients, partners, and society. Working in Research means joining a team that accelerates discovery at the intersection of high-performance computing, AI, quantum, and cloud. You'll collaborate with leading scientists, engineers, and visionaries to push boundaries and turn ideas into reality. With a culture built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration, IBM Research offers the opportunity to grow your career while contributing to breakthroughs that transform industries and change the world.

Your Role And Responsibilities

The successful candidate will join the quantum electronic design automation (EDA) effort at IBM Quantum and participate in development of the cutting-edge tools being used for designing quantum processor and testsite modules targeting IBM's proprietary superconducting technology. The role will be responsible for software engineering in support of the internal EDA ecosystem used to deliver IBM's flagship quantum processing units. The toolset of interest includes both internally developed software and industry-standard tools for hardware design, and the role requires strong spatial reasoning skills in addition to a core foundation in modern software engineering. Experience with EDA tool usage or development in the areas of routing and circuit optimization is strongly desired, as is the relevant mathematical expertise in optimization and graph theory. Experience with quantum computing hardware is also a bonus, but not required. Because the role includes collaboration between several diverse and dynamic teams of technical and operations personnel, good communication skills, initiative, and a strong sense of responsibility are key.

Responsibilities Include

 Building user-friendly, robust software tools for making quantum computing hardware Participation in development of hardware design methodologies Verification of tools using software development best practices Development and implementation of algorithms for quantum computing hardware design Active support/debug for tool end-users

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

 Python (high familiarity) Linux Object-oriented programming git Spatial reasoning and quantitative geometric skills

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

 Tcl C++ Rust Experience with CI/CD pipelines Background in optimization and graph theory Industry-grade EDA tool experience (tools from Cadence, Synopsys, Keysight etc.)

rows.title: Solutions Engineer

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
The world’s largest law firm won’t be a law firm. Join us in building it.

August allows law firms to compound their expertise by building an autonomous organization of AI agents that run the firm's knowledge work. We partner closely with our firms and grow alongside them through sharing revenue on our agents and equity in the firms we transform.

We believe that in five years, more than 95% of legal work will be concentrated among a select few elite law firms. The firms that get there will be the ones that rebuild how they deliver it. We're partnering with those firms and building the engine they run on to become the biggest legal service provider in the world.

We invest in partnerships, not just licenses. We sell finished legal work alongside our firms and take a share of what it earns. This enables them to scale their services and lets us grow along with it. That means we’re chasing the legal services market ($1T), which dwarfs the global legal tech market ($40b).

The problem is hard. An engine of agents sits underneath every matter we touch, connected to every step of a lawyer's workflow, in an industry where there is no margin for error. We’re challenged with building the perfectly accurate, infallibly secure, and yet all-powerful engine for legal work.

We're already live with several excellent firms and the early results are better than we expected. Lean team, in person, New York, backed by leading investors, growing fast.

Every role at August is a chance to remake an industry while the window is open.

About The Role

As a Solutions Engineer, you will work directly with law firms to turn complex legal workflows into working AI solutions. You will embed with clients, understand their processes and technical environment, and own deployments from discovery and prototyping through integration, go-live, and adoption. This is a hands-on, client-facing role: you will run working sessions, build and test solutions, troubleshoot issues, and help people put AI to work. You should enjoy getting into the technical details as much as explaining what you’ve built to the people who will use it.

What you’ll do

Embed with client organizations and run structured discovery across teams and practice groups, mapping workflows, systems, and data flows to identify where AI can have the greatest impact. Work one-on-one with lawyers, paralegals, legal ops staff, and technical stakeholders to translate day-to-day pain points into clear requirements and practical solutions. Build and test lightweight proofs-of-concept for document review, form filling, intake, drafting, redlining, and matter management, using APIs, scripts, and workflow automation tools where needed. Configure AI workflows and connect them to client systems, working with technical teams on integrations, troubleshooting, and validation before rollout. Run hands-on demos and training sessions that help users understand how the solutions work and adopt them in their daily practice. Own the go-live from kickoff through adoption, coordinating technical resources on both sides and resolving issues as they arise. Serve as a trusted technical point of contact for client stakeholders, running structured check-ins and business reviews to understand what’s working and what needs improvement. Translate findings from deployments into actionable feedback for August’s engineering team, including reproducible issues, integration needs, and opportunities to improve the product. 

What we’re looking for

Strong technical problem-solving skills: you can break down an unfamiliar workflow, understand how its systems fit together, and build a practical solution. Comfort writing lightweight scripts, working with APIs and structured data, and debugging integrations. Experience with Python or JavaScript is especially useful. Strong product sense: you understand what makes a workflow painful and can translate that understanding into something people actually use. Business acumen and clear communication: you can earn trust with a managing partner, a legal ops analyst, and a technical stakeholder, and explain complex ideas in straightforward terms. Natural curiosity and comfort with ambiguity: you ask good questions, investigate beyond the obvious answer, and take ownership when there is no established playbook. 1–3 years of experience in solutions engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, software engineering, or a similarly hands-on technical role. Experience working directly with customers is valuable; a background in law or legal services is a plus. Familiarity with AI tools, LLM-powered applications, or workflow automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, or n8n is helpful. Excitement about working in person at our NYC office with a team that values precision, pace, and constant reinvention. 

Benefits

Medical insurance coverageFlexible PTOParental LeaveCentralized office equipment ordering for all employeesEquinox or Chelsea Piers gym membershipIn-office perks: lunch, dinner, snacks, drinks, and moreBudget for intra-office travelTeam-building eventsRelocation support to NYC (as needed)

Why Join August

Founding Impact: Shape not just your role but the company. Uncapped Upside: Competitive base + commission, early equity ownership. Top-tier Team: Work alongside people who move fast, think clearly, and care deeply. Category-Defining Work: Help build the first true AI agents for the legal profession. Fast Growth: Scale your career as we scale the company. In-person in NYC: Collaborative, talent dense and high energy environmentGlobal Reach: Our clients span 4 continents and use August in multiple languages and jurisdictionsFrontier of Applied AI: August has access to proprietary data inaccessible to foundation model providers. We build agents to automate all challenging knowledge work. 

Compensation Range: $100K - $160K

About Nuvo

We’re Redefining the $11T B2B Commerce and Payments Market

Nuvo is bringing B2B commerce online.

While technology has reshaped consumer commerce, the business-to-business (B2B) economy — three times larger— has lagged behind.

From coffee to lumber, every product we use has been traded through a complex supply chain of suppliers, manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers. Despite the massive scale of this market, most businesses manage their trading relationships and commerce activities using outdated methods like paper forms, PDFs, emails, faxes, phone calls, and spreadsheets, making processes slow and inefficient.

Much like how Shopify, Stripe and Square have transformed how consumer companies transact, we aim to do the same for B2B companies.

About The Role

We are looking for smart engineers to help build category-defining products. Our problems span scaling AI agents, multi-agent workflows that automate risk and payments, and running agents on large scale data. You'll partner with our engineering, design and product teams to help shape the roadmap, solve real world problems and build our 0-1 products. Your work will have huge impact: on team culture, on our customers and on the economy.

What You’ll Do

Build the AI systems that automate real trade workflows: collections, credit decisioning, payments operations, and the manual work that slows the physical economy down.Turn LLMs and agents into reliable, production-grade features, not demos, with the evals and guardrails to back them.Write high-quality, clean and performant code and partner with platform and product engineers to ship end to end.Help shape how Nuvo builds with AI as both the field and our product move quickly.Use the best tools for the job. rows.title: AI Summer Intern – Data Science & AI

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
We are seeking a highly motivated and talented individual to join Trinity Life Sciences as an AI Intern on our Data Science & AI team. In this role, the intern will assist in developing and implementing artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, and analytics solutions for various applications supporting Trinity’s pharmaceutical and life sciences clients. Projects may include generative AI, predictive analytics, forecasting, segmentation, patient finding, HCP targeting, and other advanced analytical solutions. Interns will work closely with our team of data scientists, consultants, and engineers to research, design, and implement cutting-edge AI and data science solutions.

Interns develop their skills through undergoing extensive formal and informal training, as well as receiving mentorship that encourages them to stretch their skills in a real-world setting. This is a 9-week internship program based out of Trinity’s office in New York, NY – interns will be required to work in a hybrid work model, coming into the office about 2–3 days per week.

This is a 9-week, in-person summer internship and the program will run from mid-June 14 to mid-August 2027. Interns will be paid $35/hour and can expect to work 40 hours/week.

Applicants for this position must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship. Trinity is unable to consider candidates requiring sponsorship for visas, including but not limited to TN, H1-B, F-1, and STEM OPT.

Position Responsibilities

Assist in developing and implementing AI, machine learning, and generative AI solutions as part of projects for Trinity’s life sciences clients.Conduct research to identify AI models, analytical approaches, tools, and implementation techniques suited for specific client and business use cases.Analyze and evaluate the performance of AI models and solutions.Test and validate AI models and analytical approaches using real-world healthcare and life sciences data.Collaborate with team members to design and develop model enhancements, refinements, and proof-of-concept solutions.Support the Data Science & AI team in developing materials for business-development activities, including AI-related proposals, pitches, solution overviews, and presentations.Assist in preparing technical reports, presentations, documentation, and other materials that clearly communicate analytical approaches and findings.

Position Requirements

Candidates should be enrolled in a graduate or undergraduate program in computer science, data science, engineering, statistics, mathematics, or a related field. Trinity is targeting current Juniors, or students in a master’s program with 1 year left in their studies.

Required Skills

Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, SQL).Familiarity with artificial intelligence, machine learning, large language models, and/or agentic frameworks.Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Value-Added Skills

Experience developing AI, machine learning, or generative AI solutions in an academic or corporate setting. Familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Pytorch or KerasExperience working with large language models, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) flows. Experience with natural language processing (NLP), image processing, or other applied AI techniques.Experience analyzing healthcare, pharmaceutical, claims, clinical, commercial, or other real-world data.Experience translating technical concepts and analytical findings into presentations, technical documentation, or materials for nontechnical audiences.

About Us

Trinity powers the future of life sciences commercialization through the fusion of human and artificial intelligence. By blending deep therapeutic expertise and trusted human ingenuity with a purpose-built technology platform, Trinity accelerates clarity and confidence at every step of the commercialization journey—from pre-launch to scale to loss of exclusivity. For more than 30 years, the world’s leading pharmaceutical, biotech, and medtech companies have relied on Trinity’s foresight, execution, and partnership to deliver confident product launches, decisive market advantage, and measurable patient impact. During that time, Trinity expanded from its first office in Waltham, MA to 1,300 professionals across 14 offices and five continents, setting new industry standards in quality, responsiveness, and client partnership. For more information, visit Trinity at www.trinitylifesciences.com.

Trinity’s Commitment to Inclusion & Engagement (I&E)

Trinity Life Sciences is an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals. At Trinity, inclusion and engagement are at the heart of how we work and grow together. We’ve evolved from a traditional “DEI” framework to Inclusion & Engagement (I&E)—a model that moves beyond representation to focus on connection, collaboration, and shared purpose. Every role at Trinity plays a part in fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute fully. By embedding I&E principles into our culture, we ensure that belonging and engagement are not standalone initiatives—they are part of how we build teams, make decisions, and deliver excellence every day. Trinity will not tolerate any form of discrimination or harassment and encourages applicants of all ages and identities. For more information about Trinity’s commitment to Inclusion and Engagement please visit Inclusion & Engagement | Culture of Belonging at Trinity Life Sciences.

Description

Job Description

Department: Center for Child Health Services Research (CCHSR), Mindich Child Health and Development Institute, Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai

Position Summary/Overview

The Center for Child Health Services Research (CCHSR), Mindich Child Health and Development Institute, Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai, is seeking a full-time Postdoctoral Fellow to work with Brett Anderson, MD, MBA, Director of CCHSR and Associate Professor of Pediatrics and Population Health Science and Policy. The fellow will conduct NIH-funded health services and outcomes research focused on healthcare utilization, insurance coverage, healthcare expenditures, and long-term outcomes among pediatric and adult populations with complex medical conditions.

Working with Dr. Anderson and a multidisciplinary team of clinicians, epidemiologists, health economists, statisticians, and policy researchers, the fellow will conduct longitudinal analyses of healthcare utilization patterns and evaluate the impact of policies on access to care and clinical outcomes. The fellow will contribute to the development and validation of administrative claims-based methodologies and generate policy-relevant evidence that can improve healthcare delivery and health outcomes. This position offers opportunities for peer-reviewed publications, national conference presentations, interdisciplinary collaboration, grant development, and advanced mentorship in health services research, outcomes research, healthcare policy evaluation, administrative claims analysis, and causal inference methods.

Responsibilities

The ideal candidate will be:

Interested in health services research, healthcare policy, and cardiovascular outcomes research.An effective scientific communicator.Organized and detail oriented.Able to work independently while collaborating within a multidisciplinary research team.Committed to rigorous, reproducible, and policy-relevant research.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Conduct analyses of large administrative claims and clinical registry.Develop and validate administrative claims-based methodologies for identifying clinical populations and evaluating healthcare outcomes.Perform longitudinal analyses of healthcare utilization, expenditures, insurance coverage, and patient outcomes.Apply epidemiologic, biostatistical, econometric, and causal inference methods to evaluate healthcare policy impacts.Analyze linked Medicaid, commercial insurance, and registry datasetsDevelop reproducible analytic workflows and maintain well-documented programming code.Conduct literature reviews and synthesize findings from published scientific literature.Contribute to collaborative manuscripts, scientific abstracts, conference presentations, and policy-facing products.Participate in meetings with investigators and collaborators across research networks.Assist with preparation of grant reports, progress reports, and future funding applications.Ensure compliance with NIH, HIPAA, IRB, and institutional research policies.Maintain data security and adherence to all applicable data use agreements.

Qualifications

Preferred Experience

Experience working with administrative claims databases, clinical registries, electronic health record data, or other population-based datasets.Familiarity with epidemiologic methods, causal inference, health policy evaluation, or outcomes research.Experience conducting healthcare utilization, policy, or outcomes research.Knowledge of health services research methodologies and population health analytics.

MD, DO, PhD, MD/PhD, DrPH, ScD, or equivalent doctoral degree in a relevant clinical, quantitative, population health, or healthcare research discipline. Candidates completing residency training and pursuing advanced research training are encouraged to apply.

Work Environment

The role includes participation in collaborative meetings with investigators and stakeholders across multiple institutions.

Introduction

IBM Quantum is building and operating some of the world's most advanced quantum computing systems, delivered to clients and researchers through IBM Cloud. rows.title: Computational Linguistics Tenure-Track Assistant Professor
rows.descriptionText:
The School of Psychology and Cognitive Science at the Rochester Institute of Technology invites applications for a full-time, 9-month tenure-track Assistant Professor of Computational Linguistics, beginning in August 2027. Candidates are expected to have an earned doctoral degree (in hand by August 2027) in Linguistics, Computational Linguistics, or a related field. The position additionally offers an affiliation with the Department of Modern Languages and Cultures in the School of Languages, Humanities, and Social Sciences.

Successful candidates should demonstrate computational expertise, strong research talent, and initiative in grant writing. Candidates should also have a plan for excellence in teaching and student mentoring at the undergraduate and graduate levels. Applicants must be able to teach our courses in language technology and large language models, natural language processing, and/or computational speech processing. In addition, applicants should be able to teach foundational linguistics from a cross-linguistic perspective, as well as courses in at least one additional linguistics, artificial intelligence, or cognitive science subfield. Proficiency in an additional language other than English is preferred, and we welcome research or teaching experience involving language learning. The position requires a commitment to teaching and mentoring, active research and publication, and a strong potential to attract external funding. Research and teaching are priorities for faculty at RIT, and all faculty are expected to mentor graduate and undergraduate students through advising, research, and in-class experiences.

The computational linguistics-related programs at RIT serve a rapidly expanding student population at a technical university. We are looking for a faculty colleague who can also contribute to the interdisciplinary M.S. program in Artificial Intelligence and the Ph.D. program in Cognitive Science. Our coursework is also offered to B.S. in Artificial Intelligence majors. In addition, RIT provides many opportunities for collaborative research across the institute in areas such as linguistics of sign languages and languages other than English, artificial intelligence, human-centered computing, and cybersecurity. RIT faculty have access to extensive research computing resources.

Required Minimum Qualifications

 Ph.D. (in hand by August 2027) in Linguistics, Computational Linguistics, or a related field. Have demonstrated ability to conduct independent research in computational linguistics. Demonstrate potential for external research grant attainment. Have consistently and recently published in computational linguistics. Demonstrate potential for excellence in teaching language technology, natural language processing, and/or computational speech processing. Demonstrate potential for excellence in teaching foundational linguistics from a cross-linguistic perspective, and courses in at least one more linguistics, artificial intelligence, or cognitive science subfield. Demonstrate potential for excellence in supervising graduate and undergraduate student research. Show a career trajectory that emphasizes a balance between research and teaching.

Candidates should be enrolled in a graduate or undergraduate program in computer science, data science, engineering, statistics, mathematics, or a related field. Trinity is targeting current Juniors, or students in a master’s program with 1 year left in their studies.

Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, SQL).Familiarity with artificial intelligence, machine learning, large language models, and/or agentic frameworks.Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Value-Added Skills

Experience developing AI, machine learning, or generative AI solutions in an academic or corporate setting. Familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Pytorch or KerasExperience working with large language models, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) flows. Experience with natural language processing (NLP), image processing, or other applied AI techniques.Experience analyzing healthcare, pharmaceutical, claims, clinical, commercial, or other real-world data.Experience translating technical concepts and analytical findings into presentations, technical documentation, or materials for nontechnical audiences.

Trinity powers the future of life sciences commercialization through the fusion of human and artificial intelligence. About Nuvo

We’re Redefining the $11T B2B Commerce and Payments Market

Nuvo is bringing B2B commerce online.

While technology has reshaped consumer commerce, the business-to-business (B2B) economy — three times larger— has lagged behind.

From coffee to lumber, every product we use has been traded through a complex supply chain of suppliers, manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers. Despite the massive scale of this market, most businesses manage their trading relationships and commerce activities using outdated methods like paper forms, PDFs, emails, faxes, phone calls, and spreadsheets, making processes slow and inefficient.

Much like how Shopify, Stripe and Square have transformed how consumer companies transact, we aim to do the same for B2B companies.

About The Role

We are looking for smart engineers to help build category-defining products. Our problems span scaling AI agents, multi-agent workflows that automate risk and payments, and running agents on large scale data. You'll partner with our engineering, design and product teams to help shape the roadmap, solve real world problems and build our 0-1 products. Your work will have huge impact: on team culture, on our customers and on the economy.

What You’ll Do

Build the AI systems that automate real trade workflows: collections, credit decisioning, payments operations, and the manual work that slows the physical economy down.Turn LLMs and agents into reliable, production-grade features, not demos, with the evals and guardrails to back them.Write high-quality, clean and performant code and partner with platform and product engineers to ship end to end.Help shape how Nuvo builds with AI as both the field and our product move quickly.Use the best tools for the job. What matters is whether the system works in production, not which model or framework you used.

What You Bring

Strong CS fundamentals plus hands-on experience building with modern ML or LLMs (coursework, research, internships, or projects you can show).Good judgment about where AI genuinely helps versus where it adds risk, and a rigorous approach to evaluating output quality.The ability to communicate technical solutions and tradeoffs clearly.Excitement to work in an early-stage team solving ambiguous problems with a strong bias for action.

rows.title: Senior Engineer – Scalable Quantitative Computing & Data Infrastructure

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
A leading New York-based structured credit investment firm is building a next-generation scalable computing, data, and analytics platform to significantly increase the speed and capacity of its quantitative investment processes.We are seeking a senior engineer with hands-on experience building large-scale computing platforms, data infrastructure, and analytics systems. The strongest candidates will have worked on technology designed to process large volumes of data and computationally intensive analytical workloads across multiple users, models, and applications.This is not primarily an application-development or desk-modeling role. The focus is on building the underlying infrastructure that quantitative researchers, developers, and investment professionals will use for pricing, valuation, forecasting, modeling, and analytics.
Key ResponsibilitiesArchitect and build scalable computing and analytics infrastructure for computationally intensive quantitative workloads.Design distributed and parallel computing frameworks capable of substantially increasing processing capacity and speed.Build scalable data pipelines, data services, APIs, and analytical infrastructure supporting multiple models and applications.Develop reusable computational libraries and services used across quantitative development teams.Leverage cloud computing, distributed systems, Kubernetes, containers, and modern data-engineering technologies.Improve performance, scalability, reliability, deployment, testing, and monitoring of a large quantitative platform.Partner with quantitative researchers and investment professionals to translate complex analytical requirements into scalable production systems.
Core Qualifications5+ years building large-scale computing, data, or analytics platforms.Demonstrated experience with distributed computing, parallel processing, high-performance computing, or large-scale data processing.Strong background in data engineering and analytics infrastructure, including pipelines, data services, and high-volume processing.Experience architecting shared platforms used by multiple developers, models, or applications.Strong Python and/or C++ engineering skills.Experience with cloud infrastructure such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.Experience with technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, distributed processing, workflow orchestration, and automated testing.
Highly DesirableExperience building infrastructure for quantitative finance, fixed income, structured credit, pricing, valuation, risk, scientific computing, or other computationally intensive environments.The ideal candidate combines scalable systems engineering, data engineering, and quantitative computing and has built infrastructure that materially increased an organization's analytical capacity and speed.
Keywords:Software Engineer, Python, Fixed Income Analytics, Cloud Platforms, CI/CD pipelines, ML and AI financial applications
Please send resume to Jim Geiger jeg@analyticrecruiting.com

You will build and own applications end to end, from requirements through deployment and ongoing enhancement, working directly with business stakeholders.

Business PartnershipWork directly with business stakeholders to understand processes, pain points, and data needs, and translate them into clear technical requirementsValidate outputs with end users and iterate based on feedbackHelp identify operational inefficiencies, risks, and cost-saving opportunities through application and analysis work

Quality and OperationsFollow and help shape development standards, testing, and documentation practicesSupport deployment across development and production environmentsMaintain and improve existing applications after release
Qualifications:
RequiredStrong Python and SQL fundamentalsExperience developing data-driven applicationsAbility to work across data transformation, backend logic, and application developmentHands-on experience with AI-assisted development workflowsAbility and willingness to learn and develop within Palantir FoundryStrong analytical and problem-solving skillsAbility to translate business requirements into technical solutionsComfort owning products through development, testing, deployment, and maintenanceBachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience3-6 years of relevant experience
PreferredPrior experience with Palantir Foundry (Ontology, Workshop, pipelines)Experience with Streamlit, React, or similar application frameworksFamiliarity with deployment automation and cloud environments such as AzureExposure to finance, accounting, aviation, asset leasing, or MRO dataExperience building or integrating LLM-powered applications

rows.descriptionText:
Summary: The IOPS AI Engineer is a skilled professional responsible for developing and deploying complex artificial intelligence (AI) solutions to solve specific business challenges within the IOPS organization.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following:

 Develop and implement AI solutions (e.g., deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision) to address specific business challenges. Train, evaluate, and fine-tune AI models to achieve optimal performance metrics.

Monitor model performance in production environments and identify areas for improvement.

 Design and build scalable AI infrastructure, including data pipelines, model serving frameworks, and cloud-based deployment architectures. Optimize AI systems for performance and efficiency, considering latency, throughput, and resource utilization. Provide technical expertise to cross-functional teams, including product managers, data scientists, and software engineers. Work closely with stakeholders to understand business needs, translate them into actionable AI solutions, and clearly communicate technical concepts. Collaborate with data scientists to collect, analyze, and interpret large datasets to inform model development. Present findings and recommendations to leadership teams, ensuring alignment with business objectives. Stay abreast of the latest advancements in AI research and technologies to identify potential applications within the organization. Perform other duties as assigned.

Education And Experience

 Assoc Engineer: BS/BA in IT, Scientific or Engineering discipline (Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering) or related field. Engineer: BS/BA in IT, Scientific or Engineering discipline (Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering) or related field along with 2+ years of experience or equivalent combination of education and experience. Sr Engineer: BS/BA in IT, Scientific or Engineering discipline (Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering) or related field along with 5+ years of experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Deep understanding of AI algorithms, machine learning techniques (e.g., deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision), and related software frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).Proficiency in programming languages like Python, experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and knowledge of software development methodologies.

rows.title: AI Engineer II - Enterprise Architecture

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

At American Express, AI is reshaping the future of commerce and redefining the experiences our commercial customers and card members expect. Within Amex Technology, we are building platforms, products, and governance that enable agentic AI systems to operate responsibly and at scale across the enterprise.

Our focus is on agentic AI development: designing intelligent, adaptive systems that can plan, reason, and act across complex workflows with appropriate levels of autonomy. These systems power autonomous workflows, decision support, and customer-facing experiences—while meeting the high standards for security, explainability, reliability, and compliance required in financial services.

We partner closely with product, design, and business teams to deliver agentic capabilities that reduce operational friction, improve decision-making, and transform how customers interact, transact, and grow.

The Role

As an AI Engineer – Agentic AI, you will be a hands-on builder contributing to the development of production agentic AI systems that operate on real financial data and serve real customers.

You will work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to design, build, and ship AI-powered features, while learning how to operate within a regulated, customer-facing environment. This role offers strong mentorship and opportunities to grow your technical depth in LLMs, agentic systems, and production AI engineering.

This is not a research-only role. You will write production code, contribute to system design discussions, and help operate what you build after launch, with support and guidance from more senior engineers.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

 Contribute to the design and implementation of LLM-powered and agentic product features.  Build and extend agentic AI workflows that reason over context, call tools, and perform actions under guidance from senior engineers.  Help implement and maintain retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over financial data, with an emphasis on correctness and safety.  Contribute to shared AI infrastructure such as LLM services, orchestration components, and evaluation or monitoring tooling.  Participate in operating AI systems in production, including monitoring, debugging, and improving reliability and performance.  Collaborate closely with product and design partners, learning to translate customer needs into technical solutions. 

Technical Environment

We don’t hire to a narrow checklist, but candidates should be excited to grow in a modern, enterprise-scale engineering environment with a focus on agentic AI.

Core engineering stack

 Languages: Python, Go, TypeScript  Cloud and infrastructure: AWS and/or GCP, Kubernetes  APIs and services: REST, gRPC  Distributed systems: event-driven architectures, including Kafka 

Agentic AI and ML 

 Commercial and open-source LLMs integrated into agentic workflows  Tooling for agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, vector storage, and evaluation  Schema validation and structured data handling 

AI-assisted development

 Use of AI-assisted and agentic development tools for design, implementation, testing, debugging, and refactoring  Learning how to apply these tools responsibly while maintaining production-quality standards 

All systems are built to meet high standards for reliability, security, and auditability, reflecting the responsibility of deploying autonomous AI in a financial services environment.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

 2+ years of professional software engineering experience.  Some hands-on experience building or contributing to AI-powered features, LLM-based applications, or applied ML systems (professional or project-based).  Solid engineering fundamentals in at least one backend language (Python, Go, or TypeScript).  Familiarity with APIs, basic cloud concepts, and modern development practices.  Interest in agentic AI systems, autonomy, and AI-assisted development workflows.  Willingness to learn, take feedback, and grow technical ownership over time.  Comfort working in collaborative, cross-functional teams.  A strong customer mindset and curiosity about real-world problem solving. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Exposure to LLM tooling, prompt engineering, RAG, or agent frameworks through work, coursework, or personal projects.  Internship or early-career experience in fintech or other regulated environments.  Contributions to open-source projects, hackathons, or side projects related to AI or developer tooling.

Depending on factors such as business unit requirements, the nature of the position, cost and applicable laws, American Express may provide visa sponsorship for certain positions. 

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

For positions covered by federal and/or state banking regulations, American Express will comply with such regulations as it relates to the consideration of applicants with criminal convictions.

rows.descriptionText:
About Nuvo

We’re Redefining the $11T B2B Commerce and Payments Market

Nuvo is bringing B2B commerce online.

While technology has reshaped consumer commerce, the business-to-business (B2B) economy — three times larger— has lagged behind.

From coffee to lumber, every product we use has been traded through a complex supply chain of suppliers, manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers. Despite the massive scale of this market, most businesses manage their trading relationships and commerce activities using outdated methods like paper forms, PDFs, emails, faxes, phone calls, and spreadsheets, making processes slow and inefficient.

Much like how Shopify, Stripe and Square have transformed how consumer companies transact, we aim to do the same for B2B companies.

About The Role

We are looking for smart engineers to help build category-defining products. Our problems span scaling AI agents, multi-agent workflows that automate risk and payments, and running agents on large scale data. You'll partner with our engineering, design and product teams to help shape the roadmap, solve real world problems and build our 0-1 products. Your work will have huge impact: on team culture, on our customers and on the economy.

What You’ll Do

Build the AI systems that automate real trade workflows: collections, credit decisioning, payments operations, and the manual work that slows the physical economy down.Turn LLMs and agents into reliable, production-grade features, not demos, with the evals and guardrails to back them.Write high-quality, clean and performant code and partner with platform and product engineers to ship end to end.Help shape how Nuvo builds with AI as both the field and our product move quickly.Use the best tools for the job. What matters is whether the system works in production, not which model or framework you used.

What You Bring

Strong CS fundamentals plus hands-on experience building with modern ML or LLMs (coursework, research, internships, or projects you can show).Good judgment about where AI genuinely helps versus where it adds risk, and a rigorous approach to evaluating output quality.The ability to communicate technical solutions and tradeoffs clearly.Excitement to work in an early-stage team solving ambiguous problems with a strong bias for action.

rows.title: Analyst, Commercial Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world’s leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

At KAYAK, data is how we make better decisions for travelers and partners alike — and the Commercial Analytics team is at the center of that work. As an Analyst on this globally distributed team, you'll help turn commercial data into clear, actionable insights that directly support revenue decisions across flights, hotels, cars, and advertising, working closely with colleagues across North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific.

This role will be required to work from our Cambridge, MA office at least 3 days per week.

In This Role, You Will

Analyze commercial datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and performance drivers across travel verticals including flights, hotels, cars, and advertisingBuild and maintain dashboards and reports using data visualization and reporting tools to give commercial teams timely visibility into business performanceRespond to ad-hoc data and analysis requests from commercial teamsMonitor data accuracy, troubleshoot discrepancies, and maintain reporting reliability across existing data sourcesDefine and document key performance indicators (KPIs) in collaboration with commercial teams, and build models to support forecasting and goal-settingCollaborate with data engineering and business intelligence colleagues to ensure data quality and translate commercial reporting needs into technical requirementsContribute to global analytics projects such as inventory forecasting, partner-facing reporting tools, and the development of AI-assisted analytics solutionsPresent findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior commercial leaders.

Please Apply If You Have

At least 2 years of experience working with data in an analytical, business intelligence, operations, or similar role — we value demonstrated ability and transferable skills; equivalent experience, training, or self-directed learning is consideredAt least 2 years of hands-on SQL experience, writing queries to explore and manipulate large datasetsHands-on experience with at least one data visualization or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Superset, Power BI, or a comparable platform)The ability to communicate data findings clearly to people with varying levels of technical background, including in written summaries and presentationsCuriosity, attention to detail, and an enjoyment of working through ambiguous problems using dataComfort working in a global, cross-functional environment with colleagues across multiple time zones

To Stand Out, You Also Have

Experience with Python or R for data manipulation, automation, or modelingFamiliarity with the travel, e-commerce, or digital advertising industryExperience working with AI or agentic analytics toolsExposure to large-scale data warehouse environments (e.g., Trino, Vertica, or similar).

Benefits And Perks

Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per yearFocus on mental health and well-being:Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealthCompany-paid subscription to HeadSpaceCompany-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)No meeting FridaysPaid parental leaveGenerous paid vacation + time off for your birthdayPaid volunteer timeFocus on your career growth:Development DollarsLeadership developmentAccess to thousands of on-demand e-learningsTravel DiscountsEmployee Resource GroupsCompetitive retirement and health plansFree lunch 2 days per weekFun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday socials, and more
There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts-based role is $90,000-$105,000.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need an accommodation for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you.

rows.title: Intern- Robot Perception
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

Timeframe{{:}} Summer (May-Aug 2027)

At Symbotic, Early Career talent plays a meaningful role in helping us reimagine the future of supply chain automation. Through our Internship and Co-op programs, students have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, collaborate with experienced engineers and business leaders, and gain hands-on exposure to the technologies powering our end-to-end robotics and automation solutions. We are looking for curious, motivated students who are excited to solve complex problems, bring new perspectives to cross-functional teams, and see their work make an impact in a fast-moving, innovative environment.

Along the way, Interns and Co-ops are supported through mentorship, professional development, networking opportunities, and a robust calendar of events designed to help them build community and grow their careers. Symbotic offers transportation and housing benefits for students who meet our relocation requirements.

Continue reading below to learn more about this exciting opportunity!

About The Opportunities

Symbotic’s Robot Perception team is an accomplished group of engineers who are working on sophisticated algorithms in areas such as perception and computer vision.

Perception and Computer Vision interns will evaluate and propose new projects for replacing legacy tools with vision-based algorithms. These interns will scope projects from literature review, to dataset design and aggregation, training pipeline development, all the way through production deployment. Practical projects include vision-based collision avoidance. SLAM interns will develop and test algorithms for robust robot localization in complex, real-world environments, applying sensor fusion, state estimation, and probabilistic methods to solve SLAM challenges at scale. 

What You’ll Do

Research and experiment with traditional computer vision methods and deep learning methods for object detection, classification, segmentation, pose estimation, anomaly detection on images or videos. Evaluate and benchmark computer vision methods on production data. Deploy software to production on robot hardware. Design data pre and post processing methods. Document designs, code, experiments, evaluations. Identify high-impact scenarios where AI Planning and machine learning can be applied to optimize the Symbotic robotics software. Adapt state-of-the-art approaches or develop high-performance algorithms to solve real-world multi-robot problems. Conduct simulations and experiments to validate the performance of the multi-robot algorithms. Present results in verbal and written communications internally, and in top-tier academic venues. 

What You’ll Need

Pursuing a Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field. Proficiency in Python and/or C++, including experience writing code and working in Jupyter notebooks. Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Familiarity with computer vision and perception tools such as OpenCV, including image classification, object detection, segmentation, and camera calibration. Exposure to robotics perception concepts such as sensor fusion, SLAM, 3D pose representations, coordinate transforms, probabilistic graphical models, and Bayesian inference. Working knowledge of sensors, including RGB cameras, 3D sensors, and point cloud processing tools such as PCL. Experience working in Linux environments and using command-line tools. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, REST APIs, and/or SQL-based data tools such as Snowflake. Exposure to deployment or optimization tools such as Docker, ROS/ROS 2, Jetson, ONNX, VLMs, or Vision-Language-Action models is a plus. 

What’s Good To Have

Publications at high-impact conferences/journals (e.g., CoRL, ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, RSS, ICRA, IROS, RAL, AAAI, ICAPS, IJCAI, JAIR, etc.) 

Our Environment 

Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations. The employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed on a bi-weekly basis. 

About Symbotic

Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com.

rows.title: Revenue Integrity Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Under the managerial oversight of the Director the Revenue Integrity Analyst serves as a primary point of contact for Service Line Directors, Managers, Finance Directors, clinical support staff, Physicians, allied health care providers, hospital colleagues and others regarding matters that relate to aspects of professional and hospital revenue charge capture and other matters relating to professional and hospital revenue cycle and modality specific billing processes and/or workflows. The Revenue Integrity Analyst is responsible for educating providers, clinical colleagues and other members of their assigned modality specific revenue cycle teams regarding accurate professional and facility billing and revenue capture while adhering to CMS and third party payer regulations. The Revenue Integrity Analyst is responsible for assisting in the implementation of new revenue capture procedure records within the hospital chargemaster (CDM) and the development of workflows to ensure timely and accurate capture of all Lahey Health System revenue. The Revenue Integrity Analyst seeks to improve workflow, efficiency, accuracy, reimbursement and overall revenue cycle billing through operational and system enhancements and/or modifications. The Revenue Integrity Analyst is responsible to ensure that Lahey Health is maximizing accurate gross revenue capture to ensure maximum net revenue reimbursement is attained, sustained, and supported.

Job Description

Essential Duties & Responsibilities including but not limited to: 

 Responsible to provide a high level of all-around Revenue Cycle support for professional service on and off site locations staff, hospital facilities clinical staff, PFS professional and hospital billing staff, Epic system analyst colleagues, Finance leadership, and Revenue Cycle Leadership. Required to be available for Ad hoc PFS representation at interdepartmental, finance, and/or various onsite/offsite department revenue cycle meetings to assist with the evaluation of charge capture workflows and make recommendations to improve the accuracy and efficiency in capturing professional and facility revenue. Responsible to analyze, communicate, and draft internal controls and operational changes to comply with complex changes to government and third party payer policies, regulations and contract changes. Responsible to monitor and analyze various monthly/weekly/daily revenue and late charge reports. Responsible to monitor and analyze daily/weekly/monthly WQ data including Revenue Guardian holds, Charge Review, Router Review, and Claim Edits in order to make recommendations to correct any negative trends, high volume failures, and to improve front end work flow and procedures for both professional and clinical areas. Responsible to work closely with Epic system analysts within all charge capture modules in the upgrading, testing and implementation of any and all revenue cycle software products that impacts revenue capture, claim scrubbing, while ensuring Lahey Health adheres to compliance regulations set forth for both professional and hospital billing Responsible for the monthly production and maintenance of reporting mechanisms detailing departmental productivity and assist in the development, implementation, training and education, maintenance, and reporting of revenue capture initiatives. Responsible to remain current on new services being performed throughout the Healthcare System in order to maximize revenue capture. Has full knowledge of chargemaster maintenance policies and procedures in order to perform internal audits. Responsible to actively participates in the development and maintenance of revenue capture in electronic systems and any documents including downtime encounter forms (i.e,charge tickets). The Revenue Integrity Analyst assists in coordinating and maintaining accurate revenue capture preference lists containing charge code record selections with members of the modality specific professional and/or clinical staff. Responsible for keeping abreast of all government and payor level coding, billing, reimbursement rules, regulations, and guidelines related to professional and hospital revenue capture and billing. Responsible updating Epic system and informing SLD, Dept Managers, and other leadership of significant changes in a timely manner. Responsible to participate in complex projects and or audit related to revenue initiatives and complex investigations into allegations of fraudulent billing or abuse, as necessary. Provides support for projects in which Senior Leadership is involved Responsible to develop, trend, and report monthly and annual statistical reporting dashboard data to coincide with departmental and organizational KPIs (Key Performance Indicator). Responsible to proactively identifies problems or opportunities for improvements related to clinical orders,clinical documentation, and preference lists that are or should be linked to professional and/or hospital charge records. Makes recommendations to management and/or the perspective departments where high volume/high dollar values have been determined and creates Epic remedy tickets for improvements/changes to take place.

Minimum Qualifications

Education: Associates Degree. In the absence of an Associate’s Degree preferably in the business or finance field, an additional 4 years of healthcare revenue cycle experience above the five identified below are required.

Licensure, Certification & Registration: Epic proficiency or certification in Charge Description Master

Experience: Requires minimum 2 years of healthcare revenue cycle experience

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities

 Comprehensive working knowledge of medical/hospital billing practices, billing software, health care insurance, and CMS regulations Knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding principles. Knowledge of Epic or related hospital ADT/Billing software. Thoroughly proficient in data entry using a pc and a variety of electronic systems. Ability to read, analyze and interpret financial reports. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw conclusions, and make sound recommendations. Capacity to analyze and think creatively and weigh alternatives. Perception of people and an awareness to deal with conflict successfully and attain resolution Demonstrates attention to detail. Demonstrates excellent organizational skills. Demonstrates skills with multitasking Demonstrates proficiency in the use of excel documents
