rows.title: Digital & Social Intelligence Senior Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Reporting into the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager within the Commercial Excellence organization, the Digital & Social Intelligence Senior Analyst will be a crucial addition to a team whose mission is to implement an adaptive, industry-leading Social Intelligence capability into Nestle USA that is considered a trusted source of actionable, real-time insight into consumer perception & culture. The Social Intelligence capability has been built to support stakeholders across Brand Marketing, Consumer & Marketplace Insights, Social Strategy & Community, Foresight, Innovation, Category Strategy, Corporate Communication and other teams; ultimately, our goal is to fully embed the capability throughout Nestle USA and empower stakeholders across every department to act upon real-time social media insights.

Additionally, the Senior Analyst will be a crucial member of the emerging cross-functional capability of AI Readiness by supporting LLM Listening & Visibility analysis, including tool implementation & governance, stakeholder support and incorporation into Social Intelligence analysis deliverables.

After supporting the final stages of the Social Intelligence capability’s implementation across Nestle USA, and the incorporation of LLM Listening into our processes, the Digital & Social Intelligence Senior Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to provide consistent, timely & actionable insights for our brands, while forging a continuous stakeholder feedback loop on our offerings. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Senior Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Senior Analyst will be expected to balance supporting stakeholders by fulfilling research requests using our best-in-class technology stack, while also training the stakeholders to be able to leverage the technology to find insights on their own. This balance will allow the Senior Analyst, along with the rest of the Digital & Social Intelligence team, to focus our efforts on the most important in-depth analysis the organization needs, while empowering our stakeholders to conduct their own light monitoring of day-to-day digital & social insights questions. The role will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Shopper Insights and Innovation, to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams.

The Senior Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. Day-to-day activities vary given the nature of our business, but the Senior Analyst can expect to balance answering business questions through in-depth analysis using multiple technologies, collaborating with stakeholders in key meetings, developing and executing self-service training programs, identifying & helping implement new technology features, working with vendors and attending leadership presentations.

On top of the various product categories we support and the multiple technologies we use, the world of social media and AI-driven technology changes rapidly. Therefore, a balance of technical skill, strategic thinking, proactivity, flexibility and a solution-seeking attitude is crucial for success in this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Social Listening, LLM Listening & Related Social Media Research, including Presentation to Stakeholders. Leverage Nestle USA’s Digital & Social Intelligence technology stack to conduct in-depth research about our brands, competitors, product categories and relevant cultural trends, using the insights to deliver a persuasive & visual story to stakeholders that drives action within their key initiatives. This includes navigating technology that handles every facet of Digital & Social Intelligence, such as social listening, ratings & reviews listening, LLM Listening / GEO / AEO, emerging trend identification, social audience persona building, influencer evaluation and owned content performance benchmarking. Where applicable, this also includes combining findings with other data sources outside of Social Intelligence, often via collaboration with our broader Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics and Consumer Insights teams, to provide comprehensive analysis to the stakeholder. Stakeholder Training & Guidance. Assist in the development and execution of training programs, including building training material, leading office hours and sitting one-on-one with stakeholders to guide them through use cases for social listening & social intelligence that build confidence in their ability to navigate the technology to find insights.Stakeholder Request Management. Assist the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager in managing an analysis request queue, which assigns priority to each ad-hoc social research request based on impact to the business, level of effort and urgency. This includes keeping track of stakeholder check-in cadences to ensure the Digital & Social Intelligence team is consistently engaging each key stakeholder group. Tool Output Scanning & Insights Identification. Review the automated reporting outputs from the various tools, including weekly/bi-weekly/monthly AI-driven reports and real-time email alerts, to ensure continuous improvement in the quality of the automated outputs while also mining for actionable insights that need to be flagged to our stakeholders for further discussion & potential action.Tool Maintenance & Governance. Assist in the day-to-day management of the tools, from user access to dashboard/report quality, flagging issues or needs to the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager while collaborating with 3rd party and shared service support teams. Vendor Collaboration. Partnering with analysts from 3rd parties and shared service teams on key research projects and key feature advancements, as well as brainstorming and providing feedback to tool providers on ideal features and functionality that maximize actionability. 
REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, market research, analytics, communications, business, economics, or related field3-5 years of experience in social listening and additional social research, including in-tool navigational experience and strategic storytelling of analysis results.3-5 years in a strategic role working with data analytics, with a focus on developing strong dashboards and/or other automatically refreshable visualizations that empower stakeholders to quickly identify key takeaways from data
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

Experience using Talkwalker, Nichefire, Yogi, Audiense, Creator IQ, Sprinklr or similar tools throughout every part of the process: query building, dashboard visualization, automated report building and ultimately in-depth analysis of key takeawaysFamiliarity with the emerging LLM Listening & Visibility / GEO / AEO analysis space, including tools such as ProfoundStrong understanding of how AI can be used to support Digital & Social Intelligence workstreams, including prompt-writing best practices to focus the observation summarizations of AI assistantsStrong research experience and familiarity with the process for developing consumer, category & cultural insightsStrong storytelling experience through the creation and presentation of compelling slide decksAbility to translate business needs into strategic social intelligence frameworks that can be executed & replicated across a large organizationFamiliarity with foresight use cases, identifying and analyzing trend signals from social media that ladder up to larger cultural movements or consumer behavior shiftsUnderstanding of the social media landscape, dynamics of community interaction, social best practices, and digital analytics toolsStrong communication and interpersonal skillsAbility to execute multiple projects at once across various stakeholder teams throughout a large organization
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Familiarity with experimentation and A/B testing of social/digital content executionsFamiliarity with Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager for website analyticsFamiliarity with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and its analytics functionalitiesFamiliarity with Power BI to create and visualize data from disparate data sets 
Salary: $100,000.00 to $120,000.00 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

rows.title: Business Development Analyst (Entry Talent Accelerator Program - Summer 2027)
rows.descriptionText:
The Company You’ll Join: Founded in 2016 to bring rigorous research and analytics to early careers and recruiting leaders, Veris Insights has grown to serve thousands of Heads of Talent, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Early Careers from over 300 Fortune 500 organizations. Our team of 80+, including researchers, consultants, PhDs, analysts, and executive service directors, work daily to help members understand, deliberate, and solve their hardest challenges.
The Team You’ll Join: You will join an existing Entry Talent Accelerator Program (ETA) cohort, a high-performance early-career development program designed for ambitious individuals looking to accelerate their growth in client-facing and revenue-generating environments.
This role is a full-time position beginning in Summer 2027 for graduating seniors.
As a Business Development Analyst, you will sit within our Growth Division and serve as one of the first points of contact for senior Talent Acquisition and University Recruiting leaders interested in Veris Insights' work. Through strategic outreach and insights-driven conversations, you will help generate interest in our memberships (ongoing partnerships that give organizations access to our research and advisory teams) while developing communication, advisory, and executive-facing skills foundational to long-term career growth at the firm.
This is an outbound growth and business development role centered around high-volume communication and strategic prospecting. Business Development Analysts spend a significant portion of their day conducting outbound outreach through phone, email, and LinkedIn, engaging senior leaders in thoughtful, data-informed conversations.
This role is best suited for individuals who are energized by frequent conversations with senior leaders and want their work measured, coached, and rewarded on results.
How You’ll Grow: The ETA Program is a structured, 12-18 month development program built around the Business Development Analyst role. The outreach, conversations, and objections you work through every day are where the skills below are built, and the program pairs that experience with a dedicated mentor, structured coaching, and regular feedback.
Through the program, you will develop:
Public Speaking & Executive Presence: Build confidence and fluency in high-pressure communication environments through coaching, repetition, and real-time feedback.
Consultative Advisory Skills: Learn how to identify executive priorities, build credibility quickly, and guide strategic conversations with senior leaders.
Negotiation & Influence: Develop the ability to navigate high-stakes conversations with confidence, professionalism, and strong interpersonal judgement.
Data Interpretation & Insight Delivery: Learn how to quickly interpret research and data to support real-time, insight-driven advisory conversations.
The program is designed to build the foundational skills of a working professional and prepare participants for client-facing and revenue-generating roles across the firm. Progression through the program is based on individual performance against defined milestones, and placement afterward is based on business need at the time.
Your Character:
Incisiveness. You quickly identify priorities, connect ideas, and thoughtfully diagnose challenges.
Executive Presence. You communicate with confidence, professionalism, warmth, and credibility across a wide range of audiences.
Results Orientation. You are motivated by performance, growth, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Intellectual Curiosity. You enjoy learning quickly, asking thoughtful questions, and building expertise in complex topics.
Empathy & Service Orientation. You genuinely care about the people you work with and strive to build trust in every interaction.
Key Responsibilities: Direct Outreach & Pipeline GenerationExecute high-volume, multi-channel outbound outreach through phone, email, and LinkedIn to generate qualified pipelineWork toward defined activity, prospecting, and pipeline-generation goals, using performance data and strategy to improve resultsGenerate interest and build relationships with senior Talent Acquisition and University Recruiting leaders
Key Responsibilities: Growth Strategy & Partnership SupportPartner with Account Advisors to prioritize accounts, identify the right senior stakeholders, and develop tailored prospecting strategiesAnalyze trends and collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing and Revenue OperationsMaintain accurate records, activity tracking, and pipeline support within Salesforce
Key Responsibilities: ETA Program ParticipationCollaborate with your mentor to build and execute an individualized growth planCollaborate with your cohort peers on team initiatives that improve outreach, messaging, and pipeline strategyIdentify firmwide opportunities and present strategic recommendations to leadership
RequirementsCurrently pursuing a Bachelor's degree with an expected graduation date between December 2026 and June 2027Internship, part-time, or other experience in business development, sales development, recruiting, fundraising, hospitality, customer success, or similar client-facing environments is a plusStrong communication skills and comfort operating in fast-paced environmentsDemonstrated curiosity, coachability, and learning agilityA proactive, solution-oriented mindsetFamiliarity with sales and prospecting tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a plus
Compensation & BenefitsSalary: $60,000-$65,000 base salary, depending on qualifications, plus variable commission based on performanceHybrid Schedule: 3 days per week in our Washington, DC officeUnlimited PTO and monthly mental health daysMedical, dental, and vision coverage$1,000 annual wellness stipend401(k) with up to 4% employer matchPaid parental leave
Work AuthorizationApplicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future visa sponsorship. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider OPT/CPT holders.
Please keep in mind: Research has shown that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds only apply to jobs when they meet 100% of the requirements vs. their majority counterparts, which apply at a much higher rate if they meet 50-60% of the requirements. So, with that being said, if you are interested in the role, we would love to hear how you can leverage your talents to be an awesome culture add.
Our Values & Culture, In Brief: Talent is in our DNA. It is what we study, who we serve, and the quality we most pride ourselves on internally. In order for our team members to be at their best, we provide individualized benefits and support. We believe a well-rounded and diverse team is the key to our success. To provide the widest range of experiences and perspectives in our member service and internal culture, we never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Please let our recruiter know if there are any accommodations we can provide for you to ensure an equitable and comfortable recruitment process.
We highly value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and this shows up in everything we do. Our research has a significant focus on the experiences of candidates from diverse backgrounds. Internally, we have Employee Resource Groups for BIPOC and LGBTQ+ employees, and Affinity Groups to support women and neurodiversity. Furthermore, we’ve established a Diversity Council to promote a workplace environment that is safe, respectful, and inclusive for all and acts as an active partner to People Ops and Leadership in service of our broader firm-wide DEI goals.

rows.descriptionText:

Turn2Partners is partnering with a growing organization investing in real estate and infrastructure assets to hire a Real Estate Analyst. Following a significant influx of institutional capital, the company is expanding its acquisition capabilities and building a pipeline of investment opportunities.
Reporting directly to the Head of Corporate Development, this analyst will help identify, screen, and prioritize acquisition targets while gaining exposure to investment decisions and transaction analysis. Apply or reach out to Turn2Partners to schedule a confidential conversation.

rows.descriptionText:
BBB National ProgramsBBB National Programs is where businesses turn to enhance consumer trust and consumers are heard.
Business Development Program Analyst
**This role requires a minimum of three in-office days per week in McLean, VA to perform the essential functions of the position.
WHO WE AREWe are a non-profit organization dedicated to fostering a more accountable and trustworthy marketplace. As the foremost thought leader on industry self-regulation, we are shaping the way that businesses and consumers interact with one another. As the home of U.S. independent industry self-regulation, we are currently operating more than twenty globally recognized programs that have been helping enhance consumer trust in business for more than 50 years. Our programs provide third-party accountability and dispute resolution services that address existing and emerging industry issues, create a fairer playing field for businesses, and a better experience for consumers. We continue to evolve our work and grow our impact by providing business guidance and fostering best practices in areas such as advertising, child-and-teen-directed marketing, data privacy, dispute resolution, automobile warranty, technology, and emerging areas.
ABOUT OUR NATIONAL PARTNERSBBB National Programs National Partners influence the future of regulation in their industry, demonstrating to stakeholders their commitment to accountable, industry-led standards and dispute resolution programs that protect consumers and keep the playing field level for business. National Partners are champions of industry self-regulation, data privacy, consumer protection, and truth and accuracy in advertising, and support our work as the leading voice for industry self-regulation.
YOUR IMPACTThe Business Development Program Analyst turns data and research into insight that drives National Partner growth, retention, and sponsorship strategy. Working directly with the Vice President and partnering with Directors and Managers across the Business Development and National Partner team, this role is central to the successful execution of membership growth, partner engagement, and sponsorship initiatives.The analyst owns the team’s data, research, and reporting—ensuring CRM integrity, uncovering and prioritizing new opportunities, and translating findings into clear recommendations for leadership. This role requires an analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive individual who is comfortable working independently while collaborating across multiple stakeholders.The ideal candidate is curious, resourceful, and eager to learn, with strong research and analytical capabilities and a desire to contribute to business development and membership growth efforts.
Essential Duties and ResponsibilitiesCRM, Data & Reporting Own the accuracy and integrity of data within the CRM systemPerform regular data audits, cleanup, and enrichment to support effective outreach and reportingBuild and maintain weekly and ad hoc reports and dashboards to support membership, retention, and business development activitiesServe as a CRM resource for the team, including onboarding and training support for new usersMarket & Prospect Research Conduct in-depth research to identify prospective National Partners, sponsors, and key industry contactsBuild and maintain prospect lists, including detailed profiles of organizations and decision-makersSegment target industries and organizations to identify trends and prioritize opportunities aligned with growth strategyDemonstrate curiosity and initiative in uncovering new opportunities and insightsPipeline & Performance Analysis (approx. 20%)Analyze National Partner acquisition, renewal, and retention trends, and flag at-risk partnersTrack pipeline performance, including conversion rates, win rates, and revenue forecastsMeasure the effectiveness of outreach and digital campaigns related to partner and sponsor acquisition, and recommend adjustmentsAssess sponsorship and event ROI and National Partner engagement levelsTranslate findings into concise briefs, presentations, and recommendations for leadershipOutreach & Proposal Support Execute targeted outreach campaigns, including email communications and follow-upsDraft proposals, pitch materials, and customized outreach content informed by prospect researchTrack outreach activities and engagement metrics within the CRMPartner Engagement & Events Support engagement activities and communications for existing National PartnersCoordinate onboarding for new National PartnersUse engagement data to identify opportunities to strengthen partner relationshipsSupport planning and execution of events and sponsorships, including pre-event materials and on-site coordination as neededIdentify and research sponsorship prospectsTeam OperationsCoordinate team workflows, track priorities, and ensure timely follow-up on key initiativesPrepare briefing materials for leadership meetings and external engagements, and capture action items
WHAT YOU WILL BRINGMust have:Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience1-3 years of relevant professional experienceExceptional attention to detail and organizational skillsStrong research and analytical capabilities, with a track record of turning data and research into actionable recommendationsExcellent written and verbal communication skillsAbility to manage multiple priorities and work independentlyAdvanced Excel skills (e.g., pivot tables, lookups, data cleanup) and proficiency in Word and PowerPointExperience with CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics), including building reportsLet us know if you have:Experience in a nonprofit, membership-based, or professional services environmentExposure to business development, sales, or partnership support functionsExperience supporting senior leadershipExperience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)Familiarity with prospecting tools (e.g., LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo)Experience using AI tools to support research and analysis
WHAT WE OFFER:At BBB National Programs, we bring a growth mindset as we advance our mission and strive to foster trust, innovation, and competition in the marketplace, while cultivating a team of talented and engaged professionals who seek out new challenges and opportunities to catalyze our progress. We are an inclusive organization, bringing a dynamic environment that supports our employees and the meaningful work we do.
Health & Welfare Benefits: You will be offered a comprehensive plan offering health, dental and vision plans, paid short-term disability insurance, and life insurance.Financial Well-Being: Build your retirement savings with our 401k plan matching up to 7% of your contributions.Time Off: You will have flexibility for the time you need off from work. We offer a variety of plans including vacation, personal, and wellness leave.Wellness: We promote physical and mental wellness by providing a fully equipped on-site fitness center in our offices and an employee assistance program.Environment: Our modern headquarters in McLean, VA, and our office in New York, NY provide the space for creativity and collaboration, and the technology resources so you can be at your best. We believe that an inclusive workforce is a strength in fulfilling our mission.
The anticipated hiring range for this position is $60,000 to $65,000 annually. Actual compensation will be based on relevant experience, skills, education, and other job-related factors.
BBB National Programs is Great Place to Work® Certified and has been named as a Best Place to Work for Working Daughters.
BBB National Programs is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer.

Company Description Capital Electric Supply is a leading electrical distributor with over 70 locations from York, PA to Savannah, GA, combining large-scale capabilities with strong local roots. The company provides products from top manufacturers, including electrical components, lighting, tools, and safety equipment, supported by industry-relevant training and application expertise. ABS Group is seeking a Data Scientist to join our Artificial Intelligence Practice in support of a major federal modernization program.  Junior (0 to 4 years)  Mid-Level (5 to 9 years)  Senior (10 to 14 years)  Principal (15 or more years)

rows.title: Digital & Social Intelligence Senior Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Reporting into the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager within the Commercial Excellence organization, the Digital & Social Intelligence Senior Analyst will be a crucial addition to a team whose mission is to implement an adaptive, industry-leading Social Intelligence capability into Nestle USA that is considered a trusted source of actionable, real-time insight into consumer perception & culture. The Social Intelligence capability has been built to support stakeholders across Brand Marketing, Consumer & Marketplace Insights, Social Strategy & Community, Foresight, Innovation, Category Strategy, Corporate Communication and other teams; ultimately, our goal is to fully embed the capability throughout Nestle USA and empower stakeholders across every department to act upon real-time social media insights.

Additionally, the Senior Analyst will be a crucial member of the emerging cross-functional capability of AI Readiness by supporting LLM Listening & Visibility analysis, including tool implementation & governance, stakeholder support and incorporation into Social Intelligence analysis deliverables.

After supporting the final stages of the Social Intelligence capability’s implementation across Nestle USA, and the incorporation of LLM Listening into our processes, the Digital & Social Intelligence Senior Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to provide consistent, timely & actionable insights for our brands, while forging a continuous stakeholder feedback loop on our offerings. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Senior Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Senior Analyst will be expected to balance supporting stakeholders by fulfilling research requests using our best-in-class technology stack, while also training the stakeholders to be able to leverage the technology to find insights on their own. This balance will allow the Senior Analyst, along with the rest of the Digital & Social Intelligence team, to focus our efforts on the most important in-depth analysis the organization needs, while empowering our stakeholders to conduct their own light monitoring of day-to-day digital & social insights questions. The role will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Shopper Insights and Innovation, to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams.

The Senior Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. Day-to-day activities vary given the nature of our business, but the Senior Analyst can expect to balance answering business questions through in-depth analysis using multiple technologies, collaborating with stakeholders in key meetings, developing and executing self-service training programs, identifying & helping implement new technology features, working with vendors and attending leadership presentations.

On top of the various product categories we support and the multiple technologies we use, the world of social media and AI-driven technology changes rapidly. Therefore, a balance of technical skill, strategic thinking, proactivity, flexibility and a solution-seeking attitude is crucial for success in this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Social Listening, LLM Listening & Related Social Media Research, including Presentation to Stakeholders. Leverage Nestle USA’s Digital & Social Intelligence technology stack to conduct in-depth research about our brands, competitors, product categories and relevant cultural trends, using the insights to deliver a persuasive & visual story to stakeholders that drives action within their key initiatives. This includes navigating technology that handles every facet of Digital & Social Intelligence, such as social listening, ratings & reviews listening, LLM Listening / GEO / AEO, emerging trend identification, social audience persona building, influencer evaluation and owned content performance benchmarking. Where applicable, this also includes combining findings with other data sources outside of Social Intelligence, often via collaboration with our broader Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics and Consumer Insights teams, to provide comprehensive analysis to the stakeholder. Stakeholder Training & Guidance. Assist in the development and execution of training programs, including building training material, leading office hours and sitting one-on-one with stakeholders to guide them through use cases for social listening & social intelligence that build confidence in their ability to navigate the technology to find insights.Stakeholder Request Management. Assist the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager in managing an analysis request queue, which assigns priority to each ad-hoc social research request based on impact to the business, level of effort and urgency. This includes keeping track of stakeholder check-in cadences to ensure the Digital & Social Intelligence team is consistently engaging each key stakeholder group. Tool Output Scanning & Insights Identification. Review the automated reporting outputs from the various tools, including weekly/bi-weekly/monthly AI-driven reports and real-time email alerts, to ensure continuous improvement in the quality of the automated outputs while also mining for actionable insights that need to be flagged to our stakeholders for further discussion & potential action.Tool Maintenance & Governance. Assist in the day-to-day management of the tools, from user access to dashboard/report quality, flagging issues or needs to the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager while collaborating with 3rd party and shared service support teams. Vendor Collaboration. Partnering with analysts from 3rd parties and shared service teams on key research projects and key feature advancements, as well as brainstorming and providing feedback to tool providers on ideal features and functionality that maximize actionability. 
REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, market research, analytics, communications, business, economics, or related field3-5 years of experience in social listening and additional social research, including in-tool navigational experience and strategic storytelling of analysis results.3-5 years in a strategic role working with data analytics, with a focus on developing strong dashboards and/or other automatically refreshable visualizations that empower stakeholders to quickly identify key takeaways from data
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

Experience using Talkwalker, Nichefire, Yogi, Audiense, Creator IQ, Sprinklr or similar tools throughout every part of the process: query building, dashboard visualization, automated report building and ultimately in-depth analysis of key takeawaysFamiliarity with the emerging LLM Listening & Visibility / GEO / AEO analysis space, including tools such as ProfoundStrong understanding of how AI can be used to support Digital & Social Intelligence workstreams, including prompt-writing best practices to focus the observation summarizations of AI assistantsStrong research experience and familiarity with the process for developing consumer, category & cultural insightsStrong storytelling experience through the creation and presentation of compelling slide decksAbility to translate business needs into strategic social intelligence frameworks that can be executed & replicated across a large organizationFamiliarity with foresight use cases, identifying and analyzing trend signals from social media that ladder up to larger cultural movements or consumer behavior shiftsUnderstanding of the social media landscape, dynamics of community interaction, social best practices, and digital analytics toolsStrong communication and interpersonal skillsAbility to execute multiple projects at once across various stakeholder teams throughout a large organization
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Familiarity with experimentation and A/B testing of social/digital content executionsFamiliarity with Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager for website analyticsFamiliarity with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and its analytics functionalitiesFamiliarity with Power BI to create and visualize data from disparate data sets 
Salary: $100,000.00 to $120,000.00 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits

It is our business imperative to remain a very inclusive workplace.

To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. The skills you've gained while serving our country, such as flexibility, agility, and leadership, are much like the skills that will make you successful in this role. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. Nestlé seeks such skilled and qualified individuals to share our mission where you’ll join a cohort of others who have chosen to call Nestlé home.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

THIS ROLE IS BASED IN BANGKOK, THAILAND (WITH RELOCATION PROVIDED)

Location: Bangkok, Thailand (*Not open for remote work)

Get to Know our Team:

The Supply Analytics team delivers data-driven insights and decision support to optimize Agoda’s supply ecosystem.  Experience applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) algorithms to extract information from documents.  Background in enterprise-level Computer Vision, automated data collection, automated reporting, and data standardization best practices.  Demonstrated expertise in mathematics, statistics, and quantitative analysis.  Familiarity with analytic techniques such as classification, regression, clustering, dimensionality reduction, and causal modeling.

 TS/SCI or higher clearance level required

Noblis is seeking Data Scientists at all experience levels with an active TS/SCI with a Polygraph to support mission-critical national security initiatives in Chantilly, Virginia.

rows.title: Manager, Data Science - AI Foundations
rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

AI Foundations Specialist Models Data Science team builds and ships state of the art scalable architecture, AI/ML solutions for Capital One’s award-winning mobile app. We partner with product, tech and design teams to deliver app features that delight customers with dynamic and personalized experiences, enable them to chat with Capital One’s digital assistant Eno, or search for useful contents. You will be the driving force to experiment, innovate and create next generation experiences powered by the latest emerging generative AI technologies.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI powered products that change how customers interact with their money. Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Hugging Face, LangChain, Lightning, VectorDBs, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data. Be the expert in Natural Language Processing (NLP) to harness the power of Large Language Models (LLMs), adapt and finetune them for customer facing applications and features. Build machine learning and NLP models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, and validation; partnering with engineering teams to operationalize them in scalable and resilient production systems that serve 80+ million customers. Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals. 

The Ideal Candidate is:

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You're passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. Technical. You’re comfortable with advanced ML and DL technologies including language models and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience working with LLMs and solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Influential. You are passionate about AI/ML and can bring along a cross functional team in breakthrough innovations. You communicate clearly and effectively to share your findings with non-technical audiences. You are experienced in training language models or large computer vision models as well as have expertise in one or more key subdomains such as: training optimization, self-supervised learning, explainability, RLHF. You have an engineering mindset as shown by a track record of delivering models at scale both in training data and inference volumes. You have experience in delivering libraries, platforms, or solution level code to existing products.

rows.title: Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

ABS Group is seeking a Data Scientist to join our Artificial Intelligence Practice in support of a major federal modernization program. In this role, you will apply machine learning, statistical analysis, and modern AI techniques to large, complex datasets that support mission-critical planning and operations.

You will work alongside data scientists, engineers, and client stakeholders to build analytical solutions that improve data quality, support decision-making, and help move advanced analytics from prototype to operational use. The scope of responsibility, degree of technical leadership, and level of independence expected will reflect the level at which this position is filled.

What You Will Do

 Analyze large and complex datasets using statistical methods, machine learning, and AI techniques  Build, test, and maintain predictive models and analytical workflows  Apply methods such as machine learning, deep learning, NLP, generative AI, large language models, and time series analysis to mission-focused data problems  Support feature engineering, data preparation, model evaluation, and reproducible analytical development  Help transition analytics and machine learning capabilities from pilot efforts into production environments  Contribute to synthetic data development and other advanced analytical methods where appropriate  Partner with engineers and stakeholders to translate business needs into practical analytical solutions  Prepare technical documentation, reports, presentations, and other project deliverables  Support responsible AI practices, including explainability, trustworthiness, and AI risk management 

What You Will Need

Level and Compensation: This position may be filled at multiple career levels based on business need and the selected candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and demonstrated capability. Typical leveling for this role is as follows:

 Junior (0 to 4 years)  Mid-Level (5 to 9 years)  Senior (10 to 14 years)  Principal (15 or more years) 

These ranges are guidelines only and are not the sole determining factor in level. The posted compensation range reflects the full range across all possible levels. Individual offers will be based on the level at which the candidate is hired, as well as factors such as skills, experience, internal equity, and geographic market considerations where applicable.

Education and Experience

 Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related STEM field; Master's degree preferred  Relevant professional experience applying data science, machine learning, or advanced analytics; the depth and scope of experience required will vary based on the level at which this position is filled  Experience working with large, real-world datasets across the full analytical lifecycle preferred  Experience supporting production or operational deployment of analytical or machine learning solutions a plus 

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

 Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of SQL  Experience with machine learning, predictive modeling, model evaluation, and feature engineering  Familiarity with NLP, GenAI, and LLM methods  Familiarity with deep learning, neural networks, anomaly detection, and time series methods  Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings clearly to varied audiences  Ability to develop reproducible analytical workflows and clear technical documentation 

It Would be Nice if You Have

 Experience in a federal, public sector, or regulated data environment  Familiarity with survey, demographic, statistical, or population-scale data  Exposure to record linkage, entity resolution, or matching models  Experience with synthetic data, differential privacy, or responsible AI practices 

Reporting Relationships

Reports directy to the Chief Data Scientist or a Manager, Director, or Executive role.

Location:

This position is based in the Washington, D.C. metro area, with primary work performed in Suitland, Maryland. Remote or hybrid arrangements may be available for eligible work, subject to government approval.

rows.title: Applied Operations Research
rows.descriptionText:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

This is an opportunity for a motivated Operations Research Analyst to join MITRE’s Operations Analysis department. We are a large group of over 60 operations research professionals, including over 20 PhDs, who provide thought leadership on a variety of strategic and technical issues, perform analysis that enable our sponsors to make more effective decisions, lead internal research and development activities to bring new technical capabilities into the public sector, and serve as trusted third-party advisors to government sponsors on a variety of technical topics.

In short, we apply our problem-solving skills to complex interdisciplinary problems that occur within or at the intersection of organizations, operations, and technology. We support sponsor projects across the defense and public sectors including homeland defense, military logistics, radio-spectrum frequency management, health care delivery, cybersecurity analytics, fraud detection, satellite planning, homeland security and civilian aviation. We apply advanced analytic techniques such as longitudinal analysis, large-scale integer programming, metaheuristics, agent-based modeling, reinforcement learning, predictive modeling, mathematical modeling, time series & forecasting, machine learning, optimization, statistics, probability modeling, regression analyses, Bayesian analysis, and different types of simulation to solve the nation’s toughest problems. And our research pushes the boundaries on topics such as complex scheduling, medical image analysis, identifying changes in data streams and incorporating the latest AI advancements into our processes for efficiency and rigor.

If you are passionate about project-based analytical work in the public interest, you have found the right place.

rows.title: Digital & Social Intelligence Senior Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Reporting into the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager within the Commercial Excellence organization, the Digital & Social Intelligence Senior Analyst will be a crucial addition to a team whose mission is to implement an adaptive, industry-leading Social Intelligence capability into Nestle USA that is considered a trusted source of actionable, real-time insight into consumer perception & culture. The Social Intelligence capability has been built to support stakeholders across Brand Marketing, Consumer & Marketplace Insights, Social Strategy & Community, Foresight, Innovation, Category Strategy, Corporate Communication and other teams; ultimately, our goal is to fully embed the capability throughout Nestle USA and empower stakeholders across every department to act upon real-time social media insights.

Additionally, the Senior Analyst will be a crucial member of the emerging cross-functional capability of AI Readiness by supporting LLM Listening & Visibility analysis, including tool implementation & governance, stakeholder support and incorporation into Social Intelligence analysis deliverables.

After supporting the final stages of the Social Intelligence capability’s implementation across Nestle USA, and the incorporation of LLM Listening into our processes, the Digital & Social Intelligence Senior Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to provide consistent, timely & actionable insights for our brands, while forging a continuous stakeholder feedback loop on our offerings. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Senior Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Senior Analyst will be expected to balance supporting stakeholders by fulfilling research requests using our best-in-class technology stack, while also training the stakeholders to be able to leverage the technology to find insights on their own. This balance will allow the Senior Analyst, along with the rest of the Digital & Social Intelligence team, to focus our efforts on the most important in-depth analysis the organization needs, while empowering our stakeholders to conduct their own light monitoring of day-to-day digital & social insights questions. The role will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Shopper Insights and Innovation, to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams.

The Senior Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. Day-to-day activities vary given the nature of our business, but the Senior Analyst can expect to balance answering business questions through in-depth analysis using multiple technologies, collaborating with stakeholders in key meetings, developing and executing self-service training programs, identifying & helping implement new technology features, working with vendors and attending leadership presentations.

On top of the various product categories we support and the multiple technologies we use, the world of social media and AI-driven technology changes rapidly. Therefore, a balance of technical skill, strategic thinking, proactivity, flexibility and a solution-seeking attitude is crucial for success in this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Social Listening, LLM Listening & Related Social Media Research, including Presentation to Stakeholders. Leverage Nestle USA’s Digital & Social Intelligence technology stack to conduct in-depth research about our brands, competitors, product categories and relevant cultural trends, using the insights to deliver a persuasive & visual story to stakeholders that drives action within their key initiatives. This includes navigating technology that handles every facet of Digital & Social Intelligence, such as social listening, ratings & reviews listening, LLM Listening / GEO / AEO, emerging trend identification, social audience persona building, influencer evaluation and owned content performance benchmarking. Where applicable, this also includes combining findings with other data sources outside of Social Intelligence, often via collaboration with our broader Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics and Consumer Insights teams, to provide comprehensive analysis to the stakeholder. Stakeholder Training & Guidance. Assist in the development and execution of training programs, including building training material, leading office hours and sitting one-on-one with stakeholders to guide them through use cases for social listening & social intelligence that build confidence in their ability to navigate the technology to find insights.Stakeholder Request Management. Assist the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager in managing an analysis request queue, which assigns priority to each ad-hoc social research request based on impact to the business, level of effort and urgency. This includes keeping track of stakeholder check-in cadences to ensure the Digital & Social Intelligence team is consistently engaging each key stakeholder group. Tool Output Scanning & Insights Identification. Review the automated reporting outputs from the various tools, including weekly/bi-weekly/monthly AI-driven reports and real-time email alerts, to ensure continuous improvement in the quality of the automated outputs while also mining for actionable insights that need to be flagged to our stakeholders for further discussion & potential action.Tool Maintenance & Governance. Assist in the day-to-day management of the tools, from user access to dashboard/report quality, flagging issues or needs to the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager while collaborating with 3rd party and shared service support teams. Vendor Collaboration. Partnering with analysts from 3rd parties and shared service teams on key research projects and key feature advancements, as well as brainstorming and providing feedback to tool providers on ideal features and functionality that maximize actionability. 
REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, market research, analytics, communications, business, economics, or related field3-5 years of experience in social listening and additional social research, including in-tool navigational experience and strategic storytelling of analysis results.3-5 years in a strategic role working with data analytics, with a focus on developing strong dashboards and/or other automatically refreshable visualizations that empower stakeholders to quickly identify key takeaways from data
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

Experience using Talkwalker, Nichefire, Yogi, Audiense, Creator IQ, Sprinklr or similar tools throughout every part of the process: query building, dashboard visualization, automated report building and ultimately in-depth analysis of key takeawaysFamiliarity with the emerging LLM Listening & Visibility / GEO / AEO analysis space, including tools such as ProfoundStrong understanding of how AI can be used to support Digital & Social Intelligence workstreams, including prompt-writing best practices to focus the observation summarizations of AI assistantsStrong research experience and familiarity with the process for developing consumer, category & cultural insightsStrong storytelling experience through the creation and presentation of compelling slide decksAbility to translate business needs into strategic social intelligence frameworks that can be executed & replicated across a large organizationFamiliarity with foresight use cases, identifying and analyzing trend signals from social media that ladder up to larger cultural movements or consumer behavior shiftsUnderstanding of the social media landscape, dynamics of community interaction, social best practices, and digital analytics toolsStrong communication and interpersonal skillsAbility to execute multiple projects at once across various stakeholder teams throughout a large organization
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Familiarity with experimentation and A/B testing of social/digital content executionsFamiliarity with Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager for website analyticsFamiliarity with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and its analytics functionalitiesFamiliarity with Power BI to create and visualize data from disparate data sets 
Salary: $100,000.00 to $120,000.00 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. After supporting the final stages of the Social Intelligence capability’s implementation across Nestle USA, and the incorporation of LLM Listening into our processes, the Digital & Social Intelligence Senior Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to provide consistent, timely & actionable insights for our brands, while forging a continuous stakeholder feedback loop on our offerings. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Senior Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Senior Analyst will be expected to balance supporting stakeholders by fulfilling research requests using our best-in-class technology stack, while also training the stakeholders to be able to leverage the technology to find insights on their own. This balance will allow the Senior Analyst, along with the rest of the Digital & Social Intelligence team, to focus our efforts on the most important in-depth analysis the organization needs, while empowering our stakeholders to conduct their own light monitoring of day-to-day digital & social insights questions. The role will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Shopper Insights and Innovation, to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams.

The Senior Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. Day-to-day activities vary given the nature of our business, but the Senior Analyst can expect to balance answering business questions through in-depth analysis using multiple technologies, collaborating with stakeholders in key meetings, developing and executing self-service training programs, identifying & helping implement new technology features, working with vendors and attending leadership presentations.

On top of the various product categories we support and the multiple technologies we use, the world of social media and AI-driven technology changes rapidly. Therefore, a balance of technical skill, strategic thinking, proactivity, flexibility and a solution-seeking attitude is crucial for success in this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Social Listening, LLM Listening & Related Social Media Research, including Presentation to Stakeholders. Leverage Nestle USA’s Digital & Social Intelligence technology stack to conduct in-depth research about our brands, competitors, product categories and relevant cultural trends, using the insights to deliver a persuasive & visual story to stakeholders that drives action within their key initiatives. This includes navigating technology that handles every facet of Digital & Social Intelligence, such as social listening, ratings & reviews listening, LLM Listening / GEO / AEO, emerging trend identification, social audience persona building, influencer evaluation and owned content performance benchmarking. Where applicable, this also includes combining findings with other data sources outside of Social Intelligence, often via collaboration with our broader Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics and Consumer Insights teams, to provide comprehensive analysis to the stakeholder. Stakeholder Training & Guidance. Assist in the development and execution of training programs, including building training material, leading office hours and sitting one-on-one with stakeholders to guide them through use cases for social listening & social intelligence that build confidence in their ability to navigate the technology to find insights.Stakeholder Request Management. Assist the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager in managing an analysis request queue, which assigns priority to each ad-hoc social research request based on impact to the business, level of effort and urgency. This includes keeping track of stakeholder check-in cadences to ensure the Digital & Social Intelligence team is consistently engaging each key stakeholder group. Tool Output Scanning & Insights Identification. Review the automated reporting outputs from the various tools, including weekly/bi-weekly/monthly AI-driven reports and real-time email alerts, to ensure continuous improvement in the quality of the automated outputs while also mining for actionable insights that need to be flagged to our stakeholders for further discussion & potential action.Tool Maintenance & Governance. Assist in the day-to-day management of the tools, from user access to dashboard/report quality, flagging issues or needs to the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager while collaborating with 3rd party and shared service support teams. Vendor Collaboration. Partnering with analysts from 3rd parties and shared service teams on key research projects and key feature advancements, as well as brainstorming and providing feedback to tool providers on ideal features and functionality that maximize actionability. 
REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, market research, analytics, communications, business, economics, or related field3-5 years of experience in social listening and additional social research, including in-tool navigational experience and strategic storytelling of analysis results.3-5 years in a strategic role working with data analytics, with a focus on developing strong dashboards and/or other automatically refreshable visualizations that empower stakeholders to quickly identify key takeaways from data
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

Experience using Talkwalker, Nichefire, Yogi, Audiense, Creator IQ, Sprinklr or similar tools throughout every part of the process: query building, dashboard visualization, automated report building and ultimately in-depth analysis of key takeawaysFamiliarity with the emerging LLM Listening & Visibility / GEO / AEO analysis space, including tools such as ProfoundStrong understanding of how AI can be used to support Digital & Social Intelligence workstreams, including prompt-writing best practices to focus the observation summarizations of AI assistantsStrong research experience and familiarity with the process for developing consumer, category & cultural insightsStrong storytelling experience through the creation and presentation of compelling slide decksAbility to translate business needs into strategic social intelligence frameworks that can be executed & replicated across a large organizationFamiliarity with foresight use cases, identifying and analyzing trend signals from social media that ladder up to larger cultural movements or consumer behavior shiftsUnderstanding of the social media landscape, dynamics of community interaction, social best practices, and digital analytics toolsStrong communication and interpersonal skillsAbility to execute multiple projects at once across various stakeholder teams throughout a large organization
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Familiarity with experimentation and A/B testing of social/digital content executionsFamiliarity with Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager for website analyticsFamiliarity with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and its analytics functionalitiesFamiliarity with Power BI to create and visualize data from disparate data sets

HJF is seeking a Data Analyst I to provide analytic support to a team of pediatricians, epidemiologists, biostatisticians and research studies. The Henry M. Jackson Foundation for the Advancement of Military Medicine (HJF) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing military medicine. rows.title: Digital & Social Intelligence Senior Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Reporting into the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager within the Commercial Excellence organization, the Digital & Social Intelligence Senior Analyst will be a crucial addition to a team whose mission is to implement an adaptive, industry-leading Social Intelligence capability into Nestle USA that is considered a trusted source of actionable, real-time insight into consumer perception & culture. The Social Intelligence capability has been built to support stakeholders across Brand Marketing, Consumer & Marketplace Insights, Social Strategy & Community, Foresight, Innovation, Category Strategy, Corporate Communication and other teams; ultimately, our goal is to fully embed the capability throughout Nestle USA and empower stakeholders across every department to act upon real-time social media insights.

Additionally, the Senior Analyst will be a crucial member of the emerging cross-functional capability of AI Readiness by supporting LLM Listening & Visibility analysis, including tool implementation & governance, stakeholder support and incorporation into Social Intelligence analysis deliverables.

After supporting the final stages of the Social Intelligence capability’s implementation across Nestle USA, and the incorporation of LLM Listening into our processes, the Digital & Social Intelligence Senior Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to provide consistent, timely & actionable insights for our brands, while forging a continuous stakeholder feedback loop on our offerings. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Senior Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Senior Analyst will be expected to balance supporting stakeholders by fulfilling research requests using our best-in-class technology stack, while also training the stakeholders to be able to leverage the technology to find insights on their own. This balance will allow the Senior Analyst, along with the rest of the Digital & Social Intelligence team, to focus our efforts on the most important in-depth analysis the organization needs, while empowering our stakeholders to conduct their own light monitoring of day-to-day digital & social insights questions. The role will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Shopper Insights and Innovation, to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams.

The Senior Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. Day-to-day activities vary given the nature of our business, but the Senior Analyst can expect to balance answering business questions through in-depth analysis using multiple technologies, collaborating with stakeholders in key meetings, developing and executing self-service training programs, identifying & helping implement new technology features, working with vendors and attending leadership presentations.

On top of the various product categories we support and the multiple technologies we use, the world of social media and AI-driven technology changes rapidly. Therefore, a balance of technical skill, strategic thinking, proactivity, flexibility and a solution-seeking attitude is crucial for success in this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Social Listening, LLM Listening & Related Social Media Research, including Presentation to Stakeholders. Leverage Nestle USA’s Digital & Social Intelligence technology stack to conduct in-depth research about our brands, competitors, product categories and relevant cultural trends, using the insights to deliver a persuasive & visual story to stakeholders that drives action within their key initiatives. This includes navigating technology that handles every facet of Digital & Social Intelligence, such as social listening, ratings & reviews listening, LLM Listening / GEO / AEO, emerging trend identification, social audience persona building, influencer evaluation and owned content performance benchmarking. Where applicable, this also includes combining findings with other data sources outside of Social Intelligence, often via collaboration with our broader Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics and Consumer Insights teams, to provide comprehensive analysis to the stakeholder. Stakeholder Training & Guidance. Assist in the development and execution of training programs, including building training material, leading office hours and sitting one-on-one with stakeholders to guide them through use cases for social listening & social intelligence that build confidence in their ability to navigate the technology to find insights.Stakeholder Request Management. Assist the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager in managing an analysis request queue, which assigns priority to each ad-hoc social research request based on impact to the business, level of effort and urgency. This includes keeping track of stakeholder check-in cadences to ensure the Digital & Social Intelligence team is consistently engaging each key stakeholder group. Tool Output Scanning & Insights Identification. Review the automated reporting outputs from the various tools, including weekly/bi-weekly/monthly AI-driven reports and real-time email alerts, to ensure continuous improvement in the quality of the automated outputs while also mining for actionable insights that need to be flagged to our stakeholders for further discussion & potential action.Tool Maintenance & Governance. Assist in the day-to-day management of the tools, from user access to dashboard/report quality, flagging issues or needs to the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager while collaborating with 3rd party and shared service support teams. Vendor Collaboration. Partnering with analysts from 3rd parties and shared service teams on key research projects and key feature advancements, as well as brainstorming and providing feedback to tool providers on ideal features and functionality that maximize actionability. 
REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, market research, analytics, communications, business, economics, or related field3-5 years of experience in social listening and additional social research, including in-tool navigational experience and strategic storytelling of analysis results.3-5 years in a strategic role working with data analytics, with a focus on developing strong dashboards and/or other automatically refreshable visualizations that empower stakeholders to quickly identify key takeaways from data
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

Experience using Talkwalker, Nichefire, Yogi, Audiense, Creator IQ, Sprinklr or similar tools throughout every part of the process: query building, dashboard visualization, automated report building and ultimately in-depth analysis of key takeawaysFamiliarity with the emerging LLM Listening & Visibility / GEO / AEO analysis space, including tools such as ProfoundStrong understanding of how AI can be used to support Digital & Social Intelligence workstreams, including prompt-writing best practices to focus the observation summarizations of AI assistantsStrong research experience and familiarity with the process for developing consumer, category & cultural insightsStrong storytelling experience through the creation and presentation of compelling slide decksAbility to translate business needs into strategic social intelligence frameworks that can be executed & replicated across a large organizationFamiliarity with foresight use cases, identifying and analyzing trend signals from social media that ladder up to larger cultural movements or consumer behavior shiftsUnderstanding of the social media landscape, dynamics of community interaction, social best practices, and digital analytics toolsStrong communication and interpersonal skillsAbility to execute multiple projects at once across various stakeholder teams throughout a large organization
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Familiarity with experimentation and A/B testing of social/digital content executionsFamiliarity with Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager for website analyticsFamiliarity with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and its analytics functionalitiesFamiliarity with Power BI to create and visualize data from disparate data sets 
Salary: $100,000.00 to $120,000.00 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.
