rows.title: Postdoctoral Fellow - PMB

company.name: The Henry M. Jackson Foundation for the Advancement of Military Medicine

rows.descriptionText:
Join the HJF Team!
HJF is seeking a Postdoctoral Fellow who is responsible for initiating and carrying out research projects in collaboration with a research team. Pursuits research along a focused line of inquiry and has a manuscript in development.
This position will be in support of the Preventive Medicine and Biostatistics department at the University Services University of the Health Sciences located in Bethesda, MD.
The Postdoctoral Research fellow will be working on a National Science Foundation (NSF) funded project that aims to build the first integrated phylogenomic, morphological, and ecological framework of the entire Anopheline mosquito subfamily. Mosquitoes are the deadliest animals on Earth, and anopheline mosquitoes alone transmit the malaria parasites responsible for hundreds of thousands of deaths every year. Their ranges are shifting in unpredictable ways under climate and land-use change, yet fewer than 75 of the nearly 500 known Anopheline species have ever been tested for their ability to transmit human pathogens; and most lack even a basic evolutionary or ecological framework.
The Postdoctoral Research Fellow will lead genomic assembly and phylogenomic inference, contribute to 3D morphometric trait extraction and environmental niche modeling, and co-lead peer-reviewed manuscripts across multiple aims. This is an unusually broad, integrative opportunity for a scientist who wants to work at the intersection of phylogenomics, functional morphology, ecology, and public health entomology, with the training, publications, and network to launch an independent research career.
The Henry M. Jackson Foundation for the Advancement of Military Medicine (HJF) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing military medicine. We serve military, medical, academic and government clients by administering, managing and supporting preeminent scientific programs that benefit members of the armed forces and civilians alike. Since its founding in 1983, HJF has served as a vital link between the military medical community and its federal and private partners. rows.title: CTIO-AI Engineer-Sr Associate
rows.descriptionText:
At PwC, our people in data and analytics engineering focus on leveraging advanced technologies and techniques to design and develop robust data solutions for clients. They play a crucial role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth.

Those in data science and machine learning engineering at PwC will focus on leveraging advanced analytics and machine learning techniques to extract insights from large datasets and drive data-driven decision making. You will work on developing predictive models, conducting statistical analysis, and creating data visualisations to solve complex business problems.

Focused on relationships, you are building meaningful client connections, and learning how to manage and inspire others. Navigating increasingly complex situations, you are growing your personal brand, deepening technical expertise and awareness of your strengths. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality. Embracing increased ambiguity, you are comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, you ask questions, and you use these moments as opportunities to grow.

Skills

Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:

Respond effectively to the diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others.

Use a broad range of tools, methodologies and techniques to generate new ideas and solve problems.

Use critical thinking to break down complex concepts.

Understand the broader objectives of your project or role and how your work fits into the overall strategy.

Develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is changing.

Use reflection to develop self awareness, enhance strengths and address development areas.

Interpret data to inform insights and recommendations.

Uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.

The Opportunity

As part of the Data and Analytics Engineering team you will develop and implement AI solutions that enhance product offerings. As a Senior Associate, you will analyze complex problems, mentor junior team members, and maintain elevated professional standards while building meaningful client relationships.

Responsibilities

 Build and nurture meaningful relationships with clients Utilize advanced analytical techniques to drive innovation Work with cross-functional teams to achieve project goals Uphold the firm's ethical standards and recommended practices

What You Must Have

 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Data Processing/Analytics/Science, Artificial Intelligence and Robotics 3 years of professional experience developing AI/ML systems or integrating AI into products

What Sets You Apart

 Master's Degree preferred Possessing advanced proficiency in prompt engineering Demonstrating experience deploying LLMs into production Designing and optimizing RAG pipelines Leading technical discovery in fast-paced environments Collaborating effectively with cross-functional leaders Advocating for responsible AI principles Contributing to AI research or open-source communities Demonstrating knowledge of orchestration tools such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, and experience with agent-based systems

The salary range for this position is: $55,000 - $151,470. For residents of Washington state the salary range for this position is: $55,000 - $187,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. To view our benefits at a glance, please visit the following link: https://pwc.to/benefits-at-a-glance

rows.title: Full stack Software Engineer (AI Enablement Engineer)
rows.descriptionText:
Hiring Full stack Software Engineer (AI Enablement Engineer)

Location: Rockville, MD or McLean, VA (Hybrid)

Only Local DC/VA/MD who can take Assessment and for Onsite interview

Pay range: .-55/hr DOE on W2

Job Description

This position supports a newly approved AI Finance Readiness initiative focused on improving finance and administrative business processes through AI-enabled discovery, proof-of-concepts, and targeted implementations.

The engineer will partner with business stakeholders, architects, and technical teams to evaluate opportunities across systems such as Workday Financials, FlexTrack, and other finance-related platforms. The goal is not to build foundational AI models, but rather to determine where modern AI technologies can improve workflows, efficiency, analytics, and decision-making.

Key Focus Areas

AI-Driven Business Process Discovery

Evaluate finance and administrative workflows to identify opportunities for AI-enabled improvements. Conduct discovery sessions with business stakeholders and help assess feasibility of potential AI solutions. Support POCs and pilot initiatives that may ultimately lead to production implementations. Analyze existing processes and determine whether AI enhancements or alternative workflows provide the greatest value. Technology Environment

Strong engineering foundation in: Java AWS Python Exposure to modern AI platforms and tools such as: Claude Amazon Bedrock LLM-based solutions Experience with analytics platforms, automation tools, and SaaS integrations is beneficial but not required. Previous experience with RPA or workflow automation initiatives is highly relevant, as the organization views AI as a natural evolution of past automation efforts. What They Are NOT Looking For

Not seeking an AI researcher or someone building foundational LLMs. Not looking for a "unicorn" with every emerging AI skill. Not interested in candidates who simply leverage AI-generated code without understanding architecture, tradeoffs, and implementation details. This is not a pure data science or machine learning engineering role. Ideal Candidate Profile

Must-Have Characteristics

Strong senior-level software engineer with solid Java, AWS, and Python experience. Demonstrated curiosity and active investment in learning modern AI technologies. Ability to quickly evaluate AI use cases and determine technical feasibility. Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills. Comfortable translating business problems into practical technical solutions. Able to articulate pros, cons, risks, and implementation approaches during POC discussions. Nice-to-Have Experience

SaaS integration experience. Workday Financials or enterprise finance systems exposure. FlexTrack experience. Analytics platform integration experience. RPA or intelligent automation background. Personality & Mindset

Strong engineering judgment and architectural thinking. Consultative approach with business users. Comfortable navigating environments where stakeholders have differing opinions on AI solutions. Learning-oriented and adaptable to rapidly evolving AI technologies. Preference for senior engineers who can operate independently, though exceptional mid-level candidates with strong learning agility will also be considered. Interview Screening Themes

Engineering Fundamentals Depth in Java, AWS, and Python. Architecture and design thinking. Ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs. AI Adoption & Learning Mindset How are they using Claude, Bedrock, Copilot, or similar tools? Examples of AI-enabled solutions they have explored or implemented. How they stay current with emerging AI technologies. Business Partnership Experience gathering requirements and working directly with business stakeholders. Ability to challenge assumptions and assess feasibility. POC & Innovation Experience Examples of leading discovery efforts, pilots, or proof-of-concepts. How they evaluated success criteria and implementation options. Communication Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Experience influencing architects, business leaders, and engineering teams.

rows.title: AI/ML Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
ABS Group is seeking an AI/ML Engineer to join our Artificial Intelligence Practice in support of a major federal modernization program. In this role, you will design, develop, and operationalize machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions that support mission applications and data-driven workflows.

You will help bring AI capabilities into production, build supporting pipelines and model operations workflows, and work across data science, engineering, and cloud teams to deliver scalable, secure, and trustworthy AI solutions. The scope of responsibility, degree of technical leadership, and level of independence expected will reflect the level at which this position is filled.

What You Will Do

- Design, develop, and operate AI and machine learning capabilities for production applications and data workflows


- Build and maintain data and model pipelines that support training, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management


- Partner with data scientists, developers, and cloud engineers to productionize AI solutions


- Implement MLOps and related engineering practices for model deployment, monitoring, retraining, and version control


- Support generative AI and large language model implementations, including prompt workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, and vector-based retrieval patterns


- Apply AI/ML to adjacent use cases such as test automation, workflow support, and operational optimization


- Contribute to CI/CD, observability, and operational support for AI systems in secure environments


- Support responsible AI and model governance practices, including explainability and compliance requirements


- Document architectures, workflows, and engineering standards for project delivery


What You Will Need
Level and Compensation: This position may be filled at multiple career levels based on business need and the selected candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and demonstrated capability. Typical leveling for this role is as follows:
- Junior (0 to 4 years)

- Mid-Level (5 to 9 years)

- Senior (10 to 14 years)

- Principal (15 or more years)

These ranges are guidelines only and are not the sole determining factor in level. The posted compensation range reflects the full range across all possible levels. Individual offers will be based on the level at which the candidate is hired, as well as factors such as skills, experience, internal equity, and geographic market considerations where applicable.


Education and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred


- Relevant professional experience in AI engineering, machine learning engineering, or related software engineering roles; the depth and scope of experience required will vary based on the level at which this position is filled


- Experience deploying or supporting machine learning and AI systems in production environments preferred


- Experience working in cloud-based or hybrid technical environments preferred

-


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

- Proficiency in Python


- Familiarity with frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn


- Familiarity with MLOps, CI/CD for ML, and model monitoring concepts and practices


- Exposure to LLMOps, AIOps, RAG, and vector databases


- Experience building or supporting data pipelines for AI/ML applications


- Understanding of software engineering and DevSecOps practices for production systems


- Strong collaboration skills across technical teams and stakeholders

-


Nice to Have

- Experience supporting production ML at scale


- Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP AI/ML services


- Familiarity with federal, public sector, or regulated AI environments


- Exposure to NLP, classification, survey analytics, or entity resolution use cases

Location

This position is based in the Washington, D.C. metro area, with primary work performed in Suitland, Maryland. Remote or hybrid arrangements may be available for eligible work, subject to government approval.
Notice: This role has been opened for a future need expected within three months of the original posting date of this position. Potential candidates may not receive communication until the open headcount is confirmed.

rows.title: Sr. Director, Healthcare

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Relocation Assistance Offered Within Country

Job Number #176648 - New York, New York, United States

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

As the Senior Director - Healthcare (Sales team), you will be the strategic architect of our partnerships with CVS, Walgreens, and our network of Healthcare distributors and redistributors, which represent some of Colgate-Palmolive’s most critical retail partnerships. The role can be based in NY or Chicago. You will lead our team to drive sustainable growth, optimize category performance, and deepen our relationships with merchant leadership across these key accounts. You will be responsible for the total P&L across our iconic brands within the Healthcare ecosystem. This role requires a visionary leader who understands the nuances of CVS and Walgreens go-to-market strategies, retail media solutions, and complex distributor operations, along with having an Omnichannel mindset to drive success on their respective digital platforms. Our ideal candidate is an experienced and versatile business leader who has a proven track record of high performance, thinks big, and operates at depth. In addition, this leader has experience managing diverse teams in a highly dynamic business environment.

Key Responsibilities

 Strategic Leadership & PartnershipJoint Value Creation: Lead the development and execution of multi-year profitable growth plans (JBPs) that align Colgate-Palmolive's corporate goals with the strategic priorities and value propositions of CVS, Walgreens, and our distribution partners. Executive Presence: Serve as the primary face of Colgate-Palmolive to the leadership at CVS, Walgreens, and our distributors, deepening relationships, fostering trust, and driving high-level advocacy. Category Influence: Position our brands as category thought leaders by leveraging data-driven insights to influence assortment and shelf strategies across the healthcare channel.  Team Management & CultureOffice Leadership: Oversee the Healthcare team, fostering a high-performance culture that attracts and retains top-tier CPG talent. Cross-Functional Synergy: Lead a multi-disciplinary team across Sales, Category Management, Supply Chain, OMNI shopper, and Finance, as well as, agency management to ensure seamless execution. Mentorship: Coach and develop Account Managers and National Account Executives for future leadership roles.  Financial & Operational ExcellenceP&L Ownership: Manage the full Healthcare P&L (CVS, Walgreens, and Distributors), including gross/net sales, trade spend, and profitability margins. Omnichannel Integration: Collaborate with digital teams to ensure "best-in-class" presence on CVS.com and Walgreens.com, and maximize ROI on retail media investments. Forecast Accuracy: Partner with Demand Planning to ensure high in-stock levels across all retailers and redistributors, particularly during peak seasonal windows and promotional periods. 

Responsibilities

Able to lead and influence across multiple levels of the organization and effectively lead, collaborate, communicate and influence in a matrix environment. You take the lead by influencing the agenda through collaboration, negotiation and thought leadership. Find creative opportunities to grow and improve the business across the board. Your ability to adapt and adjust the strategy, willingness to take risks, and incorporate findings into the strategy quickly is the main way you can succeed. Leveraging insights, you are comfortable challenging the status quo. Proven ability to analyze relevant data, insights and information to identify opportunities and develop strategic plans to drive a commercial agenda. Grasp of the big picture and can clearly identify areas of opportunity. Collaborate with key cross-functional partners to identify opportunities for growth and build selling stories. Proven experience leading and collaborating within cross-discipline teams, networking and building strong relationships with Insights and Analytics, OMNI Shopper, Marketing, Supply Chain, Research & Development, and Sales. Strong oral and written communication skills; ability to effectively and efficiently educate and influence internal and external stakeholders at all levels. Seeking opportunities to improve via creative solutions. You dig into the reason behind the numbers, are able to look at the results and find out the reasons for what is driving those results and guide the team accordingly. 

Required Qualifications

Job Summary

The Specialty Territory Manager plans, develops, and manages the execution of commercial initiatives to attain or exceed sales targets established by the management team.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

Effectively handle lifting of various objects weighing up to 12 pounds.  While performing the essential functions of the job, the employee will be required to bend, stoop, kneel, reach, and climb stairs.  This role is primarily performed in a remote office setting and requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (e.g., seated or standing) for extended periods. The employee will work in a home-office environment and travel to medical offices, clinics, hospitals, and other meeting locations. The role requires up to 90% field travel throughout the assigned territory, including up to 50% overnight travel. 

The salary range for this position is $74-900-135,000K USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone USA additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. To give our employees flexibility, Danone is a hybrid work environment.

About You

The ideal candidate will bring a combination of education, experience, and skills that enable them to excel in this position. The following qualifications outline what we’re looking for, including both required and preferred criteria

Education & Experience

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Business, Sales, Marketing, Nutrition, or related field. A minimum of 1-8 years of recent sales or equivalent related work experience, aligned with the level of the role. Registered Dietitian preferred. 

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strategic thinking and problem solving . Strong interpersonal and communication skills . Negotiation and analytic skills . Possess a proactive attitude, initiative, and drive to learn. Highly organized with the ability to multi-task, prioritize, and work efficiently. Must possess computer skills with a keen understanding of business software such as Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, email, and calendar. Be flexible and embrace change with a growing and evolving company. 

About us

Danone North America Medical Nutrition brings together a growing portfolio of mission-driven brands, including Kate Farms, Nutricia, Neocate, Pepticate, Functional Formularies, and Real Food Blends. Together, we deliver science-backed nutrition solutions for infants, children, and adults with complex nutritional needs, whether they consume nutrition orally or through a feeding tube.

Our ambition is clear to improve health outcomes, expand access to high-quality nutrition, help reduce healthcare costs, and build sustainable growth. We combine trusted, consumer-loved brands with strong scientific and medical expertise to create nutrition solutions that make a meaningful difference in people’s lives.

By joining our approximately 450-person North America Medical Nutrition organization, you will become part of Danone’s broader North American and global network. You will have the opportunity to contribute to a growing business, collaborate across brands and functions, and help shape the future of medical nutrition in the US.

rows.descriptionText:

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Role Summary:

This Post Doctoral Research Scientist role focuses exclusively on understanding oxidative stress pathways and sensory responses in human oral mucosa triggered by oral care products. Your research will focus on developing in vitro and ex vivo models to study reactive oxygen species (ROS) associated pathways on oral mucosal and neuron-like cells. You will establish key biomarkers on oxidative stress related cytotoxicity. You will lead early-stage research programs that guide cross-functional teams in formulating safer, next-generation oral care products.

Responsibilities:

Discovery & Mechanistic Research

Scientific Discovery: Execute in vitro and ex vivo studies to evaluate oxidative stress induction and neuronal activation in oral tissue models exposed to novel formulations. Mechanistic Cellular Pathology: Investigate cellular signaling cascades linked to oxidative stress and neurogenic sensory responses . Biomarker Identification: Utilize -omics platforms to identify salivary and biological markers specific to oxidative markers and cytotoxicity. Protocol Design: Standardize testing protocols for screening active ingredients based on redox balance and neuronal reactivity. Technical Reporting: Translate oxidative and neuro-response dataset findings into guidelines for product development teams. 

Cross-Functional Innovation Strategy

Interdepartmental Partnership: Communicate mechanistic findings on oxidative stress and neuro-activation to Safety, Regulatory, and R&D leadership. Legal & IP Strategy: Work with Legal/IP to secure patent protection for novel models or formulations mitigating oxidative and neurological stress. 

Laboratory Excellence & Data Science

Lab Models: Establish high-throughput oxidative assay screening systems. Protocol Development: Standardize testing methods for quantifying ROS generation and neuronal responses. Advanced Analytics: Leverage bioinformatics tools to analyze gene expression changes in oxidative and neuro response pathways. 

Required Qualifications:

PhD in Oral Biology, Toxicology Oral Immunology, or a related fieldResearch experience in one or more of the following areas:Oral Mucosal Irritation Expertise: Deep understanding of irritation on oral soft tissues and mechanism of action of compounds inducing oral ulceration . Oral Immunology Expertise: Understanding of oral immunology, specifically the mechanisms of allergic sensitization and the inflammatory cascades leading to mucosal ulceration. Biomarker Validation: Experience in identifying, quantifying, and validating biological markers from biosamples such as saliva and blood. Bio-informatics: Data analysis and developing computable prediction models. 
Preferred Qualifications:

Toxicology and Immunology: Hands-on experience. Risk Assessment & Safety Evaluation: Database knowledge and computational predictionRegulatory Knowledge: Safety databases, status of common oral care ingredients.

About The Job

Job Summary

The Specialty Territory Manager plans, develops, and manages the execution of commercial initiatives to attain or exceed sales targets established by the management team.

Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will play an important role in driving our mission forward. The following responsibilities outline the core expectations and contributions for this position

Achieve 100% of monthly, quarterly, annual sales plan. Plan and develop the market for our existing and new products in accordance with company goals and objectives; optimize available selling tools (marketing collateral, product brochure, trunk stock, demo product, iPad videos, etc.). Drive demand for products by Attaining Hospital Formulary approvals Gaining exposure to Health Care Providers and driving brand preference and loyalty . Driving prescriptions, and Discharge Orders. Community Awareness (events). Partnership Development (Distribution, manufacturing, home care) . Service – sampling, and one-by-one strategy . Ongoing technical training and support to customers (In-Services). Competent contact person for hospital management, purchasing department and hospital staff. Analyze and report to your manager and/or others (weekly & monthly) the market and business feedback by using all available support tools (email, iPad, company laptop). 

Physical Demands & Work Environment

Effectively handle lifting of various objects weighing up to 12 pounds.  While performing the essential functions of the job, the employee will be required to bend, stoop, kneel, reach, and climb stairs.  This role is primarily performed in a remote office setting and requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (e.g., seated or standing) for extended periods. The employee will work in a home-office environment and travel to medical offices, clinics, hospitals, and other meeting locations. The role requires up to 90% field travel throughout the assigned territory, including up to 50% overnight travel. 

The salary range for this position is $74,900-135,000K USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. To give our employees flexibility, Danone is a hybrid work environment.

About You

The ideal candidate will bring a combination of education, experience, and skills that enable them to excel in this position. The following qualifications outline what we’re looking for, including both required and preferred criteria

Education & Experience

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Business, Sales, Marketing, Nutrition, or related field. A minimum of 1-8 years of recent sales or equivalent related work experience, aligned with the level of the role. Registered Dietitian preferred. 

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strategic thinking and problem solving . Strong interpersonal and communication skills . Negotiation and analytic skills . Possess a proactive attitude, initiative, and drive to learn. Highly organized with the ability to multi-task, prioritize, and work efficiently. Must possess computer skills with a keen understanding of business software such as Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, email, and calendar. Be flexible and embrace change with a growing and evolving company. 

About us

Danone North America Medical Nutrition brings together a growing portfolio of mission-driven brands, including Kate Farms, Nutricia, Neocate, Pepticate, Functional Formularies, and Real Food Blends. Together, we deliver science-backed nutrition solutions for infants, children, and adults with complex nutritional needs, whether they consume nutrition orally or through a feeding tube.

Our ambition is clear to improve health outcomes, expand access to high-quality nutrition, help reduce healthcare costs, and build sustainable growth. We combine trusted, consumer-loved brands with strong scientific and medical expertise to create nutrition solutions that make a meaningful difference in people’s lives.

By joining our approximately 450-person North America Medical Nutrition organization, you will become part of Danone’s broader North American and global network. You will have the opportunity to contribute to a growing business, collaborate across brands and functions, and help shape the future of medical nutrition in the US.

You will also join one of the world’s largest Certified B Corporations, working for a company committed to creating lasting value for people and the planet.

rows.title: Project Manager D&A
rows.descriptionText:
Project Manager D&A (18 Months Fixed Term Contract)

Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way

Technology at Primark

Our technology team is actively shaping the next wave of advancements. Engaged with innovative initiatives, your expertise will propel our business into the future. Collaborating with a creative team of tech enthusiasts, you’ll contribute your unique skills to fuel our technological advancements.

What You’ll Get

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, Potential Bonus,Pension,27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You’ll Do As a Project Manager D&A

We want you to feel challenged and inspired. Here, you’ll develop your skills across a range of responsibilities:

Lead end‑to‑end delivery of D&A technology components—including data products, platform enhancements, integrations, and analytics—while aligning to strategic project objectives.Oversee multimillion‑pound project budgets (£2m–£6m), ensuring accurate forecasting, cost control, and timely variance management.Develop and maintain detailed project plans covering scope, deliverables, timelines, risks, issues, dependencies, and resource needs, ensuring adherence to Primark’s governance and technical standards.Direct and motivate cross‑functional teams, clarifying roles, ensuring quality assurance of deliverables, and building strong working relationships across business, tech, and supplier groups.Provide regular stakeholder reporting, highlighting progress, risks, mitigations, and insights to influence decision‑making and maintain delivery momentum.Manage external vendors and internal stakeholders, negotiate contracts, track KPIs and benefits realisation, and coach team members to support their professional growth.

What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:

Bring 5+ years’ experience delivering complex technology projects particularly within Data & Analytics across defined scope, timelines, budgets, and quality standards, with strong stakeholder and communication skills.Demonstrate deep D&A expertise, including data platforms, migrations, modelling, governance, and analytics, with hands-on exposure to cloud technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, and Power BI.Apply solid understanding of data architecture, operating models, and retail data domains (product, customer, inventory, pricing, forecasting, etc.) to guide effective technology delivery.Operate confidently across Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models, driving governance, sprint planning, backlog management, and acceptance criteria for data products.Manage multiple workstreams in parallel while building relationships with senior stakeholders, vendors, and cross-functional teams within a complex matrix environment.Benefit from leading a strategically significant programme within a major retail brand, gaining senior leadership exposure and working in a collaborative culture that values delivery excellence.

Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 440 stores in 17 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.

All offers of employment are subject to background checks, including right to work, reference education and for some roles criminal, and financial checks. If you have any concerns, please reach out to our talent acquisition team to discuss.

,

rows.title: Consumer Insight Director WP+
rows.descriptionText:
We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.

Consumer Insight Director

Office location: London, UK

Role Type: Permanent

Worldpanel | Decoding Shopper Behaviour for Smarter Brand Growth

About Worldpanel By Numerator

Worldpanel by Numerator provides consumer data representing nearly 6 billion consumers in 65 countries, offering brands a multi-dimensional view of how people think, how they shop, and how they consumer, so they can set bold strategies and drive sustainable business impact.

Reasonable Adjustments

Worldpanel is committed to offering equal opportunities to all individuals including during the recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments or assistance, please advise us in advance of your interview so that we can make the necessary arrangements.

Role Overview

As a Consumer Insight Director, you will help our clients turn purchase and consumption behaviour into competitive advantages through continuous monitoring, advanced analytics and delivering tailored solutions. Worldpanel Plus is a new technology that responds to changing consumer and shopper behaviour to ensure our insight stays relevant and even more inspiring than ever. Using a custom-made smartphone app, Shoppix, launched in June 2017, Worldpanel Plus allows panelists to record their purchases and the motivations behind them in real time. Users photograph their receipts through the app, which can in turn trigger surveys to assess why they made their purchase decisions.

This role is the perfect opportunity for a retail expert to drive the service development of a Growth Platform with key clients.

What your day-to-day role with us would include:

Account management and immersion within key retailer clients. As Worldpanel Plus grows more and more of our retail clients are buying contractual services from us. This means we need a great addition to the team to run these clients and deliver and present insightful projects using Worldpanel Plus data. To date the core of the sales drive has been to our key retail partners on categories in General Merchandise such as:, DIY, Homeware Toys and Stationery. Management and delivery of Worldpanel Plus projects. Employing your ever growing industry knowledge and insight generating abilities to solve client research briefs using the new data. Growing the use of the insight within the clients business and leading the client through the evolution of the service as it develops. Worldpanel Plus is an exciting new service. Clients are reacting very positively to have data in these areas for the time and you will need to provide them with clarity on what is feasible and manage their expectations so that they enjoy the full benefits of Worldpanel Plus and grow their usage of the data over time. Promoting the service to clients and educating internal audiences. Become an expert with the new data, understanding and articulating its capabilities, benefits and quirks to educate the wider business and promote the service to our client base. Delivering against team commercial targets. Also looking for opportunities to help the client across the breadth of the new service, whether that be checking why their shoppers are not buying certain categories in store through surveys or what the opportunity is within ecommerce for example. There are a myriad of ways we could help our clients so it means developing good client relationships and keeping your finger on the pulse. Close sales through consultative selling by working in partnership with relevant account teams and new business people. Helping to develop and evolve the capabilities of the service. As one of the key client interfaces of Worldpanel Plus your role will be crucial to the development of the service. It’s critical that we understand and meet the client requirements and gather their feedback so we can develop the service. Hence we will need you to provide feedback of your experiences on client briefs and making relevant suggestions for improvements and enhancements in team forums as well as by testing new capabilities in real client situations. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

What you will bring to our team:

A self-sufficient and pro-active attitude with a willingness to learn new skills and adapt to ever evolving circumstances. A consistent track record of understanding shopper behaviour and a willingness to dive into panel data, exploring and interpreting what you discover. Experience and ability in communicating insights in a compelling and convincing manner to senior client audiences. Great client management skills ensuring the service is met with excitement and joint willingness to evolve. An ability to help close sales and energetically promote the benefits of research services to clients and internal audiences. 

Worldpanel Benefits

25 days holidays Option of flexible hybrid workingEmployee Assistance ProgrammePrivate Medical & Dental InsuranceEyecare VouchersLife Assurance & Income ProtectionCycle to Work Scheme

Why Join Worldpanel?

At Worldpanel we have an integrated way of rewarding our people based around a simple, clear and consistent set of principles. Our approach helps to ensure we are market competitive and also to support a pay for performance culture, where your reward and career progression opportunities are linked to what you deliver.

We go beyond the obvious, using intelligence, passion and creativity to inspire new thinking and shape the world we live in. Apply for a career that’s out of the ordinary and join us.

We want to create an equality of opportunity in a fair and supportive working environment where people feel included, accepted and are allowed to flourish in a space where their mental health and well-being is taken into consideration.

We want to create a more diverse community to expand our talent pool, be locally representative, drive diversity of thinking and better commercial outcomes.

rows.title: Insight Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behaviour, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing? 

Utilizing extensive industry knowledge to provide valuable insights to solve client business challenges, the ideal candidate would have a high degree of autonomy and problem-solving capabilities. The candidate should have a track record of using innovative and inspiring insight to grow our client’s business, paired with superb organizational and interpersonal engagement skills to deliver an all-round excellent service to the client.

Job Responsibilities

Drive Client Growth: Identify and pursue opportunities to expand client relationships by aligning Circana’s data and software solutions with their strategic goals. Deliver Insight-Led Solutions: Translate complex data into actionable insights that help clients make informed decisions and achieve measurable outcomes. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with internal teams (e.g., Client Insights, Product, and Analytics) to deliver integrated solutions and ensure client success. Maintain Industry Expertise: Stay current on trends in [retail, CPG, or general merchandise] to position Circana as a thought leader and trusted advisor. Utilize Sales Tools and Platforms: Leverage Circana’s proprietary platforms (e.g., Unify+, Liquid Data, Intelligence Suite) to support client engagements and solution delivery. Champion Client Success: Ensure client satisfaction by proactively addressing challenges, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering consistent value. Advanced Analytic Skills: Demonstrated ability to conceive, manage, and deliver fact-based analyses, with a focus on consumer solutions, providing clients with clear, actionable insights to inform strategy. 

Requirements

Educational background at degree level preferredExperience in a similar role preferred (i.e. Category, Insight, Data)Experience required in the application of market measurement data including shopper

Circana Behaviours

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviours sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviours throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Chiswick Park - London & Bracknell

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing?

You will be one of two dedicated senior consultants embedded with a leading consumer health client who is based in Summit, New Jersey, working across some of the most recognized brands in skin care, oral care, and self care. This is a decision advisor role. You will frame the business question with the client's RGM, pricing & assortment strategy, brand, category and customer teams, work with Circana's modeling team to get the right answer, lead the working session, and land a recommendation the client actually takes to market.

You will work across the full program, spanning both price and promotion and assortment, and you will be measured on the commercial decisions you influence, not the number of scenarios you run.

This is an hybrid role within commutable distance to the client's HQ in Summit NJ as you will spend a minimum of two days a week onsite with the client. The role sits in Circana's Analytics organization, with day-to-day account accountability to the Client Insights team that leads the relationship.

Job Responsibilities

Be the trusted advisor to RGM and category teams: Be the day-to-day analytics partner to the client's pricing, RGM, category and brand teams. Understand their planning calendar, their line review cycle, and the retailer conversations they are preparing for, and bring a point of view to those moments rather than waiting to be asked. Earn the seat at the table where pricing and assortment decisions get made. Shape pricing and promotion decisions: Interpret base and promoted price elasticities, cross-price effects, price gaps and thresholds across the client's categories and key retailers. Use Circana's platform to pressure test pricing and promotion scenarios with the client, then translate them into pricing corridors, promotional guidelines and retailer-specific recommendations the client can defend in a buyer meeting. Shape assortment and retailer decisions: Apply demand transferability and incrementality outputs at the retailer and market level to line reviews, new item decisions, delisting and planogram trade-offs. Use assortment simulations, including planogram upload and new item scenarios, to build the retailer story with the client and help them win the line review. Connect analytics to commercial outcomes: Frame the question, coordinate the modeling work, lead the working session, and package the recommendation. Follow the decision through to what happened in market and bring that back to the client so the program is judged on results. Manage the cadence of quarterly refreshes, remodels, new item updates and category reviews so the client always knows what is coming and when. Partner with Circana's delivery teams: Work closely with the Global Solutions modeling team, the Client Insights team on the account, and the dedicated analyst. Own the specs the models depend on (product groupings, attributes, geographies) and make sure what gets built matches what the client will use. Build capability on the client side: Train and support client users on the platforms, run office hours, and raise the client's fluency in elasticities, transferability and optimization so they can self-serve on the routine questions and lean on you for the hard ones. Find the next opportunity: Spot the next question before the client asks it. Actively look for adjacent problems the client is working on, whether in Growth Consulting, demand forecasting, causal analytics or other Circana solutions, and bring them to the commercial lead with a point of view on how to scope them. You will be closer to the client's agenda than anyone else at Circana, and we expect you to use that. Communicate with presence: Present clearly and confidently to senior client stakeholders. Tell the story from what the model says to what the business should do, and be willing to challenge the client's thinking when the data supports it. 

Requirements

Ideally 10 to 14 years of experience in CPG revenue growth management, pricing and promotion analytics, category management, or a consulting or analytics role serving CPG clientsA track record of using price elasticity, promotional effectiveness, demand transferability or assortment optimization outputs to influence real pricing, promotion or assortment decisions, and the ability to explain how those models work to a business audienceExperience with Point of Sale (POS), syndicated and panel data; Circana or comparable syndicated data experience strongly preferredDemonstrated ability to lead working sessions, present recommendations to director and VP-level client stakeholders, and hold a position when challengedExperience in consumer health, OTC, beauty or personal care categories preferredFamiliarity with pricing, promotion and assortment simulation platforms preferredBachelor's degree required in business, economics, marketing, statistics or a related field; advanced degree in a quantitative discipline preferred but not requiredLocated in or able to commute to Summit, New Jersey a minimum of two days per week to be at the client's HQ

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

Hybrid role. This position can be located in the following area(s): Northern New Jersey / New York metro, with a minimum of two days per week onsite in Summit, NJ. Limited additional travel (under 5%).

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $139000 to $190000.

This job is also eligible for incentive pay.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. Circana uses artificial intelligence (AI) to assess resumes for alignment with job requirements by helping locate details in resumes that relate to the job description.

This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

rows.title: Software Engineer, AI

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
What is Bilt?

Bilt is the membership for where you live.

What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants.

Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once.

We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens.

This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here.

What is Bilt?

Bilt is the membership for where you live. We started by rewarding people on their biggest expense, rent, and have grown into a network connecting members, property managers, and local merchants across dining, travel, fitness, and everyday spending.

The role

Concierge runs in the Bilt app, on the web, and over SMS, iMessage, and email. Members use it for dining, rent, payments, travel, and support. Restaurants and property managers use it to talk with their customers, and their staff use it as an assistant. It handles tens of thousands of conversations a day, with 2–3x spikes at the start of every month, and you'll build and run the backend behind all of it.

What you'll work on

Agent capabilities end to end: tools, workflows, prompts, and the integrations with Bilt and partner systems behind themThe agent runtime: multi-agent orchestration, context and memory, prompt caching, and routing across frontier and open-weight modelsPerformance: p50 and p99 across the full request path, bursty traffic, and cost per conversationEval harnesses, LLM judges, and conversation replay, so every model and prompt change is measured before it shipsAssistants for merchants' staff that work from the business's own data, and browser agents that can act where no API existsProactive features that drive engagement with members and merchants' customers: briefings, follow-ups, and outreach that land at the right momentThe conversation platform: one inbox where the agent, merchant staff, and Bilt support share threads across SMS, iMessage, email, web, and in-app chatMessaging: realtime streaming replies, attachments, message ordering and idempotent delivery, carrier and iMessage sending limits, and handing off to a person at the right momentAuthentication and fine-grained authorization, so the agent only sees and does what it should for members, merchants, and staff

How we build

We are an AI-native team. Agents are part of how we write, review, debug, and operate everything.

Writing. Coding agents like Claude Code and Devin write much of our code. You design it, review it, and own what shipsReviewing. Every PR gets AI review against rules we write down (prompt-cache pitfalls, security, performance) before a human codeowner signs offDebugging. Agents have access to our production tooling through an internal MCP gateway: logs, traces, analytics, feature flags, and the service catalog. Investigations usually start with an agent pulling the evidenceSharing context. Repos carry agent instructions, and we keep a shared library of skills and playbooks, so recurring work becomes a single command and every agent starts with the team's contextOwning. Each engineer owns a large surface from design through rollout and on-call. We ship daily behind flags, treat performance and availability as acceptance criteria, and read real conversations, not only dashboards

You have

4+ years building and operating backend services in productionStrength in at least one backend language and experience running services in the cloud. We mostly use Python (FastAPI), Java (Quarkus), and Go on Google CloudSolid distributed systems fundamentals (async processing, pub/sub, idempotency, retries, caching), and you debug across services with logs, traces, and metricsHands-on experience with LLMs, at work or on your own, and curiosity about making them reliableProduct judgment: you can read a bad conversation and tell whether the cause is the prompt, a tool, the data, or a serviceDaily use of AI coding agents, and good judgment about when to trust their outputClear writing. Design docs, PR descriptions, and the prompts you give agents all matter here

Bonus

Shipped an LLM-powered feature to real users, and can explain what broke and how you measured itAgent frameworks (Google ADK, LangGraph, or similar), tool calling, evals, LLM-as-judgeModel serving and inference: provider routing, open-weight models, latency and cost tuningMessaging or realtime infrastructureBrowser automation or computer-use agentsIdentity and access: OAuth/OIDC, token exchange, fine-grained authorization

Benefits

Compensation - We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus programHealth insurance for you (& your loved ones) from day one - Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one.401k plan with a match - Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there.Commuter FSAs - We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive.UNLIMITED PTO - Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working. Take time for yourself as often as you need it.Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points - We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt.Team Events - We believe in human connection so we hold events to help our employees break from the monotony of the typical work week.

At Bilt Rewards, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt’s salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations.

We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process.

Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt Rewards performance and outcomes - should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time.

The salary range for a Back End / AI Engineer is $170,000 - $300,000 (based on YOE/level), and you will be eligible for equity and an annual performance-based bonus.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing?

You will be one of two dedicated senior consultants embedded with a leading consumer health client who is based in Summit, New Jersey, working across some of the most recognized brands in skin care, oral care, and self care. This is a decision advisor role. You will frame the business question with the client's RGM, pricing & assortment strategy, brand, category and customer teams, work with Circana's modeling team to get the right answer, lead the working session, and land a recommendation the client actually takes to market.

You will work across the full program, spanning both price, promotion and assortment, and you will be measured on the commercial decisions you influence, not the number of scenarios you run.

Hybrid role with commutable distance to Summit NJ as you will spend a minimum of two days a week onsite with the client. The role sits in Circana's Analytics organization, with day-to-day account accountability to the Client Insights team that leads the relationship.

Job Responsibilities

Be the trusted advisor to Revenue Growth Management and Category teams: Be the day-to-day analytics partner to the client's pricing, RGM, category and brand teams. Understand their planning calendar, their line review cycle, and the retailer conversations they are preparing for, and bring a point of view to those moments rather than waiting to be asked. Earn the seat at the table where pricing and assortment decisions get made. Shape pricing and promotion decisions: Interpret base and promoted price elasticities, cross-price effects, price gaps and thresholds across the client's categories and key retailers. Use Circana's platform to pressure test pricing and promotion scenarios with the client, then translate them into pricing corridors, promotional guidelines and retailer-specific recommendations the client can defend in a buyer meeting. Shape assortment and retailer decisions: Apply demand transferability and incrementality outputs at the retailer and market level to line reviews, new item decisions, delisting and planogram trade-offs. Use assortment simulations, including planogram upload and new item scenarios, to build the retailer story with the client and help them win the line review. Connect analytics to commercial outcomes: Frame the question, coordinate the modeling work, lead the working session, and package the recommendation. Follow the decision through to what happened in market and bring that back to the client so the program is judged on results. Manage the cadence of quarterly refreshes, remodels, new item updates and category reviews so the client always knows what is coming and when. Partner with Circana's delivery teams: Work closely with the Global Solutions modeling team, the Client Insights team on the account, and the dedicated analyst. Own the specs the models depend on (product groupings, attributes, geographies) and make sure what gets built matches what the client will use. Build capability on the client side: Train and support client users on the platforms, run office hours, and raise the client's fluency in elasticities, transferability and optimization so they can self-serve on the routine questions and lean on you for the hard ones. Find the next opportunity: Spot the next question before the client asks it. Actively look for adjacent problems the client is working on, whether in Growth Consulting, demand forecasting, causal analytics or other Circana solutions, and bring them to the commercial lead with a point of view on how to scope them. You will be closer to the client's agenda than anyone else at Circana, and we expect you to use that. Communicate with presence: Present clearly and confidently to senior client stakeholders. Tell the story from what the model says to what the business should do, and be willing to challenge the client's thinking when the data supports it. 

Requirements

Ideally 10 to 14 years of experience in CPG revenue growth management, pricing and promotion analytics, category management, or a consulting or analytics role serving CPG clientsA track record of using price elasticity, promotional effectiveness, demand transferability or assortment optimization outputs to influence real pricing, promotion or assortment decisions, and the ability to explain how those models work to a business audienceExperience with Point of Sale (POS), syndicated and panel data; Circana or comparable syndicated data experience strongly preferredDemonstrated ability to lead working sessions, present recommendations to director and VP-level client stakeholders, and hold a position when challengedExperience in consumer health, OTC, beauty or personal care categories preferredFamiliarity with pricing, promotion and assortment simulation platforms preferredBachelor's degree required in business, economics, marketing, statistics or a related field; advanced degree in a quantitative discipline preferred but not requiredLocated in or able to commute to Summit New Jersey a minimum of two days per week

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position is hybrid and can be located in the following area(s): Northern New Jersey / New York metro, with a minimum of two days per week onsite in Summit, NJ. Limited additional travel (under 5%).

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

See how Epsilon powers connected marketing by unlocking the full potential of data and identity.

Epsilon is seeking a Director, Analytic Consulting to join our Analytics Consulting practice, part of the Analytic Services team. You will support consultative client engagements, define measurement approaches for paid and owned channels, and help clients adopt Epsilon’s analytic capabilities, proprietary datasets, cleanroom environments, and media measurement solutions.

The ideal candidate is a highly collaborative, data-driven, client-first analytics leader with deep experience in paid media analytics, audience measurement, campaign performance, segmentation, and marketing effectiveness. This individual can design and guide complex analytic solutions, simplify technical concepts for business audiences, and coordinate talented onshore and offshore analytics teams in the execution and delivery of high-quality client work.

Qualifications

experience in analytics, data science, marketing analytics, or digital media analyticsDemonstrated experience analyzing paid media performance across channels such as programmatic, search, social, record-level datasets, including advertising impressions, site visitation, audience attributes, campaign activity, online sales, offline sales, and customer behavior dataProficiency with SQL, Python, or similar data manipulation and analytic toolsStrong planning, prioritization, and project management skills, with ability to manage multiple analytics projects, requests, timelines, and resources concurrentlyExcellent verbal and written communication skills, with ability to simplify complexity, foster dialogue across teams, and present analytic findings in a clear, compelling, business-focused mannerSkilled in data visualization and executive-level storytelling to communicate the value of analytics to senior collaboratorsProven ability to collaborate across interdisciplinary teams including Strategy, Client Services, Product, Technology, Data Science, AI, Delivery, and AnalyticsExperience managing, coaching, and developing analytics team members, including coordination of junior, onshore, and offshore resourcesHighly motivated, collaborative, intellectually curious, and results-oriented, with a focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and client value realization

Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing?

You will be the dedicated analyst on a two-consultant team embedded with a leading consumer health client in Summit, New Jersey. Circana has been selected as this client's analytics partner for price and promotion and assortment, and you will be the person closest to the model output: running the scenarios, finding what matters in the results, building the deliverables, and making sure every number that reaches the client is right.

This is one of the best development seats in Circana Analytics for the right person. You will get hands-on exposure to price elasticity, promotional effectiveness, demand transferability and assortment optimization models in a live commercial environment, working directly with the consultants, Circana's modeling team and the client's analytics group. Analysts who do this well are on a direct path to a consultant role. The role sits in Circana's Analytics organization, with day-to-day account accountability to the Client Insights team that leads the relationship.

Run the platforms: Become the expert user of Circana's price and promotion and assortment platforms for the client. Execute scenarios and simulations requested by the consultants and client users, QC the results, and turn them around quickly. Find the findings: Go beyond running the scenario. Identify the notable results, the anomalies that need a second look, and the business implications in the model output, and bring them to the consultants with a first take on what they mean for the client. You are the first line of interpretation on the team. Build the deliverables: Translate model output into clear, accurate slides and summaries for line reviews, pricing reviews and category readouts. Maintain a consistent standard across all client-facing materials. Keep the program on schedule: Track quarterly coefficient refreshes, assortment remodels, monthly new item updates and category review timing. Flag risks early and keep the team's internal timeline and open items list current. Manage the data inputs: Maintain the product groupings, attribute files and geography lists the models depend on. Coordinate with Circana's delivery and modeling teams to resolve data questions and confirm what has been built matches the spec. Support client users: Handle routine client questions, support training sessions and office hours, and escalate anything that needs a consultant's judgment. Build the craft: Develop real working knowledge of elasticity modeling, promotional effectiveness measurement, demand transferability and optimization. Learn how the models are built, what drives the results, and where they break, so you can explain outputs to a client, catch errors before they ship, and grow into a consultant role. 

Requirements

2 to 5 years of experience in CPG analytics, category management, revenue growth management support, or a related analytical roleHands-on experience with Point of Sale, syndicated or panel data; Circana data experience preferredStrong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with Python, R or SQL preferredAnalytical curiosity: the instinct to ask why a number looks the way it does and the discipline to check before passing it onStrong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines at onceClear written and verbal communication; comfortable working directly with client usersFamiliarity with consumer health, OTC, beauty or personal care categories preferredBachelor's degree required in business, economics, marketing, statistics or a related field

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Northern New Jersey, NJ, Jersey City, NYC or within commutable distance to be onsite in Summit, NJ at the client's HQ twice per week if needed.
