rows.title: Solutions Leader, Cloud and Engineering - NYC GTM
rows.descriptionText:
Senior Principal, Solutions & GTM –– Greater New York Market
At Slalom, personal connection meets global scale. Our vision is to enable a world in which everyone loves their work and life. We help organizations of all kinds redefine what’s possible, give shape to the future—and get there.Within Slalom, our Build capability helps customers maximize the value of the software they create. We do this by…• Being fast, effective, high-quality, and consistent• Evolving our software development lifecycle by blending cutting-edge AI tooling with outcome-focused strategic thinking• Delivering end-to-end to our customers at any scale and at any point in their journey. You will be a Sr. Principal in our Build Capability in the Americas, working part of a network how we bring this to life with our customers in the Greater New York market. You will drive sales and successfully delivery of outcomes for clients across the product lifecycle as we as we build and modernize digital products, accelerate with on-demand expertise with our clients at any scale, and optimize their technology platforms and organizations.
What You’ll DoThis role executes region Capability GTM strategy with market needs, acting as a subject matter expert and thought leader collaborating with industry partners to identify and win new customer opportunities. This individual is a leader on a go-to-market team, contributes to delivery in delivery leadership roles in customer engagements, and collaborates with leadership to achieve revenue targets and address capability challenges. A requirement of this role is to live within the greater New York Market.Go to Market ApproachCreates demand by proactively seeking out speaking opportunities within the geographic Market as a SME and thought leader at external conferences and events to generate net-new opportunities.Supports Slalom-led thought leadership events, in context of Capability and related Client Outcomes.Works to proactively ignite awareness and generate demand for Capability and related client outcomes in the market. Leads Campaigns, RFIs, RFPs, workshops and POCs to ignite specific opportunities.Researches client portfolio needs and adjusts focus to topics of resonance. Focuses on building client relationships at target and active client portfolio.Business Development & SalesPartners with Industry aligned client partners and sales executives to identify and pursue potential opportunities related to technology-led outcomes.Individually acts as a Solution Lead or SME in pursuit process, identifying appropriate SME from broader capability team as needed. Focuses on specific Customers aligned to Market strategy.Participates in multi-capability solutioning and client outcome based selling motions with GTM team, at the direction of the GTM lead.Works together with peers in other markets and regions in similar roles in how we evolve our GTM approach.Resource PipelineParticipates in Market specific and Capability specific rhythm of business for hiring, staffing, workforce planning; participates in planning process for Market dedicated Capability pool.People DevelopmentLeads individuals both through direct and in-direct reporting relationships to scale GTM focus and results in the market. Has responsibility for an organizational tree that will include team members across levels within a Build discipline of expertise.Acts as mentor to other practitioners in area of Capability working to serve Market’s portfolio.Participates in performance management via providing Feedback on Capability team members assigned to Market’s pursuits and delivery.Delivery ManagementContributes to delivery via billable roles as Delivery Solution Lead and/or in SME roles within Market’s portfolio, with specific utilization target defined by Level.Engages as a leader within a discipline within the Build Capability, such as Software Engineering, Solution Ownership, Quality Engineering, Intelligence Engineering, Platform Engineering.Financial ManagementWorks with GTM leader and broader Capability leadership to contribute to Capability specific growth and cost projections.Works to achieve forecast against revenue targetsWorks proactively with Market and Regional or Americas Capability leadership to identify when a Capability is unhealthy at Market level to adjust strategy.What You’ll BringYou have spent your career learning to be the best at your craft and diving into technology building in many different forms. You long for the days of heads down creation, but now you show up to work every day excited about building and leading teams, helping them grow and be the best. You have mastered the art of working with potential and current clients to propose and bring together the best teams to solve their technology challenges.You are a player coach. You routinely surprise your team with your technology relevance, delivery experience and your geeky side. You aren’t afraid to crack open Jira or Visual Studio and roll up your sleeves. You’ve always loved building, and you are passionate about advancing the craft and co-creating with amazing clients.You bring expertise in these areas:Product Engineering – Brings extensive experience working with product engineering organizations in either industry or professional services, and leading cross-discipline teams delivering with Agile methodologies with depth in multiple disciplines such as Agile / Product Ownership, Software Engineering, Quality Engineering, DevOps, Machine Learning and Experience Design.Accelerated Engineering with AI – Understands how AI is changing the software development industry with perspectives on how roles are changing, how teams can work and move faster, and how to evolve and mature a technology organization leveraging new developments in Generative AI.Enhance and Operate – Extends teams into production with in modern operations, using techniques such as Site Reliability Engineering, to enhance and operate the digital product and solutions that teams build in modern ways.Team-Based Delivery at Scale – Leverages experience delivering engineering projects using scale teaming models and partners, including experience with Nearshore teams and Offshore teams. Product Mindset – Has a product mindset with experience and approaches to product strategy, ability to work with customers and teams around the outcome they are trying to achieve and shaping product and technology roadmaps.Working with Partners – Works with AWS, Microsoft, Google and other top partners in a sales or delivery motion. Understanding of how to co-sell, and or work with professional services teams.Inspirational Leadership - Demonstrates forward looking strategic and critical thinking, connection to market’s needsProactive GTM Mentality - Builds relationships and opportunities to proactively build pipeline; does not wait for sales/client partners to create leadsGrow Slalom Mindset- Acts as an external speaker at events. Speaks to customer CXOs as a peer with credibility and confidence.Collaboration- Has strong ability to collaborate across different teams and organizationWe are looking to hire someone based in the Greater New York market who is flexible to work in a hybrid environment including in office and/or on client site.
About UsSlalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organizations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value. At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all. Compensation and BenefitsSlalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance. Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges: The targeted base salary pay range for Senior Principal is $210,000 to $257,000. In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time. 
We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at: peopleone@slalom.com. EEO and AccommodationsSlalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact accomodationrequest@slalom.com if you require accommodations during the interview process.

rows.title: Delivery Lead
rows.descriptionText:
Target Level: Senior Consultant and Principal
**This role is not eligible for 100% remote work. Employees must live within a commutable distance of the Minneapolis metropolitan area and must be willing to be on-site at the client and/or Slalom Minneapolis office up to 5 days a week.** 
Who You’ll Work With At Slalom, our Delivery capability is the engine that powers transformation. We are the connective tissue across all capabilities—bringing strategy to life through execution that is rigorous, adaptive, and outcome-driven. 
You’ll join a community of delivery professionals who thrive in complexity and are passionate about making things happen. Our teams lead high-impact initiatives across industries, partnering with clients to navigate ambiguity, align stakeholders, and deliver results that matter. Whether it’s a multi-workstream transformation or a product launch, we bring clarity, structure, and momentum to every engagement. 
We work shoulder-to-shoulder with clients, tailoring delivery approaches to meet them where they are—whether Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid. Our focus is on enabling predictable, repeatable outcomes that help organizations dream bigger, move faster, and build better tomorrows.  What You’ll Do Lead the delivery of business and technology projects, ensuring alignment with client goals and Slalom’s delivery standards.Apply agile methodologies to drive iterative progress, foster collaboration, and adapt quickly to evolving needs.Define project scope, timelines, and success metrics in partnership with clients and internal teams, with particular emphasis on enabling smooth migration efforts and transformation initiatives.Oversee project execution through effective resource coordination, risk mitigation, and stakeholder communication, guiding teams through agile ceremonies and delivery governance to ensure the successful delivery of modernization and migration projects.Build trusted relationships with client executives, technical teams, and Slalom consultants to drive alignment and delivery excellence.Leverage AI tools and techniques—such as generative AI for documentation, predictive analytics for risk and timeline forecasting, and automation for reporting—to accelerate delivery and enhance quality.Support business development through scoping, estimation, and proposal contributions, while coaching and mentoring consultants and project managers to foster a culture of continuous learning and innovation.Contribute to the evolution of Slalom’s delivery methodology, including the integration of emerging technologies like AI.
What You’ll Bring Strong experience leading project and program delivery in consulting or complex enterprise environments.Track record of successfully delivering business and/or technology solutions that drive meaningful outcomes.Strong understanding of agile delivery methodologies and project governance. Experience applying AI-enabled tools to streamline delivery workflows and enhance team productivity. Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. Pragmatic Institute, Scrum.org, Scrum Alliance, Scaled Agile, or other relevant certifications are a plus. 
About UsSlalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. 
What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.  Compensation and BenefitsSlalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance. Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges: The targeted base salary pay range for a Senior Consultant is $120,000 to $145,000 and for a Principal $137,000 to $158,000. In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time.    
We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at: peopleone@slalom.com. Please note, this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose. EEO and AccommodationsSlalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact accomodationrequest@slalom.com if you require accommodations during the interview process.

rows.descriptionText:
Director, Global Insurance

Who You’ll Work WithOur global Industry team provides clients with deep, actionable perspectives and differentiates our offerings by applying context and insights unique to the sectors we serve. You will report to the global financial services leader and collaborate across regions with market leaders, delivery and solution teams, sales, alliances, data/AI, cloud, strategy, and customer experience practices to advance the global Insurance strategy spanning Property & Casualty, Life & Annuities, Specialty, and Reinsurnace.
Who You Are
You are an experienced insurance consulting leader with a strong record of shaping and delivering complex transformation initiatives across Property & Casualty, Life & Annuities, Specialty, and Reinsurance. Your background includes consulting experience, preferably with a large or specialized firm, and knowledge of areas such as underwriting, claims, policy administration, distribution, actuarial, finance, enterprise data, and analytics (with a specific emphasis on the front end of the insurance value chain). You connect industry strategy to practical execution, build trusted client relationships, develop market-relevant offerings, and mobilize cross-functional teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

What You’ll DoAs a Director in the Global Insurance Industry team, you will help shape and execute the insurance strategy, develop differentiated offerings, support priority client pursuits, and coordinate consistent execution across regions. Your key responsibilities will include:Contribute to the global Insurance strategy and investment priorities, including market plays, capability development, and talent needs across Property & Casualty, Life & Annuities, Specialty, and ReinsuranceDevelop and refine insurance solutions, offerings, assets, and intellectual property in partnership with industry, capability, and regional leaders.Support go-to-market execution by shaping value propositions, commercial approaches, industry points of view, and sales enablement materials.Lead and support strategic pursuits, develop executive relationships with carriers and reinsurers, and help ensure delivery quality, client outcomes, and healthy margins.Build market visibility by contributing to industry insights, conferences, client forums, and analyst conversations focused on modernization, AI, cloud, compliance, and operating model transformation.Strengthen relationships with hyperscalers, ISVs, data providers, and insurtechs to support joint solutions and coordinated routes to market.Manage operating rhythms and performance measures, including pipeline, forecasting, win rates, delivery health, client satisfaction, utilization, and margin.Build and maintain a healthy pipeline, contribute to annual influenced revenue goals, and support balanced growth across regions and insurance segments.
What You’ll Bring12+ years of progressive experience across insurance and consulting, including leadership of client engagements, pursuits, offerings, or industry initiatives.Demonstrated success translating industry strategy into practical offerings, go-to-market activities, and complex transformation programs.Strong executive presence and comfort presenting to internal and external audiences on insurance trends, points of view, offerings, and client outcomes.Strong knowledge of insurance operations, enterprise data, and relevant regulatory requirements, with depth in one or more insurance segments or functional domains.Commercial acumen and experience shaping and supporting large, complex pursuits; skilled in executive engagement and value-based storytelling.Familiarity with core insurance platforms and ecosystems such as Guidewire, Duck Creek, Sapiens, and Majesco; cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and GCP; and modern data/AI platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks.Relevant professional certifications—such as CPCU, ARM, ARe, FLMI, ASA/FSA, ACAS/FCAS, CISA, CPA, or cloud certifications—are valued but not required.Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills, with the ability to influence across functions, regions, and levels of the organization.Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Finance, Business, or a related field; advanced degree preferred. Ability to travel as needed.

rows.title: Social Media Manager - TikTok Shop (Third Party Associate)
rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
TikTok Shop is an innovative marketplace fully integrated into TikTok. It brings together online sellers, buyers and creators - all within TikTok to build a one-stop, seamless shopping experience and bringing more commerce solutions that further enable our community to discover and engage with what they love.

About the Role

The Integrity, Investigations, Intelligence and Events (i3E) teams at Meta are dedicated to protecting the users of our family of applications (e.g. Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Oculus) from a multitude of threats including: criminal organizations, human trafficking and exploitation, and scams/fraud. You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging, complicated, and high-visibility risks the company is facing.The candidate will be motivated by our mission and demonstrate the ability to independently identify opportunities, drive projects forward, and deliver measurable outcomes, and will be able to extract, assimilate, and correlate a wide variety of data in order to surface and disrupt threat actors across multiple spaces.

Proactively hunt for threats and undetected abuse by leveraging internal data, open-source intelligence, and third party private intelligenceInvestigate complex cases to understand how abuse is occurring and implement enforcement strategies to mitigate and/or detect harmIdentify areas to automate investigative tooling and tradecraftAnalyze and interpret large datasets to advance investigations, quantify trends or support findingsImplement effective strategies to prevent and disrupt abuse at scaleAddress sensitive content issues, including but not limited to graphic images, videos and writings, offensive or derogatory language, and other objectionable materialThis role involves exposure to graphic and/or objectionable content including but not limited to graphic images, videos and writings, offensive or derogatory language, and other potential objectionable material, i.e. child exploitation, graphic violence, self-injury, animal abuse, and other content which may be considered offensive or disturbing

Experience working with Python, PHP or similar scripting languagesProven experience conducting large scale data analysis and utilizing big data tools such as Maltego, Palantir, Tableau, etcTrack record of effective communication and presenting technical findingsExperience prioritizing and executing with minimal direction or oversightExperience to work within a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and changeA combination of investigative skills and engineering skillsExperience working with a team spanning multiple locations/time zones

Preferred Qualifications:

rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
The Measurement team is responsible for interpreting the performance of advertising on our platform. We work with advertisers to optimize their activity on the platform and build meaningful connections that help drive behavior change.

TikTok is looking for a full-time Measurement Partner supporting NA SMB Accounts. This role will partner with small and medium-sized businesses and agencies to help measure the effectiveness of their investment on our platform. The Measurement Partner will help advertisers understand the value TikTok drives for their business, identify opportunities to improve campaign performance, and build measurement maturity at scale.

In addition, this role will partner with key cross-functional teams such as Sales, Product Marketing, Measurement Product, and Business Marketing to ensure clients and agencies have best-in-class measurement support.

We seek highly driven, empathetic individuals who are looking to build our Marketing Sciences discipline. The ability to execute at scale, simplify complex measurement concepts, demonstrate curiosity, and apply data-driven thinking in a fast-growth environment will be critical for success.

Responsibilities:
- Partner primarily with SMB advertisers and agencies to provide measurement solutions that lead to a better understanding of their performance and the value TikTok drives for their business.
- Drive measurement adoption at scale by helping advertisers identify the right measurement approach based on their business objectives, maturity, and available data.
- Focus on strategic consulting together with revenue and product teams to help drive and implement learning agendas for clients and agencies.
- Set up, monitor, and interpret ad effectiveness studies to help advertisers quantify the impact of TikTok advertising and translate measurement results into actionable recommendations.
- Develop and deliver education sessions, resources, and collateral for internal Sales teams, advertisers, and agencies on marketing measurement and best practices.
- Identify opportunities proactively to improve measurement adoption, advertiser education, and business impact across the SMB portfolio.
- Manage client and agency feedback to ensure their voice is reflected with our product, partnerships, and measurement teams.
- Translate complex measurement concepts and results into clear, actionable business recommendations for advertisers and internal stakeholders.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- 5+ years of experience with digital advertising, marketing-related organizations, measurement suppliers.
- A track record of inferential problem solving through experimental design and analytical methods.
- Exceptional time-management and goal-oriented task management skills, with the ability to manage and prioritize a high volume of advertisers and projects.
- Ability to work effectively, deliver consistent quality at scale, and provide clear guidance on what decisions should be made.
- A track record of driving client or stakeholder decisions through clear communication and effective team collaboration.
- Demonstrated ability to operate independently and proactively identify opportunities to help meet the goals of the team and broader organization.
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical measurement concepts for non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant bachelor's degree in a quantitative field; graduate degree in science, mathematics, operations, business, digital marketing, research, or a related field preferred.
- Experience working with advertising agencies, SMB advertisers, or complex marketing data-driven organizations preferred.
- Experience with executing custom analytical work where SQL and R are a plus; practical experience operating within data for an at-scale business preferred.
- Experience developing measurement education, training, or enablement materials for sales teams, advertisers, or agencies.
- Experience with advertising effectiveness measurement, including lift studies, experimentation, attribution, or other measurement methodologies.

Design, implement, and operate highly available backend services that power Snapchat’s growth notification platform across multiple communication channels, serving hundreds of millions of users. Own the end-to-end architecture for Snap’s Growth Notification systems, with a focus on reliability, observability, cost efficiency, and sustainable DAU/MAU and retention impact. Lead technical direction for the Growth Notifications team: define multi‑quarter roadmaps, make high‑quality architectural decisions, and drive large, ambiguous projects from concept through launch and iteration. Advocate for and apply best practices in distributed systems, including SLIs/SLOs, incident management, cost management, and safe, iterative delivery in a high‑leverage, DAU‑critical system.

Experience designing, building, and operating backend services or distributed systems at significant scale. Ability to set technical vision and lead complex, cross‑functional initiatives over multiple quarters, balancing architectural quality, reliability, and product velocity. Strong foundation in system design (APIs, data models, storage, pub/sub, queues, and workflow orchestration) and performance/latency optimization. Deep experience with observability (metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards) and using data to debug, harden, and evolve large-scale systems. Experience with pub/sub and task‑queue systems (e.g., Kafka, Google Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, or internal equivalents) in high‑throughput environments. Responsibilities
TikTok Shop Supply Chain & Logistics team is seeking experienced talents. The team is dedicated to innovating and streamlining TikTok Shop's transportation network and this pivotal role is at the forefront of shaping scalable and efficient transportation strategies. The Carrier Performance Manager is responsible for managing TikTok’s external carrier network and driving end-to-end delivery quality and operational excellence. This role combines vendor management, performance analytics, and quality governance. It ensures carriers meet service, cost, compliance, and customer experience expectations while reducing defects such as loss, damage, delays, and exceptions.

The position works closely with Fulfillment Centers, First Mile, Line Haul, Middle Mile, DSP teams, Tech, Safety, and Customer Experience teams to build a reliable, efficient, and high-performing transportation network.

Key Responsibilities
1. Carrier Management & Delivery Performance Management
- Manage carrier performance across multiple regions.
- Monitor carrier KPIs including SLA compliance, on-time delivery performance, transit accuracy, cost efficiency, and customer impact metrics.
- Conduct weekly and monthly business reviews; drive action plans to improve carrier performance.
- Partner with carriers on capacity planning, operational ramp-up, contingency plans, and peak readiness.
- Build strong, accountable partnerships with carriers to ensure transparency and consistent operational results.

2. Quality Control & Exception Management
- Own quality performance metrics including delivery accuracy, defect rate, loss/damage rate, exception rate, aging&lost, and POD.

- Develop standards and procedures for proper handover, scanning accuracy, handling processes, and customer delivery requirements.
- Partner with carriers to improve operational discipline, handling quality, and compliance with TikTok standards.

- Work across the full logistics chain to align quality standards from pickup and induction through transportation and final delivery.
- Collaborate with FC outbound, line haul, and middle-mile operations to reduce upstream errors that impact carriers (e.g., mis-sort, incorrect labeling, handover discrepancies).
- Ensure consistent quality expectations and SOPs across all logistics nodes.

4. Process, System & Tool Optimization
- Collaborate with product and engineering teams to enhance transportation tools such as exception dashboards, carrier integrations, traceability systems, and quality reporting.
- Promote automation, data accuracy, and operational visibility across the carrier network.
- Provide structured feedback to inform product roadmap and operational process improvements.

- Ensure carrier adherence to TikTok’s operational standards, safety requirements, data policies, and compliance frameworks.
- Work with Safety, Compliance, and Legal teams on audits, incident investigations, and corrective actions.
- Improve driver/handler standards and operational practices to uphold customer experience.

6. Reporting & Continuous Improvement
- Build and maintain dashboards tracking carrier performance, defect metrics, quality KPIs, and compliance indicators.
- Lead continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing defects, improving reliability, and optimizing cost and performance.
- Provide structured weekly/monthly reporting and insights to leadership.

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Operations, or related field.

rows.title: Lead Business Intelligence Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer for Snap’s People Team. This person will be a trusted business partner who brings together technical expertise, business acumen, and analytical rigor. They will work closely with engineering, People Science, business leaders, and HR leadership to lead business intelligence and analytics engineering initiatives, design scalable data solutions, deliver meaningful insights, and enable data-informed decision-making.

What you’ll do:

Lead complex, high-impact business intelligence and analytics engineering initiatives from problem definition through delivery. Translate ambiguous business needs into clear technical and analytical approaches, working with stakeholders to define requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and prioritize solutions. Independently own your workflow and delivery, using sound judgment to prioritize work, manage timelines and dependencies, address risks or blockers, and keep stakeholders informed. Design and architect reliable, scalable data pipelines, data models, and self-service analytics solutions using tools such as SQL, Python, BigQuery, Airflow, Visier, Looker, and Posit. Own key data products or systems end-to-end, including technical design and architecture, quality, reliability, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, and continuous improvement. Conduct rigorous analysis and translate complex findings into clear insights and recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences. Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve data quality, reduce manual work, and build more scalable solutions. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members, contribute to team standards and best practices, and help foster a culture of learning and high-quality execution. 

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Advanced SQL and Python skills, with experience designing and building reliable data pipelines, models, and analytics solutions, and the ability to leverage AI-assisted development and analytics tools responsibly; and willingness to adopt new technologies as needs evolve. Deep understanding of the data ecosystem, including data warehouses, dimensional and semantic modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, analytics layers, visualization tools, and self-service data products. Demonstrated ability to design reliable, scalable data architectures and improve data quality, performance, maintainability, and operational resilience. Ownership and accountability, with the ability to independently navigate complex or ambiguous problems, make sound technical and architectural decisions, manage priorities across multiple workstreams, and drive work forward with limited direction. Experience applying analytical and statistical methods, including descriptive analysis, regression, correlation, time series analysis, and hypothesis testing, using tools such as Python or R. Business acumen and experience translating business questions into clear metrics, analytical requirements, data solutions, and actionable insights, with careful attention to scope, consistency, and interpretation. Ability to lead through influence and communicate complex technical and analytical concepts clearly across executives, business partners, analysts, and technical teams. Strong judgment and commitment to data quality, privacy, security, governance, and the responsible use of People data. 

Minimum Qualifications:

BS/BA degree in a technical field (e.g., computer science, mathematics) or a research-based social science field (e.g., public policy, sociology). 6+ years of relevant experience in business intelligence engineering, analytics engineering, data engineering, quantitative analysis, or a related field or a Master’s degree in a technical field + 5+ year of post-grad experience; or a PhD in a related technical field + 2+ years of post-grad experience6+ years of experience with SQL or similar query languages and development experience in at least one object-oriented or scripting language (Python, Java, Scala, etc.); Python preferred. 3+ years of experience designing and building dashboards, reports, and other end-user analytics solutions using data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, Visier, Posit, or similar platforms. 

Preferred Qualifications:

MA/MS in a technical and/or research-based field. Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform and data technologies such as BigQuery and Airflow. Experience working in an agile development environment and collaborating across technical and business teams. Experience with version control systems such as Git. Experience working with People data, including workforce and Talent Acquisition data, and familiarity with People analytics platforms such as Visier. 

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable).

Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!

rows.title: Principal Product Manager, SNPL
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we’ve tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it’s supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we’re not just here to move money— we’re here to move our global customers forward.

We’re looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that’s you and you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

About The Role

Remitly is expanding beyond cross-border remittances to build a full suite of financial products that help consumers get paid, save, spend, and borrow — all built on the trust and reliability millions of customers already place in Remitly. As Principal Product Manager for Send Now Pay Later (SNPL), you will own one of the most consequential pillars of this vision: giving Remitly customers access to responsible, accessible credit and borrowing solutions that meet them where they are.

This is a senior, high-ownership role. You will define the strategy and roadmap for Remitly's borrowing products — after a customer is onboarded through long-term retention and healthy repayment outcomes — while working with a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, analysts, and internal partners. You will balance product growth with responsible lending principles, building financial tools that genuinely improve customers' lives. Critically, you understand that a healthy borrowing portfolio is inseparable from overall product engagement — and you will drive usage across the full Remitly Card plan, knowing that customers who find broad value in the plan stay longer, borrow more responsibly, and represent lower risk. This position reports to the General Manager of the Borrow team.

You Will:

Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for Remitly's suite of borrowing solutions, spanning early feature activation post-onboarding, ongoing engagement, proactive and reactive retention, and repayment experience.Own the full product lifecycle — from discovery, requirements, and design collaboration through development, testing, launch, and ongoing optimization — ensuring consistent quality and velocity at every stage.Drive early feature activation for newly onboarded members — designing the experiences and triggers that convert onboarded customers into active users (sending, saving, spending and borrowing), ensuring they quickly realize the value of Remitly Card features.Drive engagement across the full Remitly Card plan — identifying opportunities to deepen usage of card features beyond borrowing, partnering with adjacent product teams to connect customers to relevant value, and using cross-feature engagement as a lever for retention and portfolio health.Build proactive and reactive retention strategies — designing the triggers, interventions, and experiences that keep members engaged and in good standing, and that recover at-risk members before they lapse or default.Develop a clear point of view on repayment UX and outcomes, treating repayment not as a back-office function but as a core product surface that builds trust, drives repeat borrowing, and protects the health of the portfolio.Champion an AI-first way of working across the product lifecycle — using AI to accelerate research synthesis, experiment design, and spec writing, while identifying where AI can create differentiated product experiences within borrowing (e.g., dynamic credit offers, personalized repayment nudges, intelligent risk signals).Define success metrics and instrumentation from day one — draw rates, repayment rates, retention cohorts, and cross-feature engagement — and build the experimentation and analytics framework to make fast, confident decisions.Develop a strong competitive point of view on how borrowing products are evolving for immigrant and underserved consumer segments, and translate that into product bets that differentiate Remitly.Represent the voice of the customer — conducting direct user research, synthesizing qualitative and quantitative signals, and building a roadmap that the full cross-functional team can rally around.Communicate roadmap, trade-offs, and portfolio health clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and executive leadership, building alignment and momentum across Remitly's broader financial services strategy.

You Have:

8+ years of product management experience, with significant time in consumer fintech or financial services products — including demonstrated ownership of a full customer lifecycle.A track record of scaling a financial product from early-stage through high-volume usage, with measurable impact on retention and repayment or portfolio health outcomes.Deep familiarity with lending and credit product dynamics — underwriting, draw behavior, repayment mechanics, delinquency management — and a strong instinct for where product decisions drive portfolio outcomes.Experience driving cross-product or platform engagement, with an understanding of how feature breadth and usage depth connect to retention and customer lifetime value.An AI-first mindset — you actively use AI tools in your daily workflow to move faster and better, and you're excited to explore where AI can power smarter, more personalized borrowing experiences.Strong quantitative and analytical skills — comfortable defining metrics, reading SQL and data directly, building business cases, and using experimentation rather than intuition to drive decisions.Experience working alongside Risk, Compliance, and Legal on regulated financial products, with the ability to navigate complex constraints without losing product velocity.Sharp product sense and design instincts — you care about the nuances of a credit or repayment flow and can articulate why a customer experience builds or erodes trust.Proven leadership in cross-functional environments — you know how to align engineers, designers, analysts, risk partners, and executives around a shared strategy and execute with clarity.Comfort operating at senior levels of ambiguity; you make confident decisions with incomplete information and create momentum even when the path isn't fully defined.Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

In the U.S., Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster.

Support the development cycles & measure outcomes post launch. Share learnings with the other Regional Business Managers and the US-LAC GM so that what works in one cluster can be applied across the region.

5+ years of professional experience in business management, growth, or general management roles in a B2C context, ideally in money movement, fintech, or financial services. Native level fluency in Spanish (required), fluent Portuguese for Brazil-focused candidates. An ownership mentality and a track record of ownership. Ability to balance compassionate partnership and the ability to be constructively direct. You will influence and network within the business and with external partners.

Experience in fintech, payments, or financial services. Ideally serving immigrant communities in the US or customers in Latin America and the Caribbean. Product experience OR growth / marketing experience in the areas noted above.

About the Role:

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Global Network Experience (GNX) in Money Platform — the team that owns the decision intelligence behind every dollar Remitly moves. Our platform determines not just how money moves, but what's possible, what's required of a customer, and what outcome they should expect.

You will work on a platform operating at real scale: 5,000+ corridors across 171 countries, 35,000+ routes, tens of thousands of receiving institutions, and a catalog serving hundreds of millions of requests a day. The complexity is shape as much as size: a route is a combination of country, currency, payment method, institution, partner and product line — only some combinations are valid, and we keep adding dimensions.

The central engineering challenge is platformizing that complexity — democratizing the data, building autonomy

into network management, optimizing business value with continuous monitoring and intelligence, and making each new corridor, partner, payment method or product line faster to launch and better-performing than the last.

GNX's platform surface spans from defining the data model of the network to the intelligence that operates it:

Modeling the network — the authoritative account of what the network can do: every partner, institution, destination and route we support, and the libraries everything else is built on.Deciding how money moves — what we ask and verify before a send, the route it takes, the limits that apply, when it will land across 171 countries of partner schedules and holidays, and what happens when a partner fails. Every transaction, continuously, and increasingly by model rather than rule.Controlling it safely — the platform operators run the network from, and the agent interfaces that let AI do the same under real change control.

We are looking for range: depth in one of these areas, enough fluency in the others to make good calls at the seams, and the communication to represent your area to everyone who depends on it. You will take technical ownership of an area, become the person the company trusts on it, and then do it again somewhere else. The domains are interdependent — a change in how the catalog models an institution lands on routing, validation and estimates within the same quarter — so the engineers who do well here are the ones who can hold more than one of them in their head.

The direction is autonomy — a network that notices a partner degrading, reroutes around it and corrects its own delivery promises without a human in the loop. You will also work closely with network operations, program management, analytics, the ML team, Treasury, integration squads and business product teams — the platform has a broad internal customer base, and part of the job is representing your area to it.

You Will:

Gather and analyze requirements from product, program, business, network operations and partner engineering teams.Design, code, and test services, APIs, data models and configuration surfaces that hold up under high throughput and real money movement.Work across GNX's domains rather than a single service, taking technical ownership of an area and becoming its subject-matter expert — the person consulted on design, feasibility and correctness in that space.Ramp into unfamiliar parts of the platform quickly, and move between them as priorities shift.Migrate capability from legacy services onto the platform without interrupting production traffic, and retire what you replace.Turn work that engineers do today into configuration that operators and partner teams can do themselves.Partner with ML and analytics to put routing and estimate intelligence into production, and to instrument the signals those models learn from.Identify and fix issues or bugs; participate in an on-call rotation across a Tier-1 service estate, and work with the team to quickly resolve problems and maintain system stability.Work within change control and compliance constraints, including SOX- and PCI-scoped systems.Guide the team's technical strategy while leading and shipping features and systems.Incorporate AI-assisted development into project estimates, and evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security and maintainability before it ships.Guide peers on responsible AI use, and use AI where it helps to prototype into unfamiliar problem areas.Promote engineering excellence by delivering well-tested, observable, documented, efficient, scalable, and resilient solutions, improving team processes, and contributing to cross-team technical designs.Report to the Engineering Manager for the team in Seattle, WA.

You Have:

A BS in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience6+ years of professional experienceBreadth across system types — you have worked on more than one kind of problem, and can point to a time you became productive in an unfamiliar codebase or domain quicklyExperience designing and operating large-scale distributed backend systems, including high-throughput, low-latency servicesExperience with data modeling and configuration-driven or rules-engine systems, where behavior is data rather than codeExperience modeling domains where complexity is dimensional as much as volumetric — many interactingattributes, sparse valid combinations, and a schema that has to absorb a new dimension without every consumer rewritingExperience migrating or decommissioning production systems while they remain in useExperience evaluating AI-generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability, and coaching otherson responsible AI useKnowledge of backend programming languages such as Java or GolangProven experience with software development practices, system design, software design patterns, andalgorithmsExperience with AWS and containerized deployment (Kubernetes)Proficiency in CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab, etc.)

Nice to Have:

Experience with analytics or data engineering, building the datasets and pipelines that downstream teams and ML systems depend onExperience in payments, money movement, or another domain with external partner integrations and correctness-critical workflowsExperience productionizing ML models as part of a decisioning systemExperience building internal tooling that non-engineers depend on, including frontend workExperience with time- and schedule-based logic across many jurisdictions

Support commercial conversations with disbursement and destination partners in your markets, turning partner opportunities into customer-facing offers. Monitor competitor activity, market developments and customer trends, translating insights into regional priorities. Build business cases for key initiatives and influence prioritization of partner-teams' roadmaps through structured business impact / customer centric frameworks. Drive ideation of regional product initiatives, and work with the US-LAC product, engineering, and design team to translate customer and commercial opportunities into clear requirements. Support the development cycles & measure outcomes post launch. Share learnings with the other Regional Business Managers and the US-LAC GM so that what works in one cluster can be applied across the region.

You Have:

5+ years of professional experience in business management, growth, or general management roles in a B2C context, ideally in money movement, fintech, or financial services. Native level fluency in Spanish (required), fluent Portuguese for Brazil-focused candidates. An ownership mentality and a track record of ownership. We are looking for someone with a bias for action who “gets things done” and is hungry to grow their areas of the business. Ideally you have: owned a market, product, or P&L end to end and driven results across some combination of pricing, product, marketing, and risk/fraud. Deep regional and cultural expertise in at least one of the corridor clusters above, gained through lived experience, professional experience in the region, or both, including an understanding of the migrant community in the US and how customers send and receive money in these markets. Demonstrated problem solving skills (qualitative and quantitative). Can generate high quality hypotheses and dive into an ambiguous problem statement. Ability to balance compassionate partnership and the ability to be constructively direct. You will influence and network within the business and with external partners.

Preferred:

Experience in fintech, payments, or financial services. Ideally serving immigrant communities in the US or customers in Latin America and the Caribbean. Product experience OR growth / marketing experience in the areas noted above.

Compensation Details: The starting base salary range for this position is typically $156,000 - $195,000. Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster.

rows.title: Senior Scientist, Regulatory & Clinical Operations
rows.descriptionText:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About The Role

Hims & Hers is seeking a Senior Scientist, Regulatory & Clinical Operations to join our growing laboratory organization. This individual contributor will report to the Director of R&D and serve as the clinical coordinator for our FDA-regulated study, working directly with our contracted CRO to own execution of the study from kickoff through completion.

The ideal candidate is comfortable operating at the intersection of bench science and clinical study execution, translates regulatory rigor into practical day-to-day decisions, and thrives working independently in a fast-moving environment.

This is an on-site laboratory role based in Central New Jersey.

You Will

Clinical Study Coordination

Serve as the primary clinical coordinator and point of contact for the FDA-regulated studies, working directly with the contracted CROOwn day-to-day execution of the study once it kicks off, including site coordination and protocol adherence in accordance with GCP requirementsCoordinate sample logistics with the CRO, including shipment documentation, tracking, and resolution of sample-related issues (e.g., missing samples, shipment discrepancies)Coordinate with the CRO on study timelines, data collection, protocol deviations, and reportingPerform root cause analysis and support Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) activities for study-related deviationsDevelop and review study protocols, ensuring scientific rigor and compliance with design control and applicable regulatory requirementsCoordinate human subjects protection activities, including IRB submissions and approvals and informed consent documentationIdentify technical and regulatory risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies to maintain study timelines and complianceTrack and manage study documentation, including case report forms and monitoring visit findings

Assay and Study Execution

Perform hands-on assay execution and testing in direct support of the regulated studySupport design of statistically robust validation strategies (e.g., precision, linearity, method comparison, LoB/LoD/LoQ, interference, stability) aligned with CLSI guidelines and regulatory expectationsSupport sample processing and testing per study protocol using automated chemistry and immunoassay platforms (Roche Cobas or equivalent) and LC-MS/MS (SCIEX 4500MD or equivalent) instrumentationEvaluate performance characteristics of venous as well as capillary specimens collected via at-home devices such as Tasso and YourBio HealthTroubleshoot study-related assay and technical issues in collaboration with the CRO and internal team

Quality and Regulatory Collaboration

Partner with the Quality team to ensure study designs and documentation meet FDA, CAP, and CLIA requirementsMonitor study data for accuracy and integrity throughout the study lifecycleSupport laboratory inspection readiness and audit preparation activities related to the regulated studyAuthor and review technical reports and validation documentation suitable for regulatory submissionDevelop and deliver data-driven presentations and study updates for internal leadership and external stakeholdersCollaborate with Clinical Laboratory Operations during study transfer and implementationServe as interim lab manager as needed, overseeing day-to-day lab operations

You Have

PhD in Clinical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Molecular Biology, or related field with 4+ years; OR Master’s degree with 7+ years; OR Bachelor’s degree with 10+ years of relevant bench experience in a diagnostic or clinical laboratory settingDemonstrated experience coordinating clinical or regulated studies, ideally in partnership with a CROExperience supporting FDA-regulated studies (e.g. 510(k), De Novo, or PMA pathways)Hands-on experience across assay development and execution lifecycleExperience with venous and/or capillary blood-based specimen types and other biological matricesAbility to reconcile clinical sample data across tracking and laboratory systemsStrong project management and organizational skills, with proven ability to manage study timelines and cross-functional coordinationAbility to perform basic statistical analysis to support interpretation of study dataWorking knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and design control processes (e.g., FDA QSR, ISO 13485)Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with proven ability to present complex study data clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholdersProven ability to work independently and drive study execution from kickoff to completion

Preferred Qualifications

Experience validating capillary microsampling devices (e.g., Tasso, TAP) for regulated studiesExperience with at-home or point-of-care diagnostic testing programsExperience with dried blood spot (DBS) workflows and stability characterizationExperience with statistical analysis software (e.g., JMP, Analyse-It)Experience with clinical data management and monitoring processesFamiliarity with patient safety monitoring and adverse event reporting requirements for human subjects researchFamiliarity with emerging biomarker categories relevant to metabolic health, longevity, and consumer wellness testingHands-on familiarity with AI/ML tools (e.g., Python, Copilot Studio) for process improvement or data workflows

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time rolesUnlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health daysComprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leaveEmployee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)401k benefits with employer matching contributionOffsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Hims & Hers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@forhims.com and describe the needed accommodation. Your privacy is important to us, and any information you share will only be used for the legitimate purpose of considering your request for accommodation. Hims & Hers gives consideration to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected status, including disability. Please do not send resumes to this email address.

To learn more about how we collect, use, retain, and disclose Personal Information, please visit our Global Candidate Privacy Statement.

rows.title: Pricing Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 2-3 days in office)

Pricing at Marshmallow

This role will sit in the Pricing Team, reporting into the Pricing Data Science Manager. The team is responsible for managing our loss ratio, underwriting footprint, broker optimisation and growth targets, proving integral to driving the business forwards. But you’ve probably read that all before! So what’s new?

We work in a very different way to most pricing teams that you might be familiar with. Everyone in Pricing has the potential to make significant contribution to the business, taking ownership, moving fast, innovating and delivering changes to our rates at high frequency.

We don’t just churn out GLMs all day. We build & deploy exceptional in-house pricing data science models using the latest modelling techniques. You’ll work alongside other Pricing Data Scientists & Analysts pushing innovative pricing projects, whilst also being able to work with the wider Data Science community on modelling customer behaviour, fraud & MLENG enhancements.

We work alongside a bunch of amazing engineers who ensure we can implement our decisions quickly. We also have access to huge amounts of data. We don’t just mean your standard policy, claims and quote data. Our engineers spend their lives building APIs to third parties so that we know more about our customers than any of our competitors.

All of this means that you’ll have access to as much data as you can handle, the freedom to be creative, the backing of senior leaders to make decisions, and the ability to see your ideas implemented rapidly. And on top of all of that, we’re a pretty fun group to hang around with!

What You’ll Be Doing

Developing a deep understanding of Marshmallow’s quote, policy and claims data and use this to derive insights that can be used to enhance our pricing.Own one of the strategic initiatives of the pricing team, such as supporting our expansion plans or protecting our renewing customers.Conducting claims analysis and claims modelling using SQL and Python.Conducting price optimisation analysis/modelling using Python.Building and deploying models in APIs for use in real time pricing.Identify new sources of external data that enable us to refine our view of claims risk, and conduct analysis to quantify their value.Working directly with our Engineering & MLENG functions to implement pricing proposals.Providing pricing support for the launch of multiple new products.

Who are you?

Proactive: You drive growth by identifying & delivering new opportunities Modeller: You use your DS expertise to build innovative best in class modelsCommercial: You directly use your models as tools to deliver timely real world impactCurious: You aren’t satisfied with ‘That’s just how it is’; you immediately investigate furtherOwner: You don’t just pull existing levers - you own end to end transformation in your areaOpinionated: You generate your own opinions & pitch to others in an open & honest wayExplainer: You can communicate complicated concepts in a simple way to non-expertsNetworker: You build and maintain strong relationships throughout the business

What skills are we looking for from you?

Ability to interrogate data and conduct pricing analysis within SQL & Python/RAbility to build GLMs, GBMs and other claims models within Python/RAt least 3 years of experience working in a data driven (ideally commercial) role

Perks of the job

Bonus scheme designed to reward high performancePrivate medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with OlivaPersonal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a yearMonthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose25 days holiday plus bank holidays4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

We are able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Our process

Initial call with a member from our Talent Team (30 mins)Past Experience interview with Hiring Manager (60 mins)Technical interview with a couple of the team (60 mins)Onsite Culture interviews (90 mins)

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

rows.title: Research Associate
rows.descriptionText:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie

Intelligence Connected

WoodMac.com

Wood Mackenzie Brand Video

Wood Mackenzie Values

Inclusive – we succeed togetherTrusting – we choose to trust each otherCustomer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisionsFuture Focused – we accelerate changeCurious – we turn knowledge into action

The Role And Main Responsibilities

We are looking for an Associate to work as part of our Refinery monitoring research team. The team monitors oil refineries and Petrochemical facilities in the US, Europe and Asia, and informs clients, typically traders, of any noteworthy events (planned/unplanned maintenance, ad-hoc events, etc.) that might impact their markets and trading positions.

Key Responsibilities Include

Review real-time infrared images to monitor different Oil Refineries and Petrochemical facilities across the globe.Train our machine learning models to improve the quality of their asset on/off predictions.Query our large datasets of high-frequency data to proactively generate insights or/and respond to client queries.Support efforts to improve current internal processes.Connect with colleagues internally to discuss data and insights that can be useful to form an integrated view of the short-term markets.

Your application should showcase your enthusiasm for the sectors we cover and demonstrate your ability in the following areas, which we require daily at Wood Mackenzie.

Research and data gathering – we identify and gather intelligence that feeds our industry expertise. We need inquisitive and passionate people with a keen eye for detail.Analysis - we provide market-leading research using this data/intelligence and form opinions for, and tell stories to, our customers. We need people with natural curiosity with the potential to become experts in their field and with the ability to articulate – both verbally and in writing – clear, insightful analysis.Internal engagement – we work with colleagues across the Wood Mackenzie business to deliver a compelling, integrated view of the natural resources sector to customers through our cutting-edge products. For this, we need people who are as comfortable working collaboratively as they are independently and who have excellent interpersonal skills.External engagement – we proactively connect with our customers and contacts in the industries we serve, adding value and promoting the Wood Mackenzie brand. This requires people with the potential to become industry experts who have intellectual curiosity, passion, and excellent presentation skills.Continuous improvement – at Wood Mackenzie, we are committed to transforming the way we power our planet. The energy transition is here and this impacts our customer base and how we serve them. We need colleagues with a change mindset, who are flexible, growth-orientated and proactive. This includes being innovative in the AI space.

About You

You are an engineer or economist and will have relevant experience, skills or knowledge that you can apply to the role, allowing you to contribute to our research from day one. Your existing knowledge will enhance our coverage as you develop your career.

Keen interest in commodity market dynamics - as someone with a keen interest in commodity market dynamics, you want to understand how these markets impact the natural resources industry and our everyday lives. Analytical mindset and eye for detail - your analytical mindset and attention to detail have been honed through academic and/or work experience. You're comfortable collecting and interpreting data, articulating your findings clearly, and seeking to enhance your knowledge by asking thoughtful questions. You have experience with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, which helps you present your findings in a visually compelling way. Highly adaptive team player - you thrive in fast-paced environments and are excited about the opportunity to work cross-functionally on a variety of tasks. You can work independently or as part of a team, generating ideas and striving to be the best in class. Excellent communication skills - Your strong command of English, both written and spoken, allows you to communicate effectively in the globalised commodity market. Fluency in an additional language would be advantageous. 

Expectations

Growth mindset - taking the initiative to learn new skills, seeking out feedback and coaching, and actively applying what has been learned in the workplace. Change agility - maintaining high performance through disruption and change. We are a hybrid working company and the successful applicant will be expected to be physically present in the office at least 2 days per week to foster and contribute to a collaborative environment, but this may be subject to change in the future. This is a full-time role. 

Equal Opportunities

We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. You can find out more about your rights under the law at www.eeoc.gov
